blocks.text: Bayshore Beautiful contains examples of Tampa's most stately and elegant homes with 4,764 homes in the neighborhood. This Tampa neighborhood is one of the city's more luxurious communities, with top-tier schools and homes hugging picturesque Hillsborough Bay. The most notable feature of Bayshore Beautiful is the scenic Bayshore Boulevard sidewalk. The world’s longest continuous sidewalk, extending nearly five miles along the water and welcoming runners, walkers and roller bladders, offers beautiful views of the grand homes which line Bayshore Boulevard, stunning sunsets, and the downtown Tampa skyline. There is a festive vibe during the annual Gasparilla parade in late January, which is a rich part of Tampa’s history and a very important part of the Bayshore culture.

Most of the homes in the Bayshore Beautiful neighborhood were built in the early 1920’s. The area features homes that are very consistent in character. While Bayshore Beautiful features some larger pricier homes, upwards of 3,000 square feet, there are also homes around 1,000-1,500 square feet that require some renovations. There are varying architectural styles, including ranches, Mediterranean Revival homes with archways and red tiled roofs and symmetrical Colonial Revival-style properties, that range from the early 20th century through today. Some newer homes copy vintage styles to blend with surrounding homes. Dense canopies of tall, old trees provide heavy shade on many streets. There are condominiums, some near the water, varying in living area square footage.

Residents of Bayshore Beautiful have access to all of the amenities of Tampa Bay. The South Tampa network of communities affords an abundance of opportunities for dining and shopping. Restaurants include fine dining options, casual fare, as well as cafes and coffee shops. Shoppers will delight in quirky boutiques, antique shops and well known and loved retail chains. Between Bayview and Wallcraft Avenues on MacDill Avenue, there is a small district of bars, cafes, and shops.

Bayshore Beautiful is surrounded by Palma Ciea Park with basketball, dog park and grills, Ballast Point Park with boating, fishing and Fred Ball Park with picnic area, tennis and walking trails. The location is convenient for those working in greater Tampa or St. Petersburg, about 20 miles south across the bay. Tampa International Airport is 16 minutes away.

blocks.text: Jack Nicklaus created a renowned golf club near his South Florida home that is both a celebration of his achievements in the game and a special retreat for members and their guests. He made his dream a reality in 1999 with the creation of The Bear’s Club in Jupiter, and he spared no expense to create another seminal golf experience.

At The Bear’s Club, a golf community nestled among 369 immaculate forested acres a mile from the Atlantic, Nicklaus expertly transformed the native environment with his exacting standards of design. The result is a gently rolling 7,164-yard layout that exudes a Lowcountry feel as it moves through a property rich in native vegetation, old oaks, pines, cypress trees and wetlands areas.

Barbara Nicklaus partnered with her husband to hone the Mediterranean design that ties together the clubhouse with the residential community. The massive golf headquarters, which sprawls more than 64,000 square feet on two levels, is a bastion of splendor. The interior design, to which Barbara lent her tastes, radiates an unmistakable warmth enhanced by woven rugs, decorative pieces of ceramic and porcelain, original artwork, and elegant fabrics and patterns.

Out-of-town members or their guests can also utilize four elegant one-bedroom suites named for four of Nicklaus’ favorite addresses in golf: Pebble Beach, Augusta National, St. Andrews and Muirfield, the Scottish links where he won the 1966 British Open to complete the career Grand Slam. Property owners can retire to luxurious homes; residential options include 17 golf villas, 14 club cottages and 57 estate homes built in Tuscan and French-provincial styles.
Call or email Real Estate of Florida now for more information about this elite golf community.

blocks.text: Boca Delray Golf & Country Club is an active adult 55+ gated community that is a non-equity, member-owned golf and country club. It is for those aged fifty-five and older who still enjoy a very active lifestyle with plenty of amenities to enjoy. Weekly tournaments for the men's and women's golf association are hosted at Boca Delray during the year along with mixed couple social tournaments as well. The heart of the community at Boca Delray Golf and Country Club is its beautifully presented 18-hole executive-style golf course. Boca Delray's par 60 layout has picturesque views and a vast amount of wildlife.

This attractive, low-density community is designed for serious golfers and keen tennis players as Boca Delray residents enjoy cordial neighbors, wide-open views, tree-lined streets, and a butterfly garden, all at very affordable prices. With a range of golf condos, single-family homes, apartments, and golf villas there is something to suit every lifestyle.

Amenities include golf, tennis, swimming and a fitness center, open 24/7, with the pools being temperature controlled the entire year for maximum enjoyment. You can always enjoy lunch at the Poolside Grille and, since they have free Wi-Fi there, you can bring your computer or tablet and check email, surf the net and watch streaming movies there as well. The residents live in a year-round party with members and enjoy an active and healthy lifestyle along with fine art, theatre opera, and other cultural performances, as well as shows, dances, entertainment, and fun. In addition to the golf course, the country club's well-maintained and shaded grounds host clay tennis courts, temperature-controlled pools, a giant Jacuzzi, a state-of-the-art fitness center, a Pro Shop, and the elegant clubhouse restaurant.

Conveniently located on the border of Boca Raton and Delray Beach the community is just minutes from the myriad of activities and attractions of downtown Delray Beach. Museums, art galleries, boutique shopping, the theatre, Mizner Park, and the beautiful Atlantic Ocean are just a few of the many reasons to choose nearby Boca Delray Golf and Country Club.

blocks.text: Boca Grove is a prestigious, members-only golf and country club located in the heart of Boca Raton, Florida. A boutique-style residential community that is home to less than 450 member families, Boca Grove is a recreational oasis and is recognized as one of South Florida's most affluent and desirable communities.

Members enjoy a nationally recognized tennis program, a fitness complex, and an array of casual and fine dining options, and of course, our Jim Fazio-designed 18-hole, championship golf course. The clubhouse was renovated and features a new concept restaurant, a sports bar with five large-screen televisions and all the amenities one would expect. Chippers Sports Bar has become the place to eat, meet and be merry at Boca Grove. There is a fully renovated $11.5M sports and wellness center, a resort-style pool and splash pad, children's center, a casual dining cafe by the poolside, a full-service gym including pilates and group fitness studios, plus extensive exercise and cardiovascular equipment.

blocks.text: 1550 Flagler Pkwy West Palm Beach, FL 33411

This elegant gated Breaker's West community is 3 miles west of Florida’s Turnpike on Okeechobee Boulevard in West Palm Beach, Florida. Situated on 670-acres of natural wooded area, this beautiful community is also a wildlife sanctuary with towering pines and graceful palms, sparkling lakes and manicured lawns that set the canvas for homeowners to experience a tranquil lifestyle in an Old Florida setting. Breakers West features single family homes in 14 neighborhoods.

Within the community, there are two prestigious country clubs both known for their championship golf courses: Breakers West and Mayacoo Lakes. Unique to this community, club memberships are available to homeowners but are not mandatory. The Breakers West Country Club is owned by The Breakers Resort in Palm Beach, and is a non-equity club offering five different membership levels, several featuring reciprocal privileges at The Breakers for golf, tennis, and their renowned Beach Club. At the Breakers West, members can enjoy the challenging Rees Jones Course, 7 Har-Tru tennis courts, 2 pickle ball courts, large pool and hot tub, Fitness Center, Kids Club as well as the Clubhouse bar and restaurants. The second one, Mayacoo Lakes Country Club, offers its members four different membership categories. Mayacoo Lakes members enjoy golfing where no tee times are required, an active tennis program, and a swimming pool with an outdoor snack bar along with a socially active membership.

Breakers West is convenient to West Palm Beach’s Wall Street South financial center, The Square, Kravis Center for the Performing Arts, Norton Art Museum, Palm Beach’s sophisticated dining and shopping, Palm Beach International Airport as well as Wellington’s equestrian facilities.

/neighborhood/brookridge-country-club-an.description: Search Homes For Sale in Brookridge Brooksville Homes for.

blocks.text: Bursting with amenities in bright, sunny Florida, Brookridge is an active adult community with a golf club at its center. There is an abundance of amenities within the community, but more important is the neighborhood’s location being only 1/2 mile from the Suncoast Parkway. Bookridge is just 45 minuets from Tampa and has proximity to multiple hospitals and shopping plazas that are a short drive away. This location is 15 minutes from the Gulf, Pine Beach, and Weeki Wachee Springs.

Brookridge is a masterfully planned 55+ manufactured home golf community located on Florida’s nature coast, in the Hernando County town of Brooksville. It is is a deed-restricted community with 24 hour gated access and all lots are individually owned with owners belonging to the Brookridge Community Home Owners Association where fees are kept to a low level. Homes in the community vary from 2-4 bedrooms and range from 720 square feet to 2,640 square feet in living area. Some homes overlook the golf course.

Brookridge offers residents a heated pool with a sundeck, clubhouse, tennis courts, an 18-hole golf course, and putting green. The pool, sports courts and regularly scheduled events like bingo games and dances contribute to the active nature of the neighborhood. The biggest amenity in the neighborhood is The Brookridge Country Club Golf Association, which is home to a par 72 championship golf course, pro shop and clubhouse. The pro shop and club house provide the pleasant setting for many social functions and includes a full liquor bar, restaurant snack shop and golf equipment sales, as well as a comfortable area to lounge with friends. The Association host golf leagues, social functions and a yearly tournament. Memberships include opportunities to participate in 9 and 18 hole leagues for ladies and men as well as regular social golf functions. A Club Championship Tournament is held each year for regular members.

Rotary Centennial Dog is a popular place to socialize your dog just a few miles outside the community, while Bud McKethan Park is where people go for a playground, pavilion picnics and a walking trail. During the warmer months, residents visit Bayport Park Pier on the Gulf of Mexico for fishing, tanning and relaxing. The Suncoast Trail and Tom Van Park, which has baseball, softball, basketball and picnic areas are also nearby.

/neighborhood/burnt-store-marina.description: Burnt Store Marina Homes for Sale Punta Gorda Homes for.

blocks.text: Burnt Store Marina offers a variety of architectural styles from waterfront sprawling estates with docks, large single family homes, condos, courtyard homes, villas and townhomes. Buyers can choose from condos located directly on the golf course and homes fronting canals or homes situated along the exterior wall. The community maintains an active social calendar with walking paths and events ranging from fishing tournaments and farmers markets to themed dinners, trivia nights and shopping expeditions. Residents and visitors also enjoy easy access to art galleries, waterfront dining, live music as well as other attractions that build on southwest Florida’s raw natural beauty.

Part of the community’s appeal lies in its location on Charlotte Harbor, the second largest estuary in Florida, just ten miles from the Gulf of Mexico. The marina is the largest in southwest Florida and one of the largest in the state with deep water, direct access to 525 slips, able to accommodate boats up to 100 feet. Boaters can also enjoy a heated pool with hot tub, laundry, transportation to the golf course and several onsite dining options with stunning views of the marina.

Just minutes from the open water, the community is widely recognized for having some of the best fishing around. Cape Coral is surrounded by the Caloosahatchee River on one side and Matlacha Pass on the other. The estuary waters are protected by a mangrove preserve bordering the Cape, which creates a perfect habitat for all sorts of fish ranging from snook, grouper, tarpon, redfish, cobia, trout, and more. Sailing or boating to the nearby barrier islands of Boca Grande, Useppa, Pine Island, Captiva, and Sanibel provide additional freshwater and saltwater fishing options.
The Burnt Store Marina semi-private 27-hole golf club provides challenges for golfers at all levels and features an onsite instructor and well-equipped pro shop.

Residents of Burnt Store Marina can also take advantage of an onsite tennis and fitness center, multiple dining options and a trading post with groceries, gifts and other sundries. Residents can enjoy a steak and native seafood at the nautical-themed Cass Cay Restaurant & Bar while overlooking the marina or more casual fare at the Linkside Cafe.

Burnt Store Marina offers a variety of architectural styles from waterfront sprawling estates with docks, large single family homes, condos, courtyard homes, villas and townhomes. Buyers can choose from condos located directly on the golf course and homes fronting canals or homes situated along the exterior wall. The community maintains an active social calendar with walking paths and events ranging from fishing tournaments and farmers markets to themed dinners, trivia nights and shopping expeditions. Residents and visitors also enjoy easy access to art galleries, waterfront dining, live music as well as other attractions that build on southwest Florida’s raw natural beauty.

Part of the community’s appeal lies in its location on Charlotte Harbor, the second largest estuary in Florida, just ten miles from the Gulf of Mexico. The marina is the largest in southwest Florida and one of the largest in the state with deep water, direct access to 525 slips, able to accommodate boats up to 100 feet.  Boaters can also enjoy a heated pool with hot tub, laundry, transportation to the golf course and several onsite dining options with stunning views of the marina. 

Just minutes from the open water, the community is widely recognized for having some of the best fishing around. Cape Coral is surrounded by the Caloosahatchee River on one side and Matlacha Pass on the other. The estuary waters are protected by a mangrove preserve bordering the Cape, which creates a perfect habitat for all sorts of fish ranging from snook, grouper, tarpon, redfish, cobia, trout, and more. Sailing or boating to the nearby barrier islands of Boca Grande, Useppa, Pine Island, Captiva, and Sanibel provide additional freshwater and saltwater fishing options.

The Burnt Store Marina semi-private 27-hole golf club provides challenges for golfers at all levels and features an onsite instructor and well-equipped pro shop.

Residents of Burnt Store Marina can also take advantage of an onsite tennis and fitness center, multiple dining options and a trading post with groceries, gifts and other sundries. Residents can enjoy a steak and native seafood at the nautical-themed Cass Cay Restaurant & Bar while overlooking the marina or more casual fare at the Linkside Cafe.

blocks.text: Carrollwood Village is a quiet, comfortable community nestled in the heart of Tampa with boundaries that include Gunn Highway to the south, Sale Mabry Highway to the east, Northdale to the north, and Citrus Park to the west. Carrollwood Village is an unincorporated community in Hillsborough County spread over 11.7 square miles and divided into three residential phases. Each phase is governed by a separate Homeowners Association. In entirety Carrollwood Village contains approximately 3,500 residential homes, townhomes and 1 and 2 story condominiums ranging from 2-6 bedrooms and from 1,000 square feet to 6,021 square feet in living area.

Carrollwood Village has an old charm feel with open spaces, lush tropical landscapes, walking and running trails and amazing parks and recreation facilities. Shopping, dining, entertainment and medical facilities are easily accessible. Residents live only 15 minutes from Tampa International Airport, and 20 minutes from downtown Tampa. Living in Carrollwood Village provides residents the quiet serenity of suburban life. The community is close to International Plaza, I-275 and the Veterans Expressway and only 45 minutes to the beaches. There are also several Hart bus stops scattered along Gunn Highway in the neighborhood. Gunn Highway gives drivers easy access to surrounding areas. The Carrollwood Village Golf and Country Club is a 27-hole golf course.

Carrollwood Village Park provides services ranging from fitness classes to fishing competitions. Amenities include a skatepark, dog park, playground, splash pad, and more providing fun for the whole family. It features picnic shelters, dog park, walking trails, outdoor fitness equipment, skate park and splash pad.

/buyers-faq.title: Real Estate of Florida Has Answers!
/buyers-faq.description: Have a question about buying a home in Treasure Coast? You’re not alone! Here are the answers to frequently asked home buying.

blocks.text: Real Estate of Florida Has Answers!
1. Where Should I Start the Process?

Organize and review your finances. Set a budget and figure out what you will be able to afford for a down payment. Use our handy mortgage calculator to see what a monthly mortgage payment might look like for you.
Start researching the many communities in and around Treasure Coast to see which might be best for you.
If you're a first-time buyer, you might want to get more information first!
2. How Do I Know What to Look for in a Home?
This is up to you! Take some time to decide what's important to you - proximity to amenities, school districts, yard sizes, noise, commute, highway access. This will help you find a neighborhood.

Review home features you might want and those you'll need, from size to style to overall condition. Having a good idea of what you're looking for will save you time and tours of homes that don't meet your criteria.
Browse our Treasure Coast featured listings, or start searching homes by amenities and features.
3. Why Should I Use a Realtor?
A good Realtor can guide you through the financial and legal complexities of the Treasure Coast real estate process.
A local Realtor will be a Treasure Coast expert and can provide vital insight into its neighborhoods and communities.
A Realtor can help you find the right price range for your income and finances and can explain the pros and cons of different types of mortgages.
A Realtor will answer all your questions and guide you through the complicated paperwork.
4. Where and How Can I Get a Loan?
Mortgage loans are typically available through banks, credit unions, private mortgage companies, and government state lenders.

Your Realtor can help connect you with lenders. You can also shop for lenders on your own, making sure you take some time to search around and compare rates. Calling local government agencies can also be a good idea to find out more about programs that might be available to you.
5. What if I Have Bad Credit or No Down Payment?
You might qualify for a federal mortgage program or local home buying assistance program.

The Federal Housing Administration (FHA) helps home buyers by offering insured loans. This means that if the buyer defaults, the lender will still get their money. Insured loans encourage lenders to work with more buyers regardless of their credit or available down payment.
Many state and local governments offer additional programs for buyers who meet various criteria or are buying within individual communities.
The Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) also offers many assistance programs to home buyers.
6. Once I Find My Home, What Will I Have to Pay Up Front?

Earnest money: This is the "security deposit" you pay when you submit your offer to prove to the seller that you are serious. After your offer is accepted, it is applied to your down payment or closing costs.
Down Payment: This is a percentage of the cost of your home. The amount will depend on your loan; government programs can help you decrease this amount.
Closing Costs: These are typically low for buyers and represent the fees associated with paperwork and lender charges.
7. What Other Costs Will I Pay?
Other costs can include utilities, HOA or condo fees, and property taxes - which are typically included in your mortgage payment.
Ask your Realtor about additional fees associated with your particular home, community, or neighborhood.

blocks.text: Monterey on the Lake is a non-gated single family home community in Wellington Florida. Conveniently located off Wellington Trace just south of Forest Hills Boulevard. Monterey on the Lake is within walking distance to shops and dining. Major shopping and entertainment are moments away. The Mall at Wellington Green is just a few miles down the road and offers over 170 stores and restaurants from which to choose. Even closer to home is the world-class International Polo Club, which is home to year-round polo and equestrian events.

Monterey on the Lake is a community of 152 Single Family Homes, located between Forest Hill Boulevard and Southern Boulevard with easy access to I-95 and the Florida Turnpike, in the Village of Wellington. While a majority of the homes in Monterey on the Lake only have one story there are a few that have two stories. The living square footage for the homes in Monterey on the Lake ranges from 1,358 square feet to 2,400 square feet and feature 2-5 bedrooms, 2-3 bathrooms and 2 car garages. The single-family and ranch-style homes are constructed of concrete and stucco with barrel tile roofs. The low HOA fees include maintenance of the common areas. Almost half of the homes in Monterey on the Lake are situated on a canal front lot and while every home is on a zero lot line home site with roughly an 1/8 of an acre there are a few larger home sites that have a 1/4 acre. All of the homes in Monterey on the Lake belong to a homeowners association, which has a very low monthly HOA fee. While there are no amenities within the community, it is in close proximity to area attractions and amenities such as the Wellington Aquatic Center, Equestrian Center, community center, public parks, recreational fields, restaurants, and theaters.

blocks.text: The Equestrian Club is an exquisite guard gated luxury estate home community located in Wellington on the north side of Lake Worth Road just east of South Shore Boulevard. Shopping, dining and entertainment are also close to the Equestrian Club along with all of the Equestrian events that Wellington has to offer.

There are only 138 luxury estate homes in the Equestrian Club. These gorgeous estate homes are situated on 1/3 to 1/2 acre homesites. There are seven semi-custom floor plans offering that feature 5-7 bedrooms and range in size from 3,112 to 7,000 square feet for indoor living space. These one and two story luxury estate homes feature open floorplans, vaulted ceilings and magnificent upgrades throughout. Typically, these estate homes boast backyard swimming pools, summer kitchens, winding driveways, grand foyer entrances, vaulted ceilings, gourmet kitchens, spacious bedrooms, open floor plans, hurricane-resistant glass, and numerous high end appointments. Townhomes within the community offer three bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and nearly 2,000 square feet of indoor living space.

Within the gates of The Equestrian Club, Grand Prix Farms feature custom luxury estate homes that can have private stables and/or farms. This unique section only has 10 spacious home sites ranging from 2.5-5.4 acres. Horses are not a requirement to be a part of this Equestrian Community in Wellington Florida, but they are more than welcome. These opulent homes also have their own stables, wash racks, tack rooms, and riding rings. As the name suggests, the neighborhood is equestrian focused and centered. Amenities include riding trails, tennis courts, fitness facility, playground, open green space and private clubhouse. Residents of the Equestrian Club are within walking distance to the Palm Beach International Equestrian Center, which hosts the Wellington Equestrian Festival and various other arena events and shows. The Wellington Mall offers plenty of high-end stores, restaurants, and a movie theater and the village also offers an amphitheater for live concerts and events.

blocks.text: The Landings at Wellington is a neighborhood of luxury homes in Wellington offering an assortment of beautiful styles and sizes. The homes range from 1,600 square feet to over 8,300 square feet in living area, consisting of several different home styles. The Landings at Wellington is broken down into a few subdivisions.

Lakefield of the Landings at Wellington is comprised of three separate gated communities; Lakefield West, Lakefield North and Lakefield South. All three communities are only a short bike ride or drive away from shopping, dining and entertainment. Lakefield West is a gated Single Family Home Community that offers 207 homes many of which are located on a golf, lake or cul-de-sac lot. Lakefield North is a gated Single Family Home Community that offers 109 homes, which offers many beautiful golf and lake lots throughout. Lakefield South is a gated community that offers 142 Single Family Homes and 56 Patio Homes, which most homes are situated on golf or lake home sites.

The Wellington Aero Club is a private airpark community consisting of 248 homesites. Each homesite sits on approximately one acre each with luxurious custom built estate homes up to 7,585 square feet under air. In the center of the community there is a 4,000 foot lighted runway for use by Aero Club residents. Aviation gas is available at the on-site refueling facility. There are runway, taxi-way and tie-down homesites with some homes even offer their own private hangar. Since the runway is centrally located within the community, runway access is quick and easy. Wellington Aero Club residents not only enjoy the luxury of flying right to their doorstep but also have access to the community clubhouse. The clubhouse features a game room, billiards, and a gathering room adjacent to a fully equipped kitchen that is great for special occasions.

Hidden Landings is a Non-Gated, Pet Friendly townhome community of 60 homes set off the main road and is privately situated in the center of all that Wellington, located off Forest Hill Boulevard just east of Wellington Trace. There are several styles from ranch style homes with clerestory windows and courtyards to 2 story homes with front porches and manicure landscaping. They are 2-3 bedrooms ranging from 1,000 square feet to 1,500 square feet under air and have 2-3 car garages. Many of the homes are overlooking either the lake or the canal that leads into Lake Wellington. This canal is navigable, so you can set sail from your own backyard in your paddle boat or boat with an electric motor. There is a sparkling community pool that overlooks a gorgeous lake view. Shopping of all kinds is found close by as well. The Mall at Wellington Green is just down the street and houses over 170 stores and restaurants. West Palm Beach is only a few miles down I-95, with many fine dining options.

Binks Forest of the Landings is conveniently located on Binks Forest Drive just south of Southern Boulevard drive away from shopping, dining, and entertainment. Binks Forest consists of 583 single-family and estate homes and 90 luxury estate townhomes. There are six sub-developments throughout Binks Forest; Brindlewood, Hidden Creek, Pine Trace, The Preserve, Binks Estates, and Binks Pointe. Click here for more info on Binks Forest.

blocks.text: Located on the east side of Forest Hill Boulevard, just south of Wellington Trace, Tree Tops of Wellington is a quaint single family home community located in the heart of Wellington. Just west of Interstate 441 and Southern Blvd, this inviting neighborhood highlights green spaces, tropical landscaping, and massive evergreens. The neighborhood features a variety of home styles, from spacious single-family homes to elegant townhomes.

The design style of the homes resembles mostly traditional, with a few ranch style elevations with circle driveways and oversized lots with a few homes on a quarter-acre or more. Tree Tops features homes with 3-4 bedrooms and 1,148 square feet to 2,006 square feet of living space and waterfront views. Homes offer one and two-story floorplans with living square footage that ranges from 1,100 square feet to over 2,000 square feet in living area. There are a total of 108 single family homes in Tree Tops and each home features at least 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a 1 car garage. Updated homes feature newer roofs, air-conditioning systems, and hurricane impact windows. Many homes feature a fireplace, fenced yard/patio, vaulted ceilings, marble and hardwood floors, skylights, walk-in closets, pantry, large balconies, and access to the community swimming pool.

Tree Tops also features community amenities, which include a heated pool, clubhouse and a neighborhood park. All of the homes in Tree Tops are part of a homeowners association, which has a monthly HOA fee and includes access to a community pool along with additional services.

Also located in West Palm Beach is City Place, with many fine dining and shopping options. The community is also just a short drive away from world-class equestrian facilities, making it a haven for horse enthusiasts.

blocks.text: Dyer Rd West Palm Beach, FL 33401

El Cid West Palm Beach is the most prestigious historic community in West Palm Beach, located just south of the Downtown area along the Intracoastal Waterway. El Cid is a West Palm Beach iconic community, sought after for its enduring character, approximately 272 upscale homes and unsurpassed location. A distinct characteristic of the El Cid neighborhood is its consistency and flow as you travel down its streets. There is a pattern of very large lots and relatively deep front yard setbacks. The streets themselves are clean, freshly landscaped, and lined with palm trees.

An iconic community combined with its concentration of outstanding period architecture, El Cid is on the west shore of the Intracoastal across from Palm Beach, the closest neighborhood to downtown. The El Cid Historic District is listed on the local, State, and National Register of Historic Places. S. Flagler Drive separates these homes from the Intracoastal Waterway and it also provides a much-used walking, jogging, and biking path along the water's edge. There are six parks within just a few blocks of El Cid, the largest being North Gallery Park adjacent to the Norton Museum of Art. Residents who wish to hit the beaches can travel either north to the Royal Palm Park Bridge or south to the Southern Blvd. causeway. There are also seven fitness centers and two yoga studios within a mile of the El Cid neighborhood.

Spanning Flagler Drive in West Palm Beach, El Cid offers residents some of the most memorable and stunning views of Palm Beach. The charm of El Cid rests in the unique architectural character of the homes, ranging from modern to Mediterranean, Old Florida inspired and charming bungalows blend seamlessly on the manicured streets of the neighborhood. The non-gated neighborhood is free-flowing and filled with tree-lined streets characterized by hundred year old mango trees that tower over the streets, sidewalks, and houses, along with other botanical artifacts like the kapok and banyan trees, antique lamp posts, and a variety of design styles from the Mediterranean to Spanish architecture, all trimmed in flowering bougainvillea. The striking color palette of the homes blends perfectly with its tropical setting. The non-gated neighborhood is free-flowing and filled with tree-lined streets, antique lamp posts, and a variety of design styles from the Mediterranean to Spanish architecture, all trimmed in flowering bougainvillea. Living in Flamingo Park is a unique experience that offers a blend of old and new. The neighborhood's historic homes, lush greenery, and quiet streets make it a tranquil oasis in the heart of bustling West Palm Beach.

The area's historic homes were restored by homeowners in the 1980s, which helped to rejuvenate the area, and now contribute to the neighborhood's unique and charming character. The neighborhood has one of the city's best collection of early craftsman-style bungalows, as well as some modest, Mediterranean restored homes, contemporary estates and luxury townhomes ranging from 1,000 square feet to 3,100 square feet. City Place South Tower offers luxury condo living at the neighborhood's north end.

Living in Grandview Heights offers residents an urban feel and most residents own their homes. Residents with certain two story homes can see the beautiful Atlantic Ocean over the island of Palm Beach from their second floor windows. In Grandview Heights there are a lot of bars, restaurants, coffee shops, and parks. Grandview Heights neighborhood has been restored to a mixed-use, walkable neighborhood with a mix of mostly single family homes, modern townhomes, and apartments. Also located in the neighborhood are two historic churches, several bed and breakfasts, and small local businesses.

Located in the heart of West Palm Beach, Florida, right off Downtown, the Grandview Heights neighborhood is adjacent to many downtown landmarks, including Howard Park that has playing fields, tennis courts, and a dog park, plus walking trails, the Norton Museum of Art, City Place and the Palm Beach County Convention Center. It also has the Kravis Center for the Performing Arts, a sprawling entertainment complex, with numerous stages hosting concerts, dance, and Broadway musicals. 

By taking Interstate 95, residents can reach Delray Beach, Fort Lauderdale and other hotspots along the South Florida coast, HCA Florida JFK North Hospital in 6.5 minutes. They can avoid the interstate completely to reach Palm Beach International Airport, about 3 miles west of Grandview Heights.

The Club at Ibis is an award-winning West Palm Beach country club community with a legendary reputation. Ibis is the world's only private country club community with three outstanding Nicklaus family-designed courses - the Legend, the Heritage, and the Tradition. The club has ample practice facilities for its members including a driving range, pitching and chipping area, and a putting green.

In addition to the three championship golf courses, there are many other sports and activities such as the16 Har-Tru hydro grid tennis courts, four pickleball courts, an innovative 15,000-square-foot fitness center, resort-style pool, lap pool, and a relaxing spa. The clubhouse has a Pro shop along with bar and restaurant with options ranging from casual to fine-dining. There are spaces that can be reserved for members' private events to be catered.

Beaches, boating, fishing, shopping, and cultural opportunities are all within minutes of Ibis. The Gardens Mall offers a wide variety of stores, including Nordstrom, Bloomingdales, and Tiffany & Co. Residents can conveniently enjoy a movie at Downtown at the Gardens or theatre at the Kravis Center. Local cuisine can be sampled at restaurants in nearby Legacy Place or Midtown at the Gardens, while Sailfish Marina offers sunset cruises.Palm Beach International Airport, I-95, and the Florida Turnpike are nearby for easy travel. Within a short drive is the famous island of Palm Beach, the stunning beaches of Singer Island, and West Palm Beach’s historic downtown and waterfront.

blocks.text: The Enclave at Lake Butler Sound

Perfectly placed along the pristine shores of Lake Butler, Lake Butler Sound is spread across 380-acres of Central Florida's most beautiful and breathtaking land. This gorgeous, upscale, guard-gated community allows residents to enjoy a peace and tranquility that feels as if it is hundreds of miles away from civilization, while maintaining close proximity to all of the wonderful attractions Central Florida is famous for. Lake Butler Sound offers some of the finest luxury homes and magnificent community amenities in the area. Amenities include guard-gated community, cartmel gardens and private fishing pier on Lake Butler.

The gorgeous and stately homes offer an elegance and luxury rarely matched, and top-rated schools make Lake Butler Sound perfect for a growing family. Lake Butler Sound offers residents a resort-like setting ranging from luxurious estates to palatial mansions, covering anywhere from 3,200 - 88,000 square feet. These custom-built homes were imagined and created by an elite team of award-winning builders. They feature the highest standards in design, quality, innovation, landscaping, and technology. Every home is unique and adds to the overall character of this immaculate community.

Divided into three beautiful and distinct enclaves, Lake Butler Sound is a home-owners dream. Its unparalleled natural setting has residents feeling tranquil and at peace, while its proximity to all of what Central Florida has to offer enables them constant entertainment. The gorgeous and stately homes offer an elegance and luxury rarely matched, and top-rated schools make Lake Butler Sound perfect for a growing family.
The Enclaves at Lake Butler Sound consist of three unique sections.
The Reserve Section features 10 acres of estate homes and palatial mansions overlooking scenic views from Butler Chain of Lakes.

The Estates Section is adjacent to the natural preserves and set on 3/4 to 1/2 acre ranging from 4,400 to 9,300 square feet in size and are just a short walk from Cartmel Gardens, Lake Butler Sound's formal English garden.
Mediterranean Section features custom homes built on 1/3+ acre with Classical and Mediterranean styles. They range from 3,400-4,400 square feet in size.
Retail shopping centers, restaurant row, and The Mall at Millenia are within 8.5 miles, with Downtown Orlando just 13 miles away.

blocks.text: Golden Bear Club at Keene's Pointe

Keene's Pointe in Windermere, Florida, is a master-planned luxury golf home community situated 16-miles southwest of downtown Orlando and just 5-miles northeast of Disney. This quiet, guard-gated, golf community is situated on the shores of the sought-after Butler Chain of Lakes.

There are the 14 distinct neighborhoods that make up the Keene's Pointe community with the number of lots and homes limited to around 950. Nestled along Lake Tibet-Butler, Lake Burden, the Golden Bear Club, parks, playgrounds, and nature preserves, the neighborhoods possess a variety of home styles and architectural designs. The Golden Bear Club at Keene's Pointe features a Jack Nicholas Signature designed golf course that has become the centerpiece of the prestigious community of Keene's Pointe. This phenomenal private country club is bordered by the Butler Chain of Lakes and features majestic oaks, towering cypress trees, and all types of natural flora. Conveniently located overlooking the pool and recreation area, members can easily move from an indoor workout to a refreshing swim or a quick game of tennis on the adjoining tennis courts. Along with the Pro shop, a world-class tennis facility with four lighted hard courts, with covered seating areas, a fitness center equipped with the latest state of the art weight machines, cardiovascular equipment and free weights, and a resort-style swimming pool with poolside cabanas. The Club also features a massive 24,000 square foot luxurious clubhouse facility offering panoramic views of both the ninth and eighteenth holes. The Pointe 18 Bar and Grille is an inviting setting to enjoy a casual quick bite or an elegant dinner as well as cater for all events with a range of indoor and outdoor function locations.

blocks.text: Let's face it; moving day is no picnic! Packing and moving is never easy, whether you're moving to the other side of town or across the country. Use this essential checklist to help make your move to Treasure Coast as seamless and stress-free as possible!
Don't wait until the last minute! Start packing and planning as soon as possible to alleviate some of the stress.
Start one room at a time and begin to organize and declutter. Set aside anything that can be donated, sold, or thrown away. The less stuff you have, the less you'll have to pack!
Host a yard sale to get rid of any unwanted clothing, furniture, or decor. You can also consider donating any shoes or clothing that are in good condition.
It usually takes a few weeks for the post office to process your change of address and start forwarding your mail, so request it at least two weeks before the move.
Reinforce: Use sturdy, reinforced boxes. And don't be afraid to get friendly with bubble wrap and other packing material for fragile items.
Innovate: Pack dishes, bowls, plates, and other glass objects vertically, rather than flat and stacked. For extra padding, pack glasses and stemware inside socks.
Pack small: Pack heavier items in smaller boxes so they're easier to carry.

Prevent leaks: Remove the tops and cover the openings of soaps, shampoos, and lotions with cling wrap, then twist the caps back on. You can also use cling wrap around dresser drawers or jewelry displays to keep them intact, or around furniture to prevent scratches.

Prepare: Create an "Open Me First" box containing personal items that you will need immediately, such as toilet paper, soap, instant coffee, tools and box cutters, and paper dishes. Make sure it's one of the first things off the moving truck.

Label, label, label! There's nothing worse than trying to unpack a disorganized mess! Make the transition to your new home seamless by carefully organizing and labeling boxes by room so you'll know just where to put them in your new house. (Even better - color code!)
It's not just the packing that's overwhelming - moving day itself can be very stressful if you're not prepared. Here are some tips for a low-stress moving day.

Don't pack your most important essentials and emergency prep items - like first aid supplies, medication, financial records, medical records, IDs, and other important documentation or high-value items. Always keep them with you.
If you make it home before the moving truck, make sure you're prepared with things like a change of clothes, your toiletries, and a phone charger.
Keep your moving foreman's content information with you in case you need to contact your movers for any reason. It's also handy to have your Bill of Loading and shipment registration number with you.
It's much easier to deep-clean your bathrooms and kitchen before they're loaded down with all your stuff (or before you're too tired to clean!). Clean first, unpack second.
Make the seemingly endless process smaller by breaking it down into several smaller projects, and do them in order of importance.
Don't forget to smile... Your new life in your new place just began. Welcome home.

Prevent leaks: Remove the tops and cover the openings of soaps, shampoos, and lotions with cling wrap, then twist the caps back on. You can also use cling wrap around dresser drawers or jewelry displays to keep them intact, or around furniture to prevent scratches.
Prepare: Create an "Open Me First" box containing personal items that you will need immediately, such as toilet paper, soap, instant coffee, tools and box cutters, and paper dishes. Make sure it's one of the first things off the moving truck.
Label, label, label! There's nothing worse than trying to unpack a disorganized mess! Make the transition to your new home seamless by carefully organizing and labeling boxes by room so you'll know just where to put them in your new house. (Even better - color code!)

On Moving Day

It's not just the packing that's overwhelming - moving day itself can be very stressful if you're not prepared. Here are some tips for a low-stress moving day.

Keep important info:

Don't pack your most important essentials and emergency prep items - like first aid supplies, medication, financial records, medical records, IDs, and other important documentation or high-value items. Always keep them with you.

Take an overnight bag:

If you make it home before the moving truck, make sure you're prepared with things like a change of clothes, your toiletries, and a phone charger.

Have phone numbers handy:

Keep your moving foreman's content information with you in case you need to contact your movers for any reason. It's also handy to have your Bill of Loading and shipment registration number with you.

After You Move

Clean first:

It's much easier to deep-clean your bathrooms and kitchen before they're loaded down with all your stuff (or before you're too tired to clean!). Clean first, unpack second.

Unpack by room:

Make the seemingly endless process smaller by breaking it down into several smaller projects, and do them in order of importance.

Enjoy your new home!

Don't forget to smile... Your new life in your new place just began. Welcome home.

blocks.text: Located in the city of North Venice, Toscana Isles offers luxury single-family homes that are elegantly and spaciously designed with stunning features with stunning lake views. While Toscana Isles is located in north Venice, technically the neighborhood is Nokomis. Just one mile east of I-75, off the Laurel Road exit on Toscavilla Blvd, this maintenance free gated community is only minutes away from the white sandy beaches of the Gulf Coast. Toscano Isles is a gated, deed-restricted community of 900 single family homes accessible to I-75 with quick access to Sarasota attractions. There are lots of large lakes with great fishing and kayaking from either their waterfront property or the kayak launching dock behind the community clubhouse. The large waterfront lake lots are spectacular.

The community of Toscana Isles has many floor plans. The Avon and Clifton floor plans are two bedrooms and two baths with 1,641 square feet and 1,816 square feet, respectively. The Pembroke, Edison, Ashbury, Bedford and Easton floor plans have three bedrooms and range from two to four and a half baths, ranging from 1,804 square feet to 3,148 square feet. In addition, the Destin, Camden and Somerset floor plans are four bedrooms with baths ranging from three to four and a half. These floor plans range from 2,368 square feet to 3,461 square feet in living area.

Amenities include clubhouse, a heated resort-style infinity-edge pool, state of the art fitness center, lakefront activities room. tennis and bocce courts, a large fire pit, pool side cabanas, playground, walking paths and a dog park. There is an on site lifestyle director. Toscana Isles offers two large spring fed lakes, one 94 acres and one 55 acres which are connected. Located near Nokomis Beach, waterfront dining, tiki bars, shopping, and some of the best fishing areas are close by.

Toscana Isles is convenient to shopping with the UTC Mall 19.8 mikes away and Costco is 11 miles. Downtown Sarasota is a 20 minute drive and only 10 minutes from downtown Venice. Siesta Key Beach is a 26 minute drive. Toscano Isles is close to Charlotte County Airport, Charlotte Harbor, parks and recreation, Gulf of Mexico Beaches, Fisherman's Village and world renowned golf courses.

blocks.text: Tioga Town Center is an award-winning a master-planned livable community mixed-use center designed to combine urban style with small-town charm with the comfortable style of an old southern town. The Town of Tioga and the Tioga Town Center are a few miles west of Gainesville on Newberry Road. Tioga has welcoming front porches and recessed garages, and are designed to create a sense of Community. Tioga is a mixed-use development located about three miles west of Gainesville in unincorporated Alachua County. As Tioga is carefully planned and developed, twenty percent of the town is reserved for parks and landscaping.

The neighborhood features ample parking, pedestrian-friendly streetscapes and open-air gathering spaces including a Town Square that has an amphitheater with seating and a stage to host concerts, performances and movie nights for the entire family. Boutique shopping, delicious dining, nightlife, community playground encompass the Town of Tioga. Residents live within easy walking distance to the shops and restaurants of Tioga Town Center including Patticakes, Gainesville Health & Fitness, Cilantro Tacos, World of Beer, Maple Street Biscuit Company, and Blue Highway Pizza.

Town of Tioga amenities include a community pool, cabanas, basketball, tennis, and volleyball courts, playgrounds, walkable green space and nature trails, and community garden. The residents enjoy the close-knit neighborhood feel and the chance to participate in regular Farmer's Market and community events including concerts and movie nights at the Tioga Town Center amphitheater.

The neighborhood is located 11 miles from University of Florida and UF Health Shands Hospital. Dudley Farm Historic State Park is within easy driving distance. Tioga is about a 10 minute drive from Gainesville.

blocks.text: Located in Lake Mary, just east of the I-4 and south of HE Thomas Jr. Highway Timacuan is a golf and country community. There are 550 single family estate homes built on over 400 acres of Florida landscape. Timacuan is divided into nine communities including Fairway Hills, Eagle run, Hunters Ridge, Signature Cove, Summerlin, Clubhouse Cove, Hopewell Creek, Lake Dawson, and Stratton Hill. Fairway Hills is the largest community with 219 single family homes. Many of the private residences found within the community were custom designed or semi-custom designed by MI Homes, David Weekley Homes, or Ryland Homes.

This exclusive country club community offers a variety of floor plans for a multiple of buyers, where homes range in size from 1,400 square feet to over 4,000 square feet. Many homes in the community are located on homesites that are a quarter of an acre or larger and have their own private backyard paradise with swimming pools, hot tubs, outdoor kitchens, and covered lanais with beautiful surrounding scenery to look at. One of the highlights of Timacuan Golf and Country Club is the masterfully renovated golf course with practice range, putting green and pro shop. and banquet hall. It is here that major events are hosted along with evening soirees, concerts, and private affairs. The Timacuan Club is semi-private and allows members from the public to become members and play. The community also offers Har Tru tennis courts, a beautiful community swimming pool, and basketball courts. Social activities include cards, dancing, music and trivia. Casual and formal dining are available along with sports bar.
Timacuan Golf and Country Club is located near shopping, dining and medical facilities.

blocks.text: W Torino Parkway Port Saint Lucie, FL 34986

Torino is a desirable single family neighborhood situated in Northwest Port St Lucie in St Lucie West. Torino is comprised of many single family homes and is built around Torino Parkway, a road in a form of a large circle in North of St Lucie Blvd and West of the Turnpike. Torino is known for it’s spacious home sites, nature preserves, green belts and wide open spaces. It is a very quiet residential area with a mix of families, seniors and resort living. The community has wildlife habitat including Sand Crane’s, Rabbits, Turtles, Armadillo’s and more providing a sense of green and natural lifestyle with surrounding beautifully landscaped areas.

There are 4 subdivisions within the Torino area, both gated and non-gated communities. Most of the area is not within a distinct subdivision and does not have a homeowner’s association. Homes in the community range from approximately 1,350 square feet up to 3,000 square feet of living area. Some of the larger homes are located in the Estates of Windy Pines and range up to 4,225 square feet. There is a large lake in the center with lovely waterfront homes, and a beautiful clubhouse and amenities. The community also includes a small townhome section called Villas of Torino.
Winterlakes has 205 single family homes in a non-gated community with lakes, preserve and sidewalks.
Windy Pines is a small planned community of single family homes. Section names include Windy Pines, Windy Pines West and Estates of Windy Pines.

Torino Neighborhood is bordered by I-95 on the west and the Florida Turnpike on the east, making it easily accessible to the Northern cities like Daytona Beach and Orlando or Southern cities such as Palm Beach, Boca Raton and Fort Lauderdale.

Other local attractions include Tradition Field, home of the Mets, in St Lucie West. Just to the South off I-95 is the Town of Tradition at St Lucie West Blvd where you will find more shopping and restaurants. Torino is 15 minutes to US1 and 25 minutes to the Beaches. Crosstown Parkway is a quicker route to get to the East Side of Port St Lucie with the expansion of the east-west corridor as an alternate route. Shopping, restaurants and entertainment are close by with Clover Park home to the New York Mets Spring training.

Tuscany is a luxurious community of 300 single family homes located on the east side of the Florida Turnpike just north of Atlantic Avenue in West Delray Beach. Homes for sale in Tuscany come in a variety of styles to suit your aesthetic and architectural desires. You can choose from one or two stories which offer between three and five bedrooms. There are six different one and two story floor plans in this distinctive community ranging in size from 1,500 square feet to 2,800 living square feet.
Tuscany is organized into two distinct yet equally well-appointed subdivisions : Tuscany North and Tuscany South. Each side of Tuscany has its own separate gated entrance and special amenities.

Tuscany North, an all-ages community, sits on the north side of Atlantic Avenue. The entryway is noted by its lush evergreen shrubberies and multi-tiered fountains. Tuscany North offers three to five-bedroom single family homes just east of the Florida Turnpike exit.

Tuscany's amenities include the indoor hardwood basketball court and elite quality fitness center featuring Cybex Cardio Equipment and a full set of free weights. The Tuscany North pool offers a clubhouse with exercise room, shaded gazebos alongside their open-air lounge chairs, and a special splash area for children to stay cool and have fun. There is a covered playground, basketball court, and top-quality tennis courts that round out Tuscany North's robust complement of healthy & wellness amenities.

Tuscany South resides on the south side of Atlantic Avenue and utilizes the same primary floor plans that Tuscany North offers though through deft color coordination and distinct tropical landscaping, Tuscany South is the perfect pairing to Tuscany North. At the clubhouse, shades of blue are exchanged for shades of green.

Tuscany features a a luxurious swimming pool and event room with a catering kitchen and access to the best restaurants in Delray Beach, aquatic activities, and the best shopping centers in Delray Beach. The Delray beachfront is just a short drive away, and the many major roadways that surround the neighborhood make travel readily available. The private clubhouse offers resort-style amenities for all residents. Enjoy an active lifestyle while working out in the fitness center, playing tennis, or honing your game on the basketball court.

Tuscany is just minutes from the popular destination Delray Marketplace, which features dozens of shops, restaurants, entertainment, as well as the iPic movie theater, bowling alley, and outdoor amphitheater.

blocks.text: Venetian Falls in Venice is a fully gated active adult community with the feel of a luxury resort. It is located in Venice on Center Road, approximately 2 miles east of Jacaranda Blvd. This gated, age-restricted community is filled with great amenities and is situated only ten minutes from sunny Gulf coast beaches. There are attached homes and single-family homes. The attached villas come in two styles duplex homes and garden or quad homes. Villas include many of the same features as the single-family homes but have a shared wall on one or either side. There are 190 single story paired villas range in size from 1,668 square feet to 1,681 square feet and include an extended 8-foot privacy wall beside the covered lanai. Tere are 248 Garden villas, arranged in a row of four single-story homes, are available in 2 bedroom designs and range in size from 1,448 square feet to 1,602 square feet. There are 262 two to three-bedroom, single-family homes in Venetian Falls are ranch style, and come in a range of sizes from 1,730 square feet to 2,544 square feet. Each home features a kitchen nook and separate dining room, a den, an attached two-car garage, a covered lanai.

The activities at Venetian Falls are centered on the spacious resort-style clubhouse. Nearby Venice Beach provides a wide variety of cultural and recreational attractions. The spectacular 16,000 square-foot resort-style clubhouse features a spectacular 16,000 square-foot resort-style clubhouse with spacious billiards and card room, an Internet cafe with computers, arts and crafts room and a meeting room. The Grand Ballroom, complete with a dance floor and catering kitchen, is the ideal location for the community's many parties, dances, and on-site live entertainment. The state-of-art fitness center provides both cardiovascular and strength-training equipment as well as an aerobics studio for classes and yoga sessions. Outdoors activities includes the 9-hole putting green and four bocce ball courts. The resort style pool that includes a whirlpool spa, and a resistance pool. There are walking and biking paths as well as scenic ponds that add a charming touch to this already picturesque community. A full time activities director is on hand.

Tucked away in beautiful Venice, only ten minutes from the beach, Venetian Falls is in a prime location for active adults. Just outside the community, I-75 provides easy access to downtown Venice and Sarasota, where residents can enjoy fine dining, shopping, museums, sporting events and other cultural and recreational attractions. The nearby Sarasota Bradenton International Airport is 25 miles away and provides convenient travel for residents. In addition to all the activities found in Venice and Sarasota, residents can easily make day trips to nearby Tampa and Fort Myers, which are approximately 70 miles away. Venetian Falls is located just 15 minutes and 7.5 miles to area beaches.

Venetian Isles is a distinct waterfront enclave nestled in the highly coveted community of Lighthouse Point. Venetian Isles brings to you opulence and sophistication alongside your own inland waterway overlooking the grand estates of Hillsboro Mile. This exclusive neighborhood boasts a collection of custom estate homes, each exquisitely designed and ranging from 1,500 to well over10,000 square feet of living area. The neighborhood comprises of more than 1000 homes built from the early 1960s to new construction. The estate homes in Venetian Isles range from a unique Italian flair to old-world Florida plantation estate style with wrap-around porches and statuesque columns. The homes are well-appointed with high-end finishes.

A private sanctuary where natural beauty meets architectural elegance, the community is enveloped in lush tropical landscaping, creating a serene oasis for its discerning residents. Unique architectural designs grace the streets, showcasing the individuality and opulence of each home. What truly sets Venetian Isles apart is its outdoor living spaces. Many of these residences boast expansive terraces, complemented by private resort-style pools, outdoor kitchens, and elegant water features, providing an idyllic setting for entertaining. For those with a passion for boating, Venetian Isles is a paradise. A network of canals weaves through the community, offering private dockage for large boats and yachts.

Lighthouse Point, adjacent to the prestigious Hillsboro Mile, stands as a beacon of opulence and tranquility. With eighteen miles of pristine waterways, this quiet, tree-shaded town is the perfect place to unwind. Amenities throughout the city include an array of parks, tennis courts, boat dockage, restaurants, bars, and the beach.

Situated between the livelier locales of Boca Raton and Fort Lauderdale, residents also have access to a wealth of South Florida amenities. Residents of Venetian Isles have the privilege of enjoying the city’s abundant amenities. Tennis courts, public docks, ramps, recreational areas, and swimming pools are just a few of the recreational facilities available. Furthermore, the proximity to a myriad of restaurants, shops, beaches, golf courses, and other attractions.

blocks.text: A vintage neighborhood in a vintage Gulf Coast town, Venice Gardens is a serene and secure community for active older adults and first-time homebuyers. Venice Gardens is not a retirement or 55+ community, and the community has no deed restrictions. A charming community with a vintage, old-Florida feel, Venice Gardens is a beautiful compilation of well-maintained, Florida ranch homes, picturesque lakes, and wildlife at home in their natural habitat. Beautiful renovations grace many of the homes and land is large enough to enjoy entertaining and outdoor activities. Venice Gardens' residential streets curve around a series of glittering ponds, creating cul-de-sacs and providing many residents with waterfront views. Many residents enjoy affordable homes surrounded by a nice tropical garden, and many of them are facing lakes, ponds or canals. You can fish in your backyard when you have a home on the water, or if you own a little fishing or paddle boat you can tour the chain of lakes.
The boundaries of Venice Gardens start with the Tamiami Trail in the west, Jacaranda Boulevard to the east, and Center Road to the north.

There are about 1,900 homes in Venice Gardens with a majority of the homes having beautiful lake or creek views. the neighborhood is comprised of single-family Spanish eclectic and Minimal Traditional ranch-style homes. The older 2 bedrooms, 2 bathroom homes have 900 square feet to 1,500 square feet of living area while the 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom homes are 2,000 square feet in living space.

Located near the South Venice district, Venice Gardens is quietly removed from Venice, Florida's more bustling shopping and business districts, but affords easy access to them. Venice Gardens is close to shopping, dining, medical facilities, entertainment and the white sandy beaches because it is right in the heart of Venice. It takes about 5-10 minutes to get to the beach.

Although this is not a gated community, Venice Gardens is managed under a homeowners association regime supported by very low fees. he HOA funds are used towards maintenance of the swimming pool, clubhouse, playground, gazebos and barbecues, all in a park like setting. For the avid golfer, numerous golf courses are within a two-mile drive. The nearest golf courses, Pelican Point and Venice East, attract retirees, seasonal residents, and avid golf players.

Venice Gardens residents enjoy living close to shopping districts near Jacaranda Boulevard, where you can find a Winn Dixie supermarket, and Tamiami Trail, where you can shop at Lowe’s, Petco, Office Depot, Stein Mart, and other stores.

blocks.text: Victoria Park Road Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301

Established in the 1930s, Victoria park has maintained much of that original charm. With a scattering of modern and traditional Florida-style luxury single family homes, townhomes and condos, the diversity adds to the unique atmosphere. Waterfront paved walkways and palm trees surround the park with a distinctly Floridian aesthetic of pastel stucco and Spanish-style roof tiles. Victoria Park along the canal in the neighborhood includes a lovely gazebo and curved walking pathways.

Water sports, boat tours and water taxis abound along Victoria Park’s eastern border, which aligns with the Intracoastal Waterway’s canal system. Joggers, walkers and dog owners enjoy paths and streets lined with large oaks and palm trees. The Parker, a performing arts theater in Victoria Park, offers an itinerary of events, including live music in genres such as gospel, jazz and symphony. The theater has also hosted Broadway musicals since 1967. The Stonewall National Museum & Archives offers a year-round schedule of public programs, collaborative events and exhibitions. Along the neighborhood’s eastern edge, South Federal Highway, you can choose from popular eateries

Residents who love the outdoors will feel right at home in Holiday Park, located on 90 acres, offers jogging trails, tennis courts, kayaking, fitness equipment and playing fields. Victoria Park also draws water sports enthusiasts with plenty of locations for kayaking and stand-up paddle boarding.

Victoria Park is situated north of Broward Boulevard and south of Sunrise Boulevard, east of Federal Highway to the waterway of the Middle River and the Karen Canal flowing into the Rio Barcelona waterway, which is north of the Las Olas Isles. Victoria Park residents can walk to Las Olas Boulevard shopping, fine dining restaurants and entertainment centers. Victoria Park enjoys the sun, sand and surf of Fort Lauderdale Beach and all that the beach strip has to offer less than one mile away. To the north two miles is the City of Wilton Manors. It is within close proximity to the Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport.

The Village of Golf neighborhood is a hidden gem nestled behind tall hedges and a manned-guard gate offering optimal privacy. Village of Golf is a sprawling estate in the heart in Boynton Beach spread over 400 acres of beautifully landscaped ground that houses 155 residences. Homes in The Village of Golf range widely in square footage, style, and price, but most are vastly spacious and embody an elegant, classic Old Florida feeling. The homes here consist of beautiful single-family homes with large lots ranging from roughly 0.5 acres to 2+ acres and are nicely set back from the road. The Village itself encompasses residential, agricultural, and commercial properties including the Village Square Shopping Center, a conveniently located retail center with an array of restaurants and shops.
The city of Boynton Beach houses 29 parks, 250 acres of golden sandy beaches and conservation land, 8 recreation centers, a marina, and more golf courses.

Village of Golf is close to main highways and roadways and is just 20 minutes from Lake Worth and 15 minutes to Delray Beach. The community is also centrally located between Palm Beach and Miami for casual outings at some of the world’s finest restaurants and establishments.

blocks.text: Village Walk at Lake Nona is an active lifestyle community located just south of Orlando, Florida. It can be found off of Narcoossee Road, between Dowden Road and Laureate Park Drive. Almost all of the homes are located on the water via an intricate network of canals.

Village Walk at Lake Nona is a 489-acre neighborhood within the larger 7,000-acre master-planned Lake Nona community. It is designed around a 26,000 square foot Town Center clubhouse, which is the central hub for community amenities and social activities. Indoor amenities include a state-of-the-art fitness center with cardiovascular and strength-training equipment, library, business center, meeting room, card room, catering kitchen and ballroom for socials. Outdoors, there is friendly competition on the basketball court or six lighted tennis courts. A heated resort-style and lap pool is for cool-down periods in the Florida sunshine. The community also features a gazebo, event lawn, and tot lot. Village Walk even has its own salon, deli, and market, gas station, pet boutique, and day spa, which are all located within walking or biking distance of the Town Center. Residents at Village Walk can also join clubs such as tennis, theme parties, book, bocce, bingo, bunco, cruises, dining out, fitness, poker, and walking.
Lake Nona features lush landscapes, numerous golf courses, and world-class shopping and pristine lakes offer many waterfront activities, such as boating, water-skiing, and fishing.

Village Walk at Lake Nona is a prestigious community of single-family homes, attached villas, and townhomes. Pulte offers a variety of different floor plans in this community, which are designed for low-maintenance living. Single-family homes range from 1,684 square feet to 4,107 square feet. The two attached duplex villas are designed to offer between 1,526 and 1,686 square feet of living space. The Townhome model, the Cayman II, has 1,835 square feet of living space spread across two floors. Association fees for Village Walk at Lake Nona are reasonable and vary only slightly, depending on the style of the home. These fees include all lawn maintenance and watering, cable TV, alarm service monitoring, and access to the Town Center.

Village Walk is conveniently located within the Orlando city limits on the southeast side of the city. With its prime location near major highways like 417 (the Central Florida Greene way) and 528 (the Beachline Expressway), residents are just minutes away from downtown Orlando and other nearby attractions. It is just a short commute to all the world-class shopping, dining and other attractions Orlando has to offer, such as Disney World, Universal, Sea World, and Busch Gardens and is less than a 30-minute drive away from the Atlantic Ocean and the Kennedy Space Station and only a few minutes away from the Orlando International Airport. It is also conveniently close to the Medical City district, which houses many hospitals, medical offices, and research facilities.

/neighborhood/waterlefe-golf-and-river-c.description: Waterlefe Golf and River Club Homes for.

blocks.text: Waterlefe Golf and River Club in Bradenton is unique in its setting and amenities. In addition to weaving its golf links perfectly into a residential community, the Waterlefe community was developed in perfect harmony with the pristine Manatee River adjacent to it. The residential gated community at Waterlefe consists of 621 residences of varying styles and designs, such as condos, townhouses, and estate homes. Condominiums are 1666 square feet in living area while estate homes are about 5000 square feet. Water-based leisure activities are enhanced by the fourteen congregate docks and fifty-nine marina slips in the community’s riverfront. Residents in the neighborhoods enjoy refreshing views of wetland preserves and leisurely strolls on quaint wooden bridges.

Its outstanding amenities and nature preserve views can be best enjoyed in two separate facilities: the Waterlefe Golf Clubhouse and the Waterlefe River Club. For socials and dining, the place to be is the River Club situated in a rise overlooking the Manatee River. This clubhouse boasts an elegant main dining room with superb appointments complemented by a delightful menu of delectable dishes prepared by culinary experts. A private dining area and The Pointe, an area reserved for family occasions, are likewise accessible. In addition, the River Club has a crystal-clear saline swimming pool, measuring more than 2,400 square feet. It also houses a fitness center fully-equipped with 20 pieces of modern exercise equipment. Fitness programs, such as personalized training, yoga, mat Pilates, and water aerobics are offered to members and guests. Casual dining is offered at the Grille Room of the Waterlefe golf clubhouse near the course’s first tee and the practice range.

A semi-private club, Waterlefe membership packages are reasonably priced, and membership fees are at par with the other clubs in the area. The club doesn’t charge an initiation fee as part of a recent marketing promotion campaign. Club membership isn’t required for property owners to access golf playing privileges.

blocks.text: Westchase is located in Northwest Tampa near the Hillsborough/Pinellas county line and is the only community of its stature that can truly boast a location convenient to beaches, business, downtown and Tampa International Airport.

Westchase is a master planned, deed restricted 2,000-plus acre golf course community that is home to 5,000 single family and multi-family homes as well as retail shops, offices, schools, and parks. It is an award-winning community adhering to the highest standards of environmental and architectural planning. Separated into individual villages with beautiful landscaping, Westchase offers something to everyone. From townhomes, villas and condos to luxurious single family homes, Westchase offers home style options ranging from 944 square feet to 4,626 square feet of living area.

Located within Westchase is West Park Village, a 185 acre neighborhood designed to feature homes with front porches and shopping, restaurants and a village center all within walking distance. A charming area designed to look like the neighborhoods of yesterday, West Park Village offers bungalow-style homes featuring detached garages with rear alley access and lots of sidewalks to create a small-town ambience.

The Westchase community boasts hundreds of acres of preserved land, the Westchase Golf Club, an 18-hole public golf course, multiple parks, playgrounds and picnic pavilions, nature trails, a soccer field, sand volleyball court, 2 child care centers plus two Swim and Tennis Centers, fire station, medical offices and a new state-of-the-art library. Each Swim & Tennis Center has its unique attributes but together they offer two community swimming pools which include lap lanes, shallow play areas, two toddler pools, covered shade areas, restrooms, meeting rooms and lit tennis courts.

Westchase is perfectly located within 20-30 minutes of the airport, Westshore Business District and 25-35 minutes to St. Petersburg and the beaches. The West Park Village Town Center, Westchase Town Center and the Publix Supermarket center include retail shops, markets, cafes, banks, restaurants, bars, professional offices, salons, dry cleaners, preschools, coffee shops and gyms.

blocks.text: Wellen Park is a new master planed community located in Sarasota County. The bulk of Wellen Park is incorporated into the City of North Port with the remainder in unincorporated Sarasota County. This expansive 11,000 acre community will swell to 77,000 residents and 22,000 homes. Wellen Park has become a major retirement and relocation destination. It offers an impressive array of single family homes for sale as well as paired villas and condominiums attracting all types of home buyers from growing families to retirees. With seven master-planned communities, Wellen Park offers homes from manor homes to villas. Depending on the style of home and the specific community, you can find properties that boast private swimming pools, covered lanais, and outdoor entertainment spaces. The homes come in a variety of sizes, from 1,500 square foot villas to 4,000 square foot estates. The average home has three bedrooms and bathrooms and every single home is designed with beauty and functionality in mind. The kitchens have sleek and stylish cupboards and countertops, while boasting top-of-the-line amenities.

Wellen Park is comprised of three Districts currently with an additional District planned for the future. The current Districts are West Villages, Downtown, and Playmore. West Villages District consists of the following neighborhoods: Gran Paradiso, Grand Palm, Islandwalk, Oasis, Renaissance, Sarasota National, The Preserve, and Tortuga. Playmore District consists of the following neighborhoods: Avelina, Boca Royale, Gran Place, Solstice, Sunstone, Wysteria, and Wellen Park Golf & Country Club.

Each community has its own vibe, some are sports-oriented and others are nature-oriented. No matter the kind of neighborhood, each and every community has a basic set of amenities to include clubhouse, swimming pool, tennis courts, fitness center, lounge areas, communal kitchen and playground. Other communities in Wellen Park boast extra features, like dog parks, volleyball courts, and nature walks.

There are a mix of amenities, shopping, dining options, and entertainment. In downtown Wellen Park there is a vibrant town center designed with residents centered around an 80-acre lake, providing picturesque views and a serene atmosphere for kayaking and paddleboarding from a floating dock. A 2.8 mile trail surrounds the lake for jogging, cycling, and walking. A large manicured lawn will provide space to relax and for public events. Phase one will feature 38,010 square feet of retail, dining, and office space. The Canoe House Restaurant will offer indoor and outdoor seating, casual dining with spectacular sunset views. Phase two will have 27,000 square feet of retail.

With a variety of unique local boutiques, artwork, and restaurants that showcase the area’s creativity, residents can take advantage of the lush green spaces, trees, boardwalk along the lake, and seating areas that invite you to unwind and relax amidst the peaceful landscape that focuses on health and wellness. The Great Lawn offers ample seating for relaxation, while the 2.8-mile trail encourages you to explore the surroundings and winds its way around lakes and preserves. Hammock Grove is an area dedicated to relaxation with its strategically placed hammocks. There are many eateries located here from casual food trucks to fine dining options.

blocks.text: Whispering Sands is a 25 acre site located and the northern most end of Siesta Key Beach where Big Pass meets the Gulf of Mexico. It is a beautiful residential community located along a 800-foot stretch of pristine, private Siesta Key beach. Residents can walk to the beach for walks, sun tanning, or swim in the Gulf of Mexico. There are 267 units, with each unit having access to a library. Whispering Sands Condominiums is a outstanding 55+ and up community of 2 mid rise condos and villas featuring three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a one-car garage. These homes are located along the white sands of the world-famous Siesta Beach, as the community combines the best of beachside living with low-maintenance homes.

Condos range from approximately 1,137 square feet to 1.666 square feet in living area with 2 to 3 bedrooms and 2 to 3 bathrooms, as well as assigned parking spaces or two car garages.
