blocks.text: Located on Wiles Road just east of Riverside Drive in the heart of Coral Springs, Florida, Whispering Woods, a master planned community, is an oasis of calm and serenity within a magnificent tropical environment. Two 24-hour manned gates lead into a 275-acre enclave with sparkling lakes and mature cypress trees. The community contains 192 custom single family homes characterized as ranch and Mediterranean-influenced on acre lots with seventy percent on water or cul-de-sac. Properties in this gated community, with roving security, offer a selection of custom, estate-sized homes giving you a diverse set of styles and floorplans reflecting the owner’s individuality. Homes in Whispering Woods range in size from 2,800 square feet to 7,821 square feet in living area featuring 5-7 bedrooms.

Many lots are between one and two acres. Glorious long lake water views and amazing sunsets can be seen from almost every vantage point within Whispering Woods. The community is set back off Wiles Road to further assure privacy and tranquility.

The development is located near many schools, parks, golf courses and the Sawgrass Mills, close to shops, restaurants, schools, entertainment, and transport links. In addition, Coral Spring is known for museums, art centers, parks, and more. Nearby there are recreational parks like Paul Barre Memorial Park, Fern Glen Park, and Sandy Ridge Sanctuary. Golf enthusiasts can also enjoy their tee time at the Country Club of Coral Springs, an 8-10 minute drive. The Coral Springs Museum of Art, the Museum of Coral Springs History, and the Coral Springs Center for the Arts are nearby.

/neighborhood/windsor-hills.description: Windsor Hills Homes for Sale Osceola Vacation Homes for.

blocks.text: Windsor Hills consists of attached vacation villas, 4 story condos or single family homes, an embodiment of unparalleled luxury and refined living, located within a gated community closest to Disney World. Fully, furnished, income producing, this can be a great investment to rent out to those vacationing in the area to visit the many attractions Orlando has to offer or it can be a family home. Although homes vary, many include private pools, spa, game room Broadband Wireless Internet access (WIFI), large fully equipped kitchens, living room, family room with Disney themes throughout various rooms.

As soon as you enter the neighborhood you will see the clubhouse, to your right you will see the condos and to your left you will see the town homes. Each individual town home has its own screen porch with side concrete walls. Inside the screen porch are pools roughly the size of a hot tub. In fact every home inside the Windsor Resort Community features a private screened in porch, including a pool and sometimes a hot tub. Further back into the neighborhood and farther up the hill you will find the vacation homes. In all shapes and sizes these great homes offer you a wide variety of choices for your stay. Each house features a master suite with a king or queen sized bed, and depending on the size of house, there will be several guest bedrooms. The large master bathrooms feature separate showers and double sinks.

This luxury 24 hour, guard gated community has just about everything that you would want from a vacation resort. Nestled within the distinguished Windsor community, residents enjoy access to a wealth of resort-style amenities, including a 7,500 square foot clubhouse, large lagoon style pool, two water slides, children's splash area, movie theatre, fitness center, extensive children's playground, well stocked convenience shop, video arcade, games room, putting green, and courts for basketball, tennis and volleyball all on a site in Kissimmee protected by 24 hour security. It is situated right next door to Mystic Dunes golf course and is located just two and a half miles from the main entrance to the Disney parks and offers access to shuttle buses to bring you to and from the resort.

Windsor Hills is ideally situated just one mile south of US-192 and only a 10 minute drive from the I-4, which gives you easy access to all of Orlando's main traveling routes. You will be within minutes of all the essential amenities including banks, gas stations, Walgreens, Wal-Mart, and a variety of shops, diners, bars and restaurants. All Walt Disney World Parks can be reached in just 10-20 minutes and the other attractions such as Universal, SeaWorld and International Drive can be reached in under 25 minutes.

Windstone is a peaceful gated community of 110 homes tucked off of SW Murphy Road and SW Rivers End Way in Palm City just minutes from shopping, restaurants, I-95, and The Florida Turnpike. Formally known as Rivers End, Windstone offers gorgeous views of the nature preserves around almost every estate homes that are situated along the waterfront and offer homesites at least half an acre.

There are one and two story homes, starting with 3 bedrooms and many homes featuring open floor plans, gourmet kitchens and formal dining rooms. The homes range in square footage from 3,700 square feet to over 5,800 square feet of living area with 3-5 bedrooms. The outdoor oasis provides an extra space for relaxation and somewhere to enjoy the Florida sunshine. Amenities vary amongst the homes but may include a screened patio, summer kitchen, a pool, and well-established tropical landscaping for privacy. A few of the homes also have the added benefit of a private dock with access to the water via fixed bridges.

Windstone is close to shopping, dining, and entertainment. There is easy access to the major highways to travel to Stuart, Fort Pierce and the and the Palm Beaches. Located just west of the ocean and surrounded by waterways, Palm City is a great spot for those that love all things water related sports with plenty of open spaces and parks for an outdoor adventure.

blocks.text: Barton Creek Circle Lake Worth, FL 33463

Located in the city of Lake Worth, the gated golf community of Winston Trails features 1,891 single-family homes divided into 20 villages. Housing options include villas and single-family homes ranging in size from 1,300 square feet to 3,600 square feet of living area. All homes within the community with views of the water or the golf course. Winston Trails is a beautiful 24-hour guard gated golf community, with roving security, centrally located on the east side of Jog Road, north of Hypoluxo Road near I-95, the Florida Turnpike and the Palm Beach International Airport. Since Winston Trails takes up almost an entire city block in Lake Worth, there are three gated entrances making it easy for residents to get in and out. While the main gate is located on Jog Road, the other two are on Haverhill and Hypoluxo Road. Also within the gates of Winston Trails is Bay Hill Village, a privately gated sub-development that sits in the center of this golf community.

Residents of the Winston Trails community have a number of amenities, with the centerpiece being an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Joe Lee. This premier semi private club offers a beautifully designed championship course with perfectly manicured fairways and generous landing areas. Additional amenities include a Golf Pro Shop, a pitching and chipping green, a putting green and driving range. The community also boasts 2 resort-style swimming pool, 8 lighted Har-Tru tennis courts, three basketball courts, a state-of-the-art fitness center, 3 playgrounds, a clubhouse and and walking/jogging/cycling paths. Annual Golf and Fitness memberships are available in Winston Trails at an extremely reasonable rate for residents along with non-residents.

Lake Worth is a beautiful part of the Palm beaches surrounded by towns and cities that include West Palm Beach, Lantana and is just 60 miles north of Miami. Residents of Lake Worth can enjoy a wide range of watersports, parks and open spaces, and a great choice of beaches. Shopping choices are seemingly endless with boutique shops in downtown or places like The Gardens Mall or Downtown at the Gardens in Palm Beach Gardens. Winston Trails is also only 10 minutes away from the beautiful beaches, shopping, dining and entertainment.

blocks.text: A richly personable neighborhood of Tampa, Ybor City retains the Cuban, Italian and Spanish influences that remain from its heyday as the hub of Tampa's cigar industry, now reflected in its culture and cuisine. Ybor City is a place where brick-paved streets and wrought iron balconies frame historic buildings that reflect another place in time. Ybor City is a National Historic Landmark District in Tampa, Florida, located just two miles northeast of downtown. It continues to build on its rich past with an eclectic mix of history, heritage, entertainment and excitement. This urban oasis offers historically renovated and newly constructed commercial and residential buildings located on and off Ybor City’s main thoroughfare, 7th Avenue. The district’s commercial corridor offers shopping, museums, restaurants, hotels, and beautiful public parks. Information about guided historic and ghost walking tours.

Ybor’s history, cultural roots and diversity make it one of the most unique neighborhoods in Tampa. Many of the buildings echo the charming brick exteriors of converted cigar factories, in homage to the area's celebrated history as the Cigar Capital of the World. The Ybor City Museum State Park and the historic Columbia Restaurant as well as the entertainment and nightclub scene highlight the iconic landmarks of Ybor City. Based on Ybor City's history, it is also known as the cigar capital of the world. The Ybor City Historic District is located northeast of downtown Tampa and contains nearly a thousand historic resources. Most of the historic buildings and structures were constructed between 1886 and World War I.

Apart from the factories and beyond the 7th Avenue corridor are Ybor City’s public buildings and residences. The largest concentration of historic houses built before World War I and is located between 4th and 6th Avenues and 15th and 22nd Streets. Some of these houses date back to the late 19th century. Most Ybor City residents lived in a single or multi-family home.

blocks.text: 5573 SE Running Oak Circle Stuart, FL 34997

Woodridge is a unique 66 single-family home community surrounded by nature ... yet just minutes from restaurants, shopping, boating, schools and hospitals. The community has oak tree lined streets, where homes whose construction materials, colors and design combine to create attractive and appealing homes that compliment the natural environment. The community pool and cabana are enjoyed year-round and add to the value and enjoyment of living in Woodridge.

Residents enjoy tranquil surroundings in tune with nature and catch sightings of bald eagles, wild turkeys, gopher tortoise, bobcats and many bird species. Adjacent to Woodridge is the 900+ acre Seabranch Preserve State Park. Ancient oceans shaped the physical landscape of this park and provides opportunity to experience several different natural communities in a relatively short distance. Hikers can explore over four miles of trails through these natural communities.

Close by is the St. Lucie Inlet Preserve State Park. This classic Florida barrier island park is accessible only by boat and many residents enjoy the short kayak from the end of Cove Road ... just 1/2 mile away. Enjoy fishing from the pier or a boardwalk takes visitors across mangrove forests and hammocks of live oaks, cabbage palms, paradise trees, and wild limes to the beach. During the summer months, the island is an important nesting area for loggerhead, leatherback and green turtles. They come ashore at night to dig holes in the beach sand where they lay their eggs.

blocks.text: Tucked inside a pocket of Coconut Creek communities, the 24-hour manned and gated Wynmoor condominium in Broward County offers an active 55-plus golf-course lifestyle that's rich in amenities. Wynmoor contains 5,300 condominium apartments that range in size from studio units starting at 550 square feet to 2-bedroom luxury corner units with as much as 1,625 square feet.

One of the most popular features of Wynmoor is the beautiful and activity-packed Clubhouse! With over 50,000 square feet of elegant recreational space, the Clubhouse offers a state-of-the-art fully equipped fitness center, bridge and card rooms, billiards and ping pong, arts and crafts as well as computer and educational opportunities. It is truly an exciting place to enjoy entertainment or sign up for one of the many activities. There are over 100 clubs and organizations to participate in. Outside there is golf on a highly competitive 18-hole course, 12 well maintained tennis courts and swimming. Wynmoor also offers an on-site restaurant, on-site pharmacy, and a Broadway style 962 seat theater. There is all-inclusive bus transportation to take residents to shopping, dining, etc.

With convenient access to both Florida’s Turnpike and I-95, Wynmoor is just a few minutes drive to many of South Florida’s top destinations, entertainment venues, educational and cultural centers, shopping, dining and most importantly, the crystal clear waters of the Atlantic coast beaches, just six miles away. It is Only 6 miles from beautiful beaches and just off the Florida Turnpike.

The Seminole Casino Coconut Creek is a popular entertainment destination that hosts various events, including live music concerts and comedy shows. The Promenade at Coconut Creek is a premier shopping and dining destination, featuring a mix of upscale boutiques, restaurants, and entertainment options.

blocks.text: Hunters Run is a luxury country club gated community nestled into 990 acres of lush South Florida landscape in Boynton Beach. With 23 unique subcommunities, this country club consists of 1,650 homes including single-family homes, attached homes, and condo homes. It is the closest private country club community to downtown Delray Beach and the ocean. Boynton Beach serves up waterfront dining, abundant shopping and lively entertainment.

The condo homes are featured in four distinct neighborhoods and average from 1,315-2,015 square feet. These homes offer two to three bedrooms, two to two-and-a-half bathrooms, and ample carport parking.
The attached homes are offered in eight of the community's neighborhoods and range from 1,531-2,645 square feet and offer two to three bedrooms and bathrooms with attached two-car garages.

The single-family homes of Hunters Run are featured in nine neighborhoods that come in a variety of models. These spacious homes typically range from 1,778-5,281 square feet and include three to four bedrooms, two to four bathrooms, and two-car garages.

Residents also have access to numerous amenities, including three championship golf courses. Homeowners also enjoy the 145,000 square foot clubhouse, with a fitness center, a full-service salon and spa, a golf pro shop, seven dining venues, and a resort-style pool. Homeowners have 20 Har-Tru tennis courts, a tennis pro shop, racquetball courts, business centers, 12 pickleball courts and 5 restaurants. There are three 18-hole championship golf courses, driving ranges, and putting greens.

There are also a variety of attractions in the area, including Henry Morrison Flagler Museum, Sandoway Discovery Center, Norton Museum of Art, South Florida Science Center and Aquarium, and The Palm Beach Museum of Natural History.

Located in the heart of east Boynton Beach, Hunters Run is north of Lake Ida Road and just west of Congress Avenue. Excellent restaurants, shopping centers, museums and parks are nearby. The pristine beaches of Boynton are only a quick drive away.

Hunters Run is about 20 minutes away from Boca Raton and 25 minutes from Palm Beach International Airport. Hunters Run is also close to multiple healthcare providers, such as Delray Medical Center, Wellington Regional Medical Center, Bethesda Health, Holy Cross Hospital, and MD Now Urgent Care.
I-95 is only a few minutes from Hunters Run and the Florida Turnpike is not that much further. Palm Beach International Airport is also within reach.

blocks.text: As one of Tampa's oldest neighborhoods, Hyde Park is high lighted by quaint tree-lined cobblestone streets, where a canopy of towering southern oaks and palm trees shade traditional bungalows. It is a historic neighborhood within the city limits of Tampa and known as Tampa's most fashionable neighborhood, it has the most expensive real estate in town. It is the perfect blend of city living with a neighborhood setting.

Upscale Hyde Park is renowned for its dining and nightlife scene along South Howard Avenue, or SoHo, with relaxed global restaurants, local institution Bern's Steak House, and cocktail bars that attract a young nighttime crowd. Hyde Park Village shopping center offers international chain stores alongside indie boutiques. blocks.text: Imagination Farms is a family-friendly single family home community where children love to play with their friends and let their imaginations run wild. There are 7 different models of homes divided into 4 phases with each phase of Imagination Farms offering a playground area with tot lot and basketball courts. The Imagination Farms community features 415 single family residences with four, five, and six-bedroom floor plans ranging in size from 2,170 square feet to 4,375 square feet of living area with lot sizes in Imagination Farms ranging from .528 acre to 2.15 acres, offering stunning views of sparkling lakes, manicured gardens, green marshes, and wide canals. All but 43 homes are on water. Predominantly one story community, there are only 14 two story homes built in Imagination Farm. Each home has exquisite interior finishes, including granite countertops, tile floors, Roman tubs, crown molding and high ceilings. blocks.text: 11501 El Clair Ranch Rd Boynton Beach, FL 33437

Indian Spring is a senior resort style living golf and country club community located primarily on the south side of Woolbright road, on both sides of El Clair Ranch Rd almost to Piper's Glen Road just east of Jog Rd. It consists of 1,901 homes nestled within 24 neighborhoods. Single-family homes, attached villas, townhomes, and condos can all be found in the community. Some of these neighborhoods have their own outdoor pool and small clubhouse located within their neighborhoods.

While country club membership is not required, if you are interested in paying for a membership, you can join the neighboring Indian Spring Country Club to take advantage of many world-class amenities. While membership is not required to live within the community, it is required to use any of the amenities at Indian Spring Country Club. The club prides itself on first-rate facilities with a 52,000 square feet clubhouse, dining establishments, outstanding social programs, art and craft classes, performances at the Kravis center and the Broward Theatre of the Performing Arts, guided day trips, top live entertainment, gala dinner dances and cocktail hours. Additional amenities feature two championship golf courses, 26 Har-Tru tennis courts, state of the art fitness center, Olympic-size pool, full-service spa, miles of walking and biking trails and a stadium to seat 200 people.

There is a vibrant social scene at Indian Spring Country Club. With a full-time lifestyle director, there are always social clubs, activities, and parties scheduled for club members. Members can relax playing cards, socializing poolside, or on one of the many guided trips to the area's local attractions. The low-maintenance lifestyle in the community provides residents with more time to enjoy all of the world-class amenities offered in the country club. The low monthly homeowner's association fee covers general maintenance of the community grounds as well as exterior maintenance of the homes. It also offers the ability to become a member of the Indian Spring Country Club for social and golf opportunities.

There are various kinds of memberships available at the club: The Full Golf Membership, The Social Membership provides all of the aforementioned amenities except that access to the golf course is more limited and There is also an Executive Golf Membership for those 55 and younger.

Nestled between Highway 95 and the Florida Turnpike, Indian Spring offers easy access to all of the area’s major urban areas, including West Palm Beach, Fort Lauderdale, and Miami, Indian Spring is close to multiple health care facilities, including Bethesda Hospital, JFK Medical Center, and Heartland Health Care Center. It is a 15-minute drive to the beach and a half hour drive to Palm Beach Interational Airport, with the Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International only 45 minutes away.

The residences within this community are situated on long fairways, gorgeous lakes, or lush tropical landscaping, ensuring that every home has an amazing Florida-style view. There are several different home styles to choose from, from condos to estate homes.

blocks.text: Imperial Point is a great family neighborhood of 1470 homes and condominiums, the first of which was built back in 1960. Lush mangroves and palms shade the homes of Imperial Point. Positioned just south of Pompano Beach, this suburban community is enmeshed in the casual South Florida atmosphere of Fort Lauderdale. Imperial Point homes are located on the west side of US1/Federal Highway, between the major east/west arterial roadways of East McNab Road and Commercial Boulevard. The area features a mixture of waterfront and dry lot homes, as well as the popular Broward Health Imperial Point Hospital. Waterfront homes have ocean access with two fixed bridges.

Imperial Point is a thriving community in a wonderful location close to shopping, restaurants, good schools and the beach. It is bordered to the North by McNab Road, to the South by NE 56th Street, on the East by US 1, and on the West by NE 18th Avenue. At the North end of the community is Imperial Point Park with a playground.

Imperial Point homes are conveniently located within walking distance to parks, casual restaurants and shopping. The Broward Center for the Performing Arts, city's Business District and several city parks are nearby. Popular destinations like the Fort Lauderdale Beach, Downtown Fort Lauderdale, Fort Lauderdale/Hollywood International Airport, fine dining, golf courses, top-rated schools and more are only minutes away. I95 and Dixie Highway makes it accessible for an easy commute.

blocks.text: Indian River Plantation is located on the southern end of Hutchinson Island. Tropical Hutchinson Island, bordered by the Atlantic Ocean on the east and the Intracoastal Waterway on the west, provides a breathtaking setting for captivating sunrises and sunsets.First-class amenities are available nearby, from golf, tennis, boating, deep-sea fishing charters, gourmet dining, art galleries, cultural programs, live entertainment as well as top-rated medical care. Historic downtown Stuart is only a 10 minute drive away.

There is a 200 room luxury Marriott hotel with a restaurant and tiki bar & grille. The 18-hole, par-61 golf course, 13 championship tennis courts, and 1700 feet of private beach are meticulously maintained. A 77 slip, full service, deep-water marina gives instant access to some of the world's finest pleasure boating and deep sea fishing.

Plantation Beach Club at Indian River Plantation Resort is staffed by a team of trained, on-site personnel (management, sales, recreation, maintenance, housekeeping and security). The resort is professionally managed by Hilton Grand Vacations Company (HGVC).

BAYVIEW consists of four residential buildings with a total of 128 beautifully appointed condominiums, most with spectacular water and dolphin-watching views. There is also a recreational center which incorporates a clubhouse, fitness room as well as a heated-pool and hot-tub.

BEACHWALK: Beachwalk, built in 1993 consists of 56, 2 bedroom, 2 bath units. All condos in Beachwalk offer a split plan with two master suites each with their own bath. This is a pet-friendly community with some buildings allowing up to 2 large pets.

CLUB VILLAS: Club Villas is a 48-unit condominium built in 1987 and most have views of lakes, golf course or private preserves. The Plantation Club Villas is a four story elevator building and have the convenience of under building parking for residents.

FAIRWAY VILLAS: Fairway Villas is a 32-unit condominium association comprised of both 2 and 4-unit villas. Built in 1978, Fairway Villas consist of 10 smaller one and two story buildings close to the Marriott Resort and full service marina in Indian River Plantation.

INLET VILLAGE: is a 103 unit condominium. Inlet Village consists of three 4 story buildings. Two of which overlook the wide Indian River (Intracoastal Waterway) and the other with sweeping views of lakes and the Indian River Plantation golf course.

LAKESIDE: There are 75 units built in 1980. Sizes range from 1 bedroom, 1 bath units of 596 sq. ft. up to 2 bedrooms, 2 and 1/2 bath units with 1323 sq. ft. of living area. This is a pet-friendly complex that will allow up to two large pets.

PLANTATION HOUSE: The Plantation House was built in 1979 and has 40, 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condos. All units have Ocean Views. There’s an Oceanside pool as well as under building parking and some free standing garages that come with the Plantation House condos. Plantation House has controlled access with a coded elevator and entrances to any of the units.

OCEAN HOUSE: is an 80 unit condo with over 560 feet of private ocean access. Consisting of luxury Condo units of either 2 or 3 spacious bedrooms with lots of amenities. All suites have Ocean views, even the first-floor units, which are in actuality the equivalent of being on the third floor as there are two parking levels for residents to enjoy covered parking.
OCEAN TERRACE: Ocean Terrace is a 32 unit ocean front property with sweeping views of the Atlantic Ocean, 18 hole championship golf course and the Indian River and Intracoastal Waterways.

RIVERBEND: Riverbend is comprised of 91 units within five buildings, each offering 5 distinctive floor plans, a garden courtyard with its heated swimming pool and spa, canopied entertainment pavilion and grille area. Hidden parking under each building enhances the beauty of the natural setting.
RIVERWOOD: 12 smaller two story buildings house 60 spacious condos with a mix of three bedroom - three bath, 2 bedroom - 2 bath, and 1 bedroom - 1 bath units.

RIVER VILLAGE: Built in 1980, there are 64 two bedroom - two bath condos. This is a pet-friendly building. River Village residents enjoy their own community pool for River Village resident’s exclusive use. All ages are welcome and rentals are permitted with a one-month minimum restriction.

TENNIS VILLAS: The Tennis Villas are condos located just off the golf course and surrounded by the Atlantic Ocean to the east and the Indian River (Intracoastal) to the west. There are 92 units built in 1978 and 1979. They are all two bedroom - two bathroom condos.

blocks.text: 3150 S Country Club Dr Inverness, FL 34450

Inverness Golf and Country Club is a suburban golf community situated on Florida's Nature Coast in Citrus County. Located on the Nature Coast of Florida, south of the City of Inverness off U.S. Highway 41, the Inverness Golf and Country Club offers a clubhouse with a restaurant and lounge, a Pro-shop, swimming pool, lighted tennis courts, driving range, and practice putting green. There is also an excellent banquet facility used for various events, including weddings, family reunions, social gatherings, and business meetings. The Inverness Golf and Country Club is a private golf course.

The golf neighborhood of Inverness Golf and Country Club is mostly made up of spacious single-family homes created with various architectural styles by a variety of builders. Golf homes at Inverness are composed of luxury golf estate homes on oversized lots, along with more affordable golf course homes, waterfront homes, apartments, and golf villas. These homes range in size from just 1,080-square feet to over 5,000-square feet of living area. The homes feature 2-5-bedrooms, 2-3.5-bathrooms, a two-car garage, and a golf cart garage. Amenities include clubhouse, heated swimming pools, tennis courts.

This community is conveniently located just minutes away from the unique shops and restaurants of downtown. The hospital, schools, shopping centers, numerous city parks, Withlacoochee State Trail, Interstate 75, and other attractions are only minutes away. Inverness Airport is just a mile south of the city limits, besides the Citrus County Speedways. The Withlacoochee State Trail and The Florida National Scenic Trail, which runs more than 1,400-miles from the Panhandle to the Everglades, are perfect for hikers, bikers, walkers, and runners.

Other parks in and around this golf community include Whispering Pines Park, Fort Cooper State Park, Wallace Brooks Park, and the Henderson Lake Boat Ramps. Inverness is also close to Flying Eagle Preserve, Withlapopka Community Park, and McGregor Smith Scout Reservation.

Islandia I & II are beautiful high-rise condominiums on Hutchinson Island directly overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. Islandia enjoys the reputation of being one of the best managed and maintained condos on the Island and is known for its community of friendly and welcoming residents. Islandia I and II consist of 194 units within the 20-story buildings, each enjoying spectacular views of the ocean and the Intracoastal Waterway. The building amenities include a fully equipped fitness room, sauna, billiards room, and a social room with kitchen facilities where residents enjoy frequent gatherings. Access to the beach is only steps away on a private walkway with fresh-water shower and a fish station. Shared with its sister building Islandia II, residents have the use of two heated 50-foot swimming pools, a hot tub, bar-b-que grilles, and tennis courts. A guard house is manned 24 X 7 at the Islandia entrance and unoccupied units are inspected on a regular basis by the building staff to ensure nothing is amiss while residents are away.

The Islandia community is an active one where all residents are welcome to participate in bridge, yoga, bocce ball, tennis and golf. Monthly maintenance fees include many desirable features and services: AT&T end to end Fiber with U-verse TV (which includes all home HD-DVR), 100mb secure wireless internet, and unlimited local and long-distance phone service.

Islandia, on 60 acres of one of Florida’s most beautiful barrier islands, provides a luxurious environment to meet all the wants and needs of its residents with its unspoiled beaches, tropical scenery and proximity to restaurants, shopping, theaters and golf courses.

blocks.text: Island Estates, is a quiet residential waterfront boating community in beautiful Clearwater. Island Estates is a man-made Island built in late 1960s on 210 acres of land, with over 530 Single Family Homes and 1,500 Condos. The community is a self contained island located between Clearwater Beach and downtown Clearwater. Homes range from 3-6 bedrooms and from 1,557 square feet to 8,548 square feet in living area. Most of the homes have pools, waterfront views and docks, situated on a series of finger islands. Residents can immediately access Clearwater Bay and the Intracoastal Waterway. The Gulf of Mexico is also an easy boat ride away, via Clearwater Pass just south of the subdivision.

Island Estates, has a vast variety of single family homes that can be your waterfront getaway with a wide range of homes at different price points, all with outstanding water views of Clearwater Harbor. Most homes have a boat dock with direct access to the Gulf of Mexico. blocks.text: Jacaranda West is now recognized as a premier golf and country club community that challenges residents with two 18-hole championship courses. Among its amenities, residents enjoy an impressive clubhouse, an active social calendar and a wonderful blend of families, young professionals and active retirees, all partaking in the area's unparalleled lifestyle. there are about 900 homes in Jacaranda West Country Club with residences neatly arranged in enclaves that surround a country club and several lakes. Many of the enclaves feature single-family residences with private swimming pool, but a couple of sections offer low-rise condominiums and villas with superb views of the golf courses and convenient access to I-75 and downtown Venice.

Jacaranda West has many gated communities, each of which has its own distinct personality and amenities. Within each gated community, residents have access to a unique list of activities. Whether based in Heron Lakes, Meadow Run or Lake of the Woods, residents are only a 6-mile drive from historic downtown Venice for all their shopping needs. The streets in Jacaranda West are lined with palm trees, and most of the area’s single-family homes have Spanish influenced detailing as well as ranch-style homes and condos. In the Heron Lakes community there are single-story villas.

Jacaranda Country Club Villas is an active adult community for ages 55 and older. There are 72 two and three-bedroom attached villas ranging in size from 1,184 square feet to 1,749 square feet featuring cathedral ceilings, bright and open floorplans, an enclosed lanai with beautiful golf course views, and an attached two-car garage. Amenities include access to a heated community pool with cabana and maintenance free living.

A country club membership at Jacaranda West grants residents access to all the amenities, from the golf course to the tennis courts and from the clubhouse to the grill room. Families enjoy living close to a county library and a YMCA, and the Venice beaches are within biking distance.

The nearest shopping centers, Jacaranda Commons and Venice Village Shoppes, are anchored by Publix shopping centers and is just a couple of miles away from Jacaranda West via United States Highway 41. A few miles north, Detwiler’s Farm Market is home to locally-sourced produce, an old-fashioned butcher shop and even hand-dipped ice cream. For a wider selection of shops, take a quick drive to historic downtown Venice. Residents of Jacaranda West have prime access to immaculate golf and pristine beaches just 9 miles west of the community and some of the residential sections are located next to a nature preserve.

In Jacaranda West the residents have access to Venice Island which, along with its famous selection of shops and restaurants, is also home to Venice Municipal Airport. The two runways are mainly used for privately owned aircrafts and medical personnel. Interstate 75, will take residents 50 minutes north to the much larger Sarasota Bradenton Airport. Nearby amenities include Venice Museum and Archives, Caspersen and Venice Beaches, Centennial Park and Brohard Paw Park.

/neighborhood/johns-lake-landing.title: John's Lake Landing
/neighborhood/johns-lake-landing.description: John's Lake Landing Homes for Sale Orange County Homes for.

blocks.text: A beautiful gated community conveniently located blocks away from Highway 50 off of Hartle Road, Johns Lake Landing is comprised of one and two story single-family homes consisting of 3-5 bedrooms ranging from 1,758 square feet to 4,889 square feet in living area. This community boasts lakefront homes with some homes overlooking the pristine and sparkling Johns Lake with private boat docks.

Located on the 2,400-acre Johns Lake rated in the top 10 bass fishing lakes in Florida, residents can easily access the pristine waters, making it ideal for boating, bass fishing, and water skiing. The community also provides numerous onsite amenities, including a sparkling pool, large cabana, and a children's playground. Sidewalks and nature trails weave throughout the subdivision providing a scenic backdrop for working out or simply relaxing in nature. Johns Lake Landing is within a quick drive of numerous outdoor recreational opportunities, including the 13-mile South Lake Trail, the 22-mile West Orange Trail, and multiple lakes, ponds, and parks. Golf course is 5 minutes away.

Shopping centers, restaurants, movie theaters, and more are conveniently located near Johns Lake Landings, making daily living easy. This Clermont community is also less than four miles to top-rated South Lake Hospital and enjoys excellent proximity to Downtown Clermont and Winter Garden Village. Children attend top-rated Lake County schools and can participate in various local youth clubs and recreational activities. While Johns Lake residents have several shopping centers to choose from, the area is also home to vast stretches of farmland with shops offering local goods and activities specific to the area including some local honey at the Winter Garden Honey Farm, or head out to Escape with Horses for lessons, birthday parties or team-building activities.

The community is close to SR429, SR 50,the Florida Turnpike and 30 minutes to Orlando's world famous attractions. There is easy access to shopping and entertainment only 20 minutes to downtown Orlando and within close proximity to historic Winter Garden. There is cycling, walking, jogging and skateboarding on the nearby West Orange Trail and less than 3 miles to the the public boat ramp on John's Lake.

blocks.text: Jupiter Country Club offers the luxurious atmosphere of private country club living combined with close proximity to everyday conveniences.

This exclusive community of luxury single family homes and carriage homes by Toll Brothers, Inc. feature various collections with innovative designs and thoughtful attention to detail, with picturesque golf course and/or lake views.

World-class amenities include the new Grand Clubhouse with a soaring open-air rotunda entryway, vaulted ceilings, exposed wood beams, and elegant exterior detailing. Amenities include on-site dining at Cove featuring Tuscan inspired décor and a menu of locally sourced ingredients, lighted bocce ball courts, men’s and women’s locker rooms, and a fully-stocked Golf Shop.

The Sports Club at Jupiter Country Club is a state-of-the-art facility, offering everything needed for fitness and well-being. It features cardiovascular equipment and free weights, men’s and women’s locker rooms, lighted tennis courts, multi-purpose sport court, resort-style pools, casual dining at Cay Cafe, and more.

At Jupiter Country Club, your choices for the day are endless, from enjoying a challenging round of golf on the 18-hole Greg Norman Signature Golf Course, to playing an afternoon tennis match, or relaxing by the pool. The amenities and recreational facilities at Jupiter Country Club truly bring resort-style living to your backyard year-round.

As a Member of Jupiter Country Club, you will enjoy a wide array of amenities and services, as well as establish friendships and business relationships that will last a lifetime in a respectful atmosphere of camaraderie.

Jupiter Country Club completed its much anticipated 23,000-square-foot Grand Clubhouse in May 2014. The Clubhouse includes an expansive main dining room, bar, lounge, and private dining area with panoramic views of the perfectly manicured Golf Course. Clubhouse amenities include Men’s and Women’s locker rooms with flat screen TVs, private shower suites, and an adjoining card room where guests can relax after a round of golf. Additionally, a finely appointed Golf Shop showcases the latest trends in golf equipment and apparel. The Grand Clubhouse features Tuscan-style interiors and exterior with soaring 27-foot open-air rotunda entryway, vaulted ceilings, exposed wood beams, and elegant exterior detailing.

blocks.text: Jupiter Ocean Grande is Jupiter's premier, luxury oceanfront condominium and is comprised of 4 buildings, two on A1A with 18 condominiums per building and two larger buildings with 48 and 54 units. There are a total of 138 units in Jupiter Ocean Grande and several floor plans, each condo features 3 bedrooms ranging in size from 2,000 to 2,760 sq. ft., with open floor plans, 9' ceilings, unbelievable ocean views and offers beautiful Victorian inspired architecture with a South Florida tropical flair. The two direct oceanfront buildings - 131 and 221, are highly sought after for their great views. The units are accessed via a semi-private elevator. Interior décor of these luxury units includes high ceilings, crown molding, granite or other fine stone counters, custom window treatments, central vacuums, and may include upgraded flooring such as marble or hardwoods.

Jupiter Ocean Grande also features a gated entrance, a full-service marina, fine dining, beautiful resort style pool area with16 private cabanas, a spa tub, 2 lighted tennis courts and two clubhouses with a state-of-the-art-fitness center, billiards a kitchen for parties and additional storage. Large dogs are welcome in this condo, and the Jupiter pet-friendly beach is located just across the street.

Jupiter Ocean Grande is in a prime location. In Jupiter, condos are not located directly on the beach but sit across the Beach Road preserving access to the beach for residents. Beach Road is a daily destination for walkers, with and without dogs, groups of cyclists heading north to Jupiter Island or south to Juno, and those just out for a daily stroll to enjoy the views. The stretch of beach is dog-friendly and evenings will find dog lovers bringing their furry friends out to the beach for a romp.

About a mile north you will find restaurants of all types, from sushi to beach-style to steak houses. The famous Maltz Dinner Theater is located in this area, too, so find a great place to live in the Jupiter Ocean Grande.

blocks.text: Jupiter River Estates covers an expansive area with something for every family lifestyle and price point. This assortment of diverse subdivisions offers a wide selection of properties for home buyers with varying tastes, lifestyles, and price points. Houses in this community differ greatly not only in prices and sizes, but also in taxes, as some homes are in Palm Beach County while other homes in Martin County.

Some of the homes are situated in central Jupiter near the North County Aquatic Center and are two and three bedrooms with either one or two baths and are about 1,000 square feet of living space and are located on small creeks that wind through the area like Jones Creek and Sims Creek. A modest sized boat can wind its way out to the Jupiter Inlet from here.

Many of these homes are located along the small tributaries and creeks feeding into the Inlet. These starter homes have access to all of Jupiter’s great public facilities like the Public Library, Town Hall, Jupiter Community Center, North County Aquatic Center, Post Office and Jupiter Medical Center and are just 5 minutes from the family friendly parks like Dubois, Carlin and Jupiter Inlet Park, all of which are located near or at the Inlet and the famous, 150 year old, working Jupiter Lighthouse.

As Jupiter River Estates make its way north through the central part of the Town of Jupiter, the homes get bigger but retain their central location. These homes offer three to six bedrooms and range in size from 1,887 to 6,090 square feet under air. Amenities include boating, private docks, tennis courts, sidewalks, and easy access to shops, restaurants, and I-95

On the north side of the Loxahatchee River and Jupiter Inlet, the homes in Jupiter River Estates become waterfront homes and the floor plans from 3 to 6 bedrooms with four and half baths, private pools, ranging from 2,000 to 5,000 feet of living space of living area. These waterfront homes have to the Intracoastal waterway and Jupiter Inlet, but boat size is limited by the Island Way Bridge in many cases. Jupiter River Estates is a mix of “Old Florida” waterfront homes on the Loxahatchee River and luxurious, brand new estates offering the finest in craftsmanship and decor. Located just South of Jonathan Dickinson State Park, Jupiter River Estates is the serenity of living on the Loxahatchee River. The Loxahatchee riverfront community is actually in Martin County, but the stores and great restaurants of Jupiter and Tequesta are close by.
Amenities include boating, private docks, swimming pools, tennis courts, sidewalks, and easy access to shops, restaurants, and I-95. Resident children attend A-rated public schools.

Nestled on the Intracoastal Waterway just east of the Indiantown Bridge on U.S. Highway 1, these five buildings offer not only an incredible location, but also the very best in amenities.

Amenities in all the buildings consist of covered garage parking, marina dock, up to a 65-foot boat slip, community pools, hot tubs, outdoor grilling, doorman, fitness & exercise center, social and community gathering rooms, movie theatre, pool table, landscaping, and exterior building insurance. blocks.text: Located inconspicuously on the west side of town in North Central Coral Springs, the Kensington neighborhood is the picture of a South Florida family oriented suburban community. It’s subdivisions include Chelsea, Kensington Classics, Kensington Commons, Kensington Gardens, Kensington Glen, Kensington Green, Knightsbridge, Parkwood, Sanctuary and Vanderbilt Estates.

There are Sprawling Spanish-style ranch homes that feature open floor plans and are situated on big lots shaded by palm trees and ringed by canals, with practically all necessities within easy reach. There are smaller one and two story 3 bedroom homes on smaller 1/4 to over 1/3 acre, and up to 5 bedroom mansions.

The neighborhood is freckled with gated communities, separated from the main cul-de-sacs by canals. Two scenic canals run through Kensington, and residents can enjoy the outdoors at Paul Britton Park and the larger North Community Park. Paul Britton Park features a central playground, with other amenities such as picnic tables, a basketball court, grills and a rentable pavilion perfect for weekend cookouts. North Community Park offers basketball and sand volleyball courts, soccer and football fields, baseball diamonds and tennis courts. The park also includes a picnic area and a mile-long paved walking trail that winds along the banks of the canal and around a pond bedecked with a sparkling fountain.
At The Shoppes at Heron Lakes, located directly in the neighborhood, patrons can work out at LA Fitness, Healthy Delights Cafe or enjoy a meal at Lefty’s Tavern and Grill.

Kensington sits isolated from the rest of Coral Springs, yet is merely 9 miles from Butterfly World, a vibrant botanical garden filled with birds and butterflies. Locals are also a quick 20-mile drive to the beach. Fort Lauderdale, where residents can stroll the river walk or visit the Museum of Science and Discovery, is 25 miles away. Residents of Kensington enjoy easy access to Sawgrass Expressway, connecting them to Florida’s Turnpike and Interstate 95. The Sawgrass Expressway also runs south along the Everglades to Interstate 595, a palm-lined scenic route to Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport which is 30 miles away.

blocks.text: A relaxed suburb on the north side of Pompano Beach, Kendall Green is in a great position to reap the benefits of Pompano Beach's increasing popularity without getting too crowded by the traffic and commercialization that comes with the city's growth. Kendall Green is comprised primarily of one story single family homes with some Traditional architecture with an occasional midcentury modern feel. Most of the homes are 3 bedrooms but there are some larger homes as well. Many of these homes have been renovated.

The neighborhood is 15 minutes from the beach where they offer yoga classes on the beach, and central to all major highways, including east of Interstate 95 and North Dixie Highway, west of the Pompano Beach Airport and within close proximity to Broward Health North. A protected area featuring one of South Florida's rarest habitats, Crystal Lake Sand Pine Scrub spans 24.2 acres on Kendall Green's north side, with a trail loop perfect for an evening or morning walk.

Shopping is close by with commercial areas surrounding the neighborhood with large grocery stores such as Seabra and Costco. There are also smaller, locally owned shops in Kendall Green, including Christine Grocery Store, that are great for grabbing something quick on the way home. Plenty of local and chain eateries surround the area, too, with the Breakfast Club proving to be a popular neighborhood staple that serves breakfast and brunch seven days a week. Down the road, another community fave, Feijão com Arroz Steakhouse that serves no-frills, authentic Brazilian cuisine. There are new restaurants on Atlantic Boulevard and A1A as well.
In the growing city of Pompano Beach, Kendall Green offers a competitive price point for homebuyers seeking a suburban lifestyle in a central, subtropical location.

blocks.text: Knollwood is a gated, single family home community of 148 homes located between Hypoluxo Road and Gateway Boulevard, on the west side of Lawrence Road in Boynton Beach, Florida. Knollwood is a neighborhood perfectly located near natural parks and shopping in Boynton Beach. The homes range in size from 1,383 to 3,106 square feet with 3 to 4 bedrooms and open, spacious layouts and lush green yards.

The Knollwood Community clubhouse is a private facility that offers a wide range of activities for residents. All residents have access to great amenities such as a fitness center, resort-style heated pool with cabana baths and covered area, children’s play area, and picnic area with BBQ.

Knollwood is only a short drive from the beach and other local attractions. Just west of the development, residence can explore the natural beauty of the Loxahatchee National Wildlife Refuge, while to the east residents are less than 20 minutes away from the Atlantic Ocean. This community is conveniently located three miles from the Boynton Beach Mall, local dining and shopping areas as well as nearby golf courses like the Indian Springs Golf Club, Pine Tree Golf Club and The Links at Boynton Beach Golf.

Jaycee Park is only ten minutes away, where you will find a mangrove nature preserve with a boardwalk that looks out onto the Intracoastal. Oceanfront Park is 2.5-miles away, where there are fitness areas, covered pavilions and cabanas that you can reserve to watch the sunset.

Knollwood is not far from major roadways, such as Interstate 95 and Florida Turnpike. This makes it even easier to travel throughout the surrounding areas such as West Palm Beach and Delray Beach. It is located in the Central Palm Beach County area, only 15 minutes from the beach and Palm Beach International Airport. Residents will be less than 40 minutes from the Fort Lauderdale International Airport.

blocks.text: Kings Gate is a gated, low-maintenance active adult community situated in Port Charlotte, Florida. It is located one mile west of I-75 on Kings Highway, ten minutes away from a shopping mall and attractions. The area is less congested than other coastal areas in Florida, but close enough to modern conveniences and beautiful beaches along the Gulf Coast.
There are 650 attached and single family homes, ranging between 1397 and 270 villas, ranging between 1395-1709 square feet. The golf villas are attached homes and range between 1393-1705 square feet.

Kings Gate in Port Charlotte has wonderful amenities for resort-style living, including an 18-hole executive golf course with private and clinic golf lessons, and a putting green. The 30,000 square-foot clubhouse in Kings Gate features a fitness center equipped with cardiovascular and weight-training machines and hosts a variety of exercise classes, such as yoga, Zumba and other fitness classes. There are also rooms for cards, and billiards, a library and a grand ballroom and theater for a variety of year-round social events. Outdoors, a large heated pool with a spa allows for healthy, low-impact exercise, while a large patio and cabanas, two lighted clay tennis courts, two bocce ball courts, and four shuffleboard courts, a lawn bowling area and walking and biking trails. Many scheduled events encourage participation like cruises, parties, and dances. Kings Gate s full-time activities director organizes a wide variety of social events.

Kings Gate is within minutes of three major hospitals and plenty of major attractions, shopping options and easy access to pristine gulf beaches. Charlotte County, Fort Myers, and Sarasota offer lots of cultural attractions and recreational activities. Some of Charlotte County s noteworthy attractions are Charlotte Speedway, Charlotte Sports Complex, the Charlotte Performing Arts Center, and the Octagon Wildlife Sanctuary.

/neighborhood/Kings-Isle.title: Kings Isle
/neighborhood/Kings-Isle.description: Kings Isle Capri Granada Lombardi Madeira San Marino Tuscany Venice Port Saint Lucie St. Lucie West Florida MLS real estate search For sale St. Lucie.

blocks.text: 100 NW Kings Isle Blvd Port St. Lucie, FL 34986

Kings Isle in St. Lucie West is an active adult neighborhood with a 55+ age restriction. Built by Lennar in the early 90’s this community of 987 homes offers two types of properties: detached single family homes with one or two car garages or attached villa-style homes.

There are seven Isles within Kings Isle that are sub-associations of the master. Isle names are Capri, Granada, Lombardy, Madeira, San Marino, Tuscany, and Venice – each have their own distinct aesthetic appeal.

Built with concrete block construction the single family properties range from 1,100 to 2,100 sq-ft with an average of around 1,700 sq-ft of living space. These units have either a one or two car garage and owners are required to take care of all exterior maintenance (except for the Isle of Tuscany where homes are painted by the association on a predetermined schedule).

The Villa homes are also concrete block construction and are referred to as Courtyard residences. Averaging about seven to ten units per courtyard the homes are attached in a U-shape pattern around a community fountain, park benches, and lush landscaping. Living space ranges from 1,000 to 1,500 square feet with the most common model around 1,100 square feet. The courtyard units do not have a garage but are assigned parking spaces in a parking lot. Some residents own a carport over their assigned space or one could be erected for around $2000. The Isles of Lombardy (Lombardy Drive) and Venice (San Remo Circle) are home to the Courtyard residences. Owners of Courtyard units are required to maintain their own home owner’s insurance but the association cares for the exterior painting and landscaping.

The Royal Club is a 15,000 square foot clubhouse hosting over 30 active clubs and providing facilities such as a game room, library, ballroom, fitness center, card tables, and meeting rooms. Relax by the pool that also includes a section for laps. You’ll also find a jacuzzi by the pool as well as ample shaded seating. The iconic “beach” at Kings Isle can be seen from St. Lucie West Blvd. Other outdoor activities include tennis courts, bocce ball, shuffleboard, and horse shoe pits.

Home owner’s dues range from $260 – 290 a month depending on the Isle sub-association. Dues cover basic cable, all exterior lawn care, an on-site activities director, manned guard gate, and use of the clubhouse facilities.
There are restrictions for pets: 1 dog up to 30 pounds or 2 dogs up to 40 pounds combined.

blocks.text: A 300-acre wooded enclave on the shores of East Lake Toho is the setting for Kissimmee Bay Country Club’s elegant golf homes and premier recreational amenities. The tree-lined streets winding throughout the neighborhood are professionally manicured, giving all who enter the true feeling of living in a tropical paradise.

Kissimmee Bay homes offer from two to seven-bedroom floor plans and range from 1500 to over 7200 square feet with single family homes and Monaco Bay's attached villas with multi car garages or designated parking spaces. Homes feature both contemporary and custom architectural designs, some newly built estates and townhomes offering golf views and water views with mature, lush landscaping.

Located next to one of the best freshwater lakes in Central Florida, residents enjoy boating, fishing, or skiing right there. As a lakeside waterfront community, homeowners have the advantage of launching their boats at the community’s private boat ramp and can fish, ski, and more. The sports-minded can join a team and play on the neighborhood’s basketball and tennis courts or become members of the community’s premier 18-hole golf course. Children attend the best of Osceola County Public Schools, and their parents can get them to any of Orlando’s world-famous theme parks in minutes. Neighbors also enjoy Old Town located in downtown Kissimmee which offers fun family activities all year long and offers hundreds of shopping and dining options near home,

Kissimmee Bay Country Club has a public 18-hole golf course with a clubhouse featuring a bar and grille restaurant, pro shop and the Langly Golf Museum. Carved out of natural Florida landscape, the golf course at semi-private. Kissimmee Bay is a favorite among golfers in the Orlando area. The country club offers dining with lunch, dinner and features various activities including trivia night, karaoke night and Taco Tuesdays.

blocks.text: Located in the heart of Stuart, Kingswood is a 55+ community consisting of of 444 condominiums that were built from 1970 till 1995. There are various floor plans and sizes ranging from 2 Bedroom, 2 Bathroom condos with 1,236 sq. ft. of the living area down to 1 Bedroom, 1 bathroom condos with 691 sq. ft. of living area.

Most of Kingswood’s buildings are two stories with condos on each floor. There are three newer 4 story buildings that have elevators and offer units with views of the Saint Lucie River. The Kingswood condo community is separated into three phases. Each one has a separate property management company and HOA fee structure. Phase 1 and 3 each have one pool, clubhouse and shuffleboard courts along with public barbecue grills. Phase 2 has the same amenities but with two pools and clubhouses.

As of June 2018, the HOA fees vary from $250.00 up to $400.00 per month depending on the size and location of the condo. The fees cover the recreation area, building insurance, water, sewer, trash and pest control as well as basic cable TV.

blocks.text: Just north of Orlando’s iconic lake is the historic neighborhood of Lake Eola Heights with 1,101 homes. As a designated historic district, Lake Eola Heights is one of downtown Orlando’s oldest and most architecturally diverse, predominantly residential neighborhoods. There are shady, tree-lined streets with a mix of Craftsman, Mediterranean Revival, Colonial Revival, and frame vernacular residences that blend with Art Deco and traditional homes, as well as established multi story condominiums. Historic brick streets crisscross the community, fringed by wide sidewalks and elegant homes. Homebuyers also have a range of townhomes and multi-story condominium complexes featuring in-house fitness centers and views of Lake Eola. Homes range from 1-5 bedrooms and from 799 square feet to 2,879 square feet in living area.

Residents can easily walk to nearby parks, commercial districts and Orlando’s Central Business District. Lake Eola Park features walking and cycling paths, and hosts concerts and plays at the Walt Disney Amphitheater. The park's lake has iconic swan-shaped paddle boats, a tribute to the real-life feathered residents. In the neighborhood's leafy historic district, brick-paved streets are lined with 1800s farmhouses, cottages and neoclassical churches. Lake Eola Park hosts a bevy of special events out of the Walt Disney Amphitheater and features an iconic concrete fountain, swan-shaped paddleboats available to rent and a paved walkway encircling the lake. East down Amelia Street is the Orlando YMCA, home to outdoor pools and indoor facilities with gym equipment and daycare programs for local kids. To the north are the Gaston Edwards and Lake Ivanhoe Parks, both offering opportunities to cast out fishing lines and soak up lake views while walking its trails.

Local markets and delis are just a short walk down the street. Eola General Store is a local market and deli offering a range of bottled wines, hot beverages, sandwiches, cheese and charcuterie boards. Chic commercial districts like Thorton Park are just across the street from Lake Eola.

Lake Eola is the center of Downtown Orlando. They have a drone show on Christmas and craft fairs on weekends. Performing arts venues like the Abbey and the Mezz host concerts and stage musical readings and can be rented for weddings or private parties. Less than a mile away is the Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts, which hosts touring Broadway productions annually. The Central Business District is a walkable half a mile from most area homes. Along with that walkability, neighbors are a short distance from major freeways like the I-4 Express and the East-West Expressway. Orlando International Airport is 26 minutes away.

There are shady, tree-lined streets with a mix of Craftsman, Mediterranean Revival, Colonial Revival, and frame vernacular residences that blend with Art Deco and traditional homes, as well as established multi story condominiums. Historic brick streets crisscross the community, fringed by wide sidewalks and elegant homes. Homebuyers also have a range of townhomes and multi-story condominium complexes featuring in-house fitness centers and views of Lake Eola. Homes range from 1-5 bedrooms and from 799 square feet to 2,879 square feet in living area.

Residents can easily walk to nearby parks, commercial districts and Orlando’s Central Business District. Lake Eola Park features walking and cycling paths, and hosts concerts and plays at the Walt Disney Amphitheater. The park's lake has iconic swan-shaped paddle boats, a tribute to the real-life feathered residents. In the neighborhood's leafy historic district, brick-paved streets are lined with 1800s farmhouses, cottages and neoclassical churches. Lake Eola Park hosts a bevy of special events out of the Walt Disney Amphitheater and features an iconic concrete fountain, swan-shaped paddleboats available to rent and a paved walkway encircling the lake. East down Amelia Street is the Orlando YMCA, home to outdoor pools and indoor facilities with gym equipment and daycare programs for local kids. To the north are the Gaston Edwards and Lake Ivanhoe Parks, both offering opportunities to cast out fishing lines and soak up lake views while walking its trails.

Local markets and delis are just a short walk down the street. Eola General Store is a local market and deli offering a range of bottled wines, hot beverages, sandwiches, cheese and charcuterie boards. Chic commercial districts like Thorton Park are just across the street from Lake Eola. 

Lake Eola is the center of Downtown Orlando. They have a drone show on Christmas and craft fairs on weekends. Performing arts venues like the Abbey and the Mezz host concerts and stage musical readings and can be rented for weddings or private parties. Less than a mile away is the Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts, which hosts touring Broadway productions annually. The Central Business District is a walkable half a mile from most area homes. Along with that walkability, neighbors are a short distance from major freeways like the I-4 Express and the East-West Expressway. Orlando International Airport is 26 minutes away.

Other common facilities for residents include a state-of-the-art gym with fitness director, 8 lighted Har-Tru tennis courts, 4 pickleball courts, and spin studio. The new clubhouse offers elegant indoor dining. Besides golf, Lakewood National residents enjoy proximity to the 22 mixed-use fields of the Premier Sports Campus ideal for rugby, ultimate Frisbee, soccer and football

The community is also convenient to commercial establishments and life and leisure centers. The nearest amongst these are at the junction of Lorraine Road and State Road 70 just a short distance west of Lakewood National. The Main Street of Lakewood Ranch along with the Mall at University Town Center are easily accessible with a short trip south from this community. Lakewood National Golf Club is just minutes from I-75, which makes for a quick commute to Sarasota and the famous Gulf coast beaches and Sarasota Bradenton International Airport.

blocks.text: Las Olas Boulevard Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301

Las Olas is one of the most exclusive and affluent neighborhoods in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. It is nestled on scenic Finger Isles on grand canals. This area is famous for its breathtaking waterfront views, luxurious lifestyle, and world-class amenities. Las Olas is a unique and diverse neighborhood that offers something for everyone. With deep water dockage and wide canals, Las Olas Isles homes are a boater’s dream and are highly sought after by buyers looking for an exclusive, luxury property with stunning architecture and state-of-the-art features. It's an ideal location for those who want to live near the water and enjoy an active lifestyle, with easy access to boating, fishing, and water sports. There is something for everyone, from stunning waterfront mansions to chic downtown condos. The neighborhood offers a mix of new and old construction, with properties ranging from classic Mediterranean-style villas to modern, minimalist homes.

Las Olas offers a unique and vibrant lifestyle from upscale dining to world-class shopping where residents can enjoy luxury shopping, dining, and culture. The neighborhood is home to some of the city's best restaurants, bars, art galleries and nightclubs. You can enjoy a relaxing day at the beach or indulge in a spa treatment at one of the many luxury spas. Stretching from the beach over the Intracoastal Waterway to the main area and featuring endless eclectic shopping and dining options, Las Olas Boulevard provides old-world charm, with Mediterranean architecture, palm-tree lined streets, old-fashioned lamp posts and twinkling lights strewn about the black olive trees.

Las Olas is home to over 30 al fresco dining options, several world class museums and major art galleries, over 70 shops guaranteed to meet your every want and need, and spectacular Las Olas houses and yachts both for sale and for rent.

blocks.text: Bridgeport Bay Circle Mount Dora, FL 32757

Lakes of Mount Dora is a spectacular waterfront 55 active adult gated community located minutes from downtown historic Mount Dora in the heart of Central Florida and less than 40 minutes from the Orlando Airport and the attractions. The Mount Dora community features man-made lakes, covering 127 acres, and naturally beautiful scenery combining Southern hospitality with small town charm while still being in proximity to all the region has to offer from small, charming towns to large metropolitan centers. The Lakes of Mount Dora is fully gated with No CDDs and low HOA fees. Nearly 70% of the 950 homesites are located on 178 acres of lakes. Spacious single-family floor plans range from 1,263 square feet to over 3,700 square feet. These single-family homes feature two to four bedrooms, two to four bathrooms, and two to three-car garages.

The 18,000 square foot clubhouse features a game room, arts and crafts room, card room, state of the art fitness center, locker rooms, library, billiard room, fitness trail, swimming pool and hot tub. Outside the Island Club is an outdoor resort-style pool with lap lanes and a hot tub. There are also plenty of miles of walking trails within the beautiful community as well as a fitness trail with exercise stations that provide residents with an exciting way to stay active along their strolls. A chain of lakes and islands is readily accessible for boating, fishing, and other recreational activities on the water. Residents can use small electric motor boats, paddle boats and canoes to travel around the community. Lakes of Mount Dora offer a lifestyle catered around the needs of today's active adult buyers that enhances their social calendars with plenty of fun-filled activities and clubs.

Mount Dora is commonly referred to as the New England of the South with its quaint downtown that is renowned for its rich culture and exciting shopping and dining outlets. Mount Dora's central location provides convenient access to the attractions of Orlando and the Atlantic coastal beaches. The Gulf of Mexico is only 45 miles west and the Atlantic coast is 90 miles east. Disney World, Universal Studios, the Kennedy Space Center and Sea World are accessible in less than 90 minutes.

/neighborhood/lantana-heights.title: Lantana Heights
/neighborhood/lantana-heights.description: Lantana Heights Homes for Sale Real Estate of Florida Homes for.

blocks.text: Boasting a prime location just minutes from the beach, shops, boat ramp, and Interstate 95, Lantana Heights is made up of 844 single-family homes located in the heart of it all between the I-95 and the water. Square footage ranges anywhere from 1,152 to 2,282. With no HOA fees you can park your boat or RV at your property and the sizeable driveways allow for this. Lantana Heights is made up of single-family Colonial Revival, contemporary and side-gabled ranch-style homes, many of which have sizable driveways to allow you to park a boat.

There are a couple of parks and open spaces nearby with space to spend time with the family. Maddock Park features a full basketball court, skateboard park and dog park. Howard Park features a baseball field, BBQ’s, picnic areas, and playground equipment. Nature enthusiasts can enjoy the trails of the Lantana Scrub Natural Area, while maritime lovers have quick access to ocean waves and the sea breeze. Lantana Sports Complex is a hub for athletes, with three baseball fields and two soccer fields. And the Way Martial Arts offers fitness programs for beginners and advanced competitors; the center teaches Brazilian jiu-jitsu and kickboxing.

A coastal town, Lantana features waterfront restaurants to enjoy lunch and dinner, an array of shops and of course the 8-acre beach. Lantana Heights retains the charm of its origins as an old fishing village. Lantana Scrub Natural Area is just 32.5 acres but it offers a remnant of the Atlantic coastal scrub that once stretched from Miami-Dade County to St. Augustine. The area contains two habitats: scrub and scrubby flatlands. Sand pine and saw palmetto are found throughout, along with Florida rosemary, powder-puff lichen and hog plum. Escape the noise of the outside world along its trails, and you may even spot gopher tortoises, golden-winged skimmers, eastern phoebes or osprey.

With close proximity to major cities Lantana is a great place to call home. West Palm Beach is less than 20 minutes and just slightly further afield at 30 minutes you are in Palm Beach Gardens, both cities with an array of arts, entertainment and culture.

blocks.text: Laurel Oak Homes are located in the Laurel Oak Estates and Country Club which is a prestigious 24 hour guard-gated golf course community of over 813 acres located east of I-75 off of Bee Ridge Road in Sarasota, Florida. Laurel Oak Estates is home to 346 single family homes and 60 maintenance free villas ranging in size from 2200 square foot villa to 10000 square foot estate home. Encompassing hundreds of homes and surrounded by lush tropical scenery, Laurel Oak welcomes you to a luxurious lifestyle in a picturesque paradise. Many of these Laurel Oak Homes have been built on large half acre lots and have views of lakes and or the championship golf courses. Laurel Oak will provide scenic views of the lakes, wetland preserves and the lush green golf courses.

Enjoy country club living with access to endless amenities to pique your interests. Laurel Oak is a popular community for families and empty nesters where membership is available but not required. In addition to golf, members have access to a wide array of amenities including a 45,000 square foot clubhouse with formal and informal dining options including three restaurants: The Members’ Lounge, The Garden Room, and The Laurel Room, each offering a different atmosphere, state-of-the-art tennis facilities including 12 Har-Tru tennis courts, Pickleball, and a Swimming Center featuring a six-lane junior Olympic swimming pool. The club also boasts a selection of social events. An environment beneficial for families, several children's camps take place during the summer months.

Members of Laurel Oak Country Club enjoy reciprocal privileges with the Bird Key Yacht Club. The Laurel Oak Country Club is a private member-owned club that features two signature18-hole signature championship courses over lush landscape and rolling green fairways.

Laurel Oak is an hour south of Tampa, Sarasota enjoys a tropical climate year-round while nestled against the ambiance of the Gulf waters. Sarasota is a city infused with countless cultural offerings to include a vibrant arts scene, eclectic shopping and dining, as well as a plethora of art galleries and performing arts venues.

blocks.text: Lauderdale Isles is a waterfront single-family neighborhood located in southern section of Fort Lauderdale, Florida. This non gated neighborhood is situated east of US 441, between Riverland Road and the South Fork New River waterway. Lauderdale Isles homes are off the new river with direct ocean access to the Atlantic Ocean (no fixed bridges). Each isle leads to the Southfork New River, which feeds into the historic New River. Most Lauderdale Lauderdale Isles homes have personal docking for boats or yachts along the stunning the canals that lead to the Intracoastal waterway. The New River winds past the neighborhoods of Citrus Isles, Sailboat Bend and the Las Olas Isles as it makes its way to the popular Intracoastal Waterway and eventually the Atlantic Ocean.

The area is popular with boaters because of its protected and clean waterfront along Fort Lauderdale’s New River. It is also in close proximity to downtown Fort Lauderdale, beaches, fine and casual dining, and entertainment as well as the Fort Lauderdale/Hollywood International Airport.

blocks.text: Inspired by the music and lifestyle of legendary musician Jimmy Buffett, Latitude Margaritaville is a new 55+ active adult community in Daytona Beach, Florida. With innovative floor plans and abundant amenities, residents relish the world-class options for recreation, nightlife, and dining at this renowned Jimmy Buffett retirement community.

Residents of Latitude Margaritaville will enjoy unmatched access to impressive amenities. Surrounding the Town Square, the epicenter of all activity in the community, residents enjoy the state-of-the-art Fins Up! Fitness Center with a gym, aerobics studio, and an indoor lap pool and whirlpool spa. The Latitude Bar & Chill Restaurant offers indoor and outdoor dining. Amenities include Last Mango Theater where residents gather for performances, banquets, and dancing. The Workin’ ‘N’ Playin’ Center includes the Coconut Telegraph Business Center, the Barkaritaville Pet Spa, and multipurpose rooms for everything from crafts to cards. There is live music, entertainment, and dancing at the Town Square.

The state-of-the-art new construction homes will have a wide range of styles and options, with a total of 25 floor plans. The Conch Cottages Collection features four attached home models that are 2 bedroom/2 baths and range from 1,210 to 1,481 square feet. in living area. The Caribbean Collection boasts six floor plans of attached 2 bedroom/2 baths homes ranging from 1,503 to 1,862 square feet in size. The Beach Collection of single-family homes with 2-3 bedrooms/2-2.5 baths that features five floor plans that range from 1,684 to 2,392 square feet. The Island Collection is the largest collection offered at Latitude Margaritaville. It offers four plans with 2-3 bedrooms plus a den/2.5-3.5 baths ranging from 2,310 to 2,564 square feet. The Island collection has 3 car garages while the other collections come with 2 car garages.

Outdoor activities include tennis, bocce ball, and pickleball courts to the walking trail surrounded by a tropical landscape. The outdoor amenities feature a resort-style pool, with its beach entry feature, and patio for swimming, access to aerobics & group fitness classes, arts & crafts classes, and swimming classes. The community also hosts golf outings, holiday parties, and various concerts.

Just outside the Margaritaville retirement community, the golf-cart accessible, 200,000-square-foot Latitude Landings retail center is open with a Publix grocery store and plenty of shopping space. This prime location puts residents within easy reach of daily necessities and local attractions. The Central Atlantic Coast provides endless opportunities for recreation, entertainment, and adventure. The community's location in the heart of Daytona Beach, just off of Highway 95, also provides access to nearby beaches and championship golf courses. Daytona Beach International Airport is less than 10 miles away.
Latitude Margaritaville is also close to several health care providers, including Halifax Health Medical Center, AdventHealth Daytona Beach, and Florida Hospital New Smyrna Health Park.
