blocks.text: Lauderdale Harbors is a beautiful Waterfront community in Fort Lauderdale only minutes to the Intracoastal Waterway and the Atlantic Ocean. It is an exclusive community, comprised of 262 single family homes, featuring a few inland streets and waterfront homes with quick ocean access and zero fixed bridges. Located East of Federal highway (US1) and just North of 17th Street Causeway, Lauderdale Harbors is a fantastic community with their own Lauderdale Isles Yacht and Tennis Club.

The neighborhood is comprised of single family homes situated across 3 finger isles and a few adjacent streets, as Lauderdale Harbors is nestled between Rio Vista, Harbordale and the Intracoastal Waterway. This prestigious neighborhood is known for its upscale properties, diverse architectural styles, and picturesque waterfront views. Lauderdale Harbors offers residents a luxurious living experience, with well-maintained landscapes and a sense of privacy that contributes to the elegance of the community. Ranch styles and split-level homes are interspersed with 3 and 4 bedroom homes, many with private docks, many with Spanish or mid-century modern influences. There are 1 and 2 bedroom condominiums towards the bottom of the neighborhood.

The community’s location offers boaters some of the quickest ocean access in Fort Lauderdale given the Fort Lauderdale inlet is just south once you pass under the 17th Street Causeway. The Lauderdale Yacht Club is directly next to the community and the waterfront homes offer generously sized deep water dockage.

There are several shopping and dining options within 1 mile of the neighborhood, and students attend the highly rated Broward County Public Schools. Lauderdale Harbors is 2 miles from Downtown Fort Lauderdale, on the edge of the Stranahan River. Just down the street is the Fort Lauderdale Convention Center, Port Everglades cruise ship terminals, Fort Lauderdale Beach, Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport and of course Las Olas Boulevard and Downtown Fort Lauderdale just a few minutes north featuring a mix of modern architecture and historic charm, offering upscale shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Fort Lauderdale’s diverse cultural scene. including museums, theaters, and art galleries, adds to the city’s overall vibrancy.

blocks.text: Lido Key is a beautiful barrier island 25 miles west of downtown Sarasota located just across the Ringling Bridge on the Gulf of Mexico. Situated along the glistening waters of the Gulf Coast, Lido Key epitomizes tropical tranquility in Sarasota. Relish in the relaxed pace of a laid-back community, which features luxury condos, beach cottages, and waterfront estates, in an area known for its fantastic wildlife viewing and sailing facilities. Lido Key is a European-style island connected to the Sarasota mainland by St. Armands with a bridge, and to Longboat Key on the north with a bridge.

Renowned for its spectacular scenery, Lido Key welcomes one and all to the breathtaking beaches that look out onto the azure Gulf waters with several Lido Key homes nestled against this captivating coastline. Homes on the island consist of luxury condos and waterfront houses that are bay front, beach front or interior properties. Each home is a private oasis with large outdoor living areas featuring salt-water pools, summer kitchens, and room for plush lounge seating. Many residences have private gated entrances on oversized lots filled with massive swaying palms and brilliant flowering shrubs. Interior features include 12 to 13-foot ceilings and grand foyers with chandelier lighting; the homes highlight top-of-the-line finishes including marble flooring, and spiral wrought-iron staircases. Remodeled properties display gourmet-style kitchens with monogram appliances, beautiful center islands, and walk-in pantries. Each home is a private oasis with large outdoor living areas featuring salt-water pools, summer kitchens, and room for plush lounge seating.

Lido Beach is in close proximity to St Armands Circle, the world famous outdoor shopping area that has 145 exclusive upscale shops, boutiques, pristine beaches and outstanding dining options. It is a seamless blend of tranquil island living and the vibrant culture of nearby Sarasota. Local attractions include the Mote Marine Laboratory and Aquarium, boat tours and sunset cruises. Sarasota is a beloved Gulf Coast gem with a culture like no other. It is infused with a vibrant arts scene, eclectic shopping and dining, and surrounded by a picturesque landscape.

blocks.text: Legends Golf and Country Club is a distinguished golf community in Central Florida, offering various amenities, including a championship golf course and a range of residential architectural style. The gated community of Legends is nestled within a semi-private golf course that has spectacular views of rolling hills and majestic lakes. In addition to the18-hole golf course, there is a a driving range, putting and chipping greens, a fully stocked pro shop and professional instruction. The Legends community consists of about 950 homes nestled in 6 subdivisions catering to a range of different architectural styles. All residents must become a member of the master homeowners' association and their neighborhood subdivision. They are Beacon Ridge, Bridgestone, Carrington, Clermont Beacon Ridge, Nottingham and Sherbrook. Homes in the community range from 3-6 bedrooms and are between 1,900 square feet to over 4,800 square feet of living area.

The Legends Community has a 24 hour guard at the gate. The monthly HOA dues include internet and cable as well as access to the Clubhouse that includes a beautiful resort style heated pool and spa, fully equipped fitness center, separate media and event rooms, tennis courts, basketball court, playground, lanai overlooking Lake Louisa, along with a social dining experience at Legend’s Grille and Tavern.

Legends benefits from its prime Central Florida location, specifically west of Orlando, in Clermont, Lake County, Florida. This location provides residents with convenient access to major highways, including Florida’s Turnpike, US 27, and Highway 50, facilitating seamless travel to different locations.
In addition, downtown Orlando is a brief 30-45 minute journey from the Legends community making it an ideal location for those who commute to the city or enjoy occasional city visit

blocks.text: 2901 W Lake Vista Cir Davie, FL 33328

Long Lake Estates in Davie is an intimate community of only 95 home sites which surrounds a 16 acre lake and is adjacent to it's sister community of Long Lake Ranches. The community is located 1.25 miles south of SR 84 and I-595 between Nob Hill Road and Hiatus Road.

This elegant 24-hour manned gated community features a rustic stone guard house overlooking a cascading waterfall shaded by oak and ficus trees. Long Lake Estates was carefully planned for extra-spacious homes. There are 7 different models, 5 single story ranch style and 2 two story models. These estate homes feature 4 to 7 bedrooms and range between 3,062 square feet to 4,811 square feet of living area. The homesites range from .50 acres to 1.44 acres.

Long Lake West has 132 homes with larger lot sizes while Long Lake Ranches has 240 homes. The Long Lake communities, all located in the town of Davie, enjoy the charm of small town living while being close to the city with its shopping and restaurants while still a short drive to Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport and the Miami International Airport.

Long Lake Estates has a dedicated community recreational park exclusively for use of its homeowners. Amenities include a clubhouse, heated pool, children's playground, two tennis courts, a basketball court and picnic pavilion. Recreational trails for horseback riding, biking, walking and skating wind gently around the community's perimeter. Nearby is tree Tops Park which is a 356 acre recreational area including nature trails, canoeing, fishing, playgrounds, picnicking and a 3.5 mile dedicated equestrian trail. Homeowners have easy access to the nearby 272-acre Vista View Park with its picnic shelters, playgrounds, equestrian corral and fishing docks. It also has an area for primitive group camping and an airstrip for radio-controlled planes.

Its location in Davie Florida, just off of state road 595, make Long Lake Estates an ideal location close to shopping at Sawgrass Mills Mall, gourmet and casual dining in Fort Lauderdale and the pristine coastline of the Atlantic.

blocks.text: Longboat Key is a town in Manatee and Sarasota counties along the central west coast of the U.S. state of Florida, located on and coterminous with the barrier island of the same name. Longboat Key is south of Anna Maria Island, between Sarasota Bay and the Gulf of Mexico. The gorgeous white sand beaches of Longboat Key are enjoyed by residents and guests at the fantastic resorts, hotels, condos and beach houses.

Waterfront golf is one of the highlights of this Sarasota-Manatee gem, a resort community which also offers renowned fine dining as well as casual options right on the water—the ever-popular Mote Marine Laboratory & Aquarium, boating to scenic Beer Can Island offering a stunning place for picnics, parties, fishing, swimming and sunbathing and a free waterski show. Amenities include the island's championship golf course and tennis club, and its dining and shopping. Longboat Key brings you an elegant and scenic environment that offers the rare combination of breathtaking beaches, including Whitney Beach, Lido Beach and cultural activities, all within a relaxed and elegant lifestyle. Across a bridge at the north end of Longboat Key over Longboat Pass, Anna Maria Island’s Coquina Beach offers a shaded area to picnic and barbecue. Siesta Key to the south is accessible by car, across Ringling Causeway to Sarasota, south on 41, Tamiami Trail. Siesta Public Beach, famous for its soft white sand offers shaded picnic areas, playground and volleyball courts, restrooms and concessions. Further south is Turtle Beach, a popular boat and kayak launching area with picnic tables, restrooms, and a playground.

blocks.text: 8300 S.E. Fazio Drive Hobe Sound, FL 33455

Located in Hobe Sound, Florida, Lost Lake Golf Club is a community of 602 single family and patio homes ideally situated around 5 lakes and includes beautiful swimming pools, tennis courts and Bocce courts available to Owners and guests. The Golf Club at Lost Lake, a renowned golf course designed by Jim & Tom Fazio II and Associates, is a private club adjoining the community.

Lost Lake is nestled on the north side of the quiet, quaint town of Hobe Sound in Martin County, Florida. It’s a truly beautiful, friendly community, just minutes to the award-winning City of Stuart, and the warm, inviting Atlantic Ocean. Besides Stuart, residents can shop in the nearby towns of Jupiter, Tequesta, Port St. Lucie, West Palm Beach and world-famous Worth Avenue of Palm Beach.
Stuart (the “sailfish capital” of the U.S.), is also home to many excellent golf courses, restaurants, theaters and other venues for an active lifestyle.

The gated, covenants-governed, tree-lined community provides a safe, serene setting in which to live and Lost Lake is conveniently located near a variety of world-class health care and treatment facilities.

The Golf Club at Lost Lake is a semi-private club featuring various levels of club membership, with associated advantages. Social memberships are available to all offering total access to the dining room and grill. Limited summer memberships are available allowing golf privileges as well as food and beverage privileges in the grill room.

The tennis/pickle ball courts are located near the main entrance to our community and adjacent to the main pool and office. There are two lighted courts that have been resurfaced and new windscreens installed in the fall of 2016. In between the two courts there is a shaded area with tables, chairs and a water cooler for relaxing in between sets or watching a good match. The courts are accessible with the use of your pool key.

Lost Lake has two heated pools in which residents and their guests can swim, workout or relax. The main pool is located near the tennis courts and LLGC office while the second is located on Paurotis Lane. Gates, fences and security cameras at the pools are for the safety and security of those using the facilities.

Esplanade Golf & Country Club at Lakewood Ranch presents an air of sophistication and luxury. Beginning with entry views of serene lakes, lush landscaping and perfectly manicured golf links, every aspect of this resort-style community makes it clear this is a location to be coveted. Esplanade is made up of 1250 homes, 956 single family homes and 294 condominiums and detached villas. Esplanade at Lakewood Ranch offers Mediterranean-style architecture design that is truly unique to Southwest Florida. All homes are maintenance free and pet friendly.

The lifestyle is centered around signature resort-style amenities and wellness programs to invigorate the mind, body, and spirit. Experience a new level of inspired living and enjoy an exciting array of programs and amenities. Amenities include a heated lagoon-style pool, tennis, bocce and pickleball courts and a signature spa and wellness program. Esplanade has an 18-hole championship golf course with pro-shop, concierge services, group fitness classes, pet concierge programs, billiard room, adventure playground, and planned events, group outings and entertainment and travel excursions. They offer fine to casual dining, wine tastings, catered events and more, with a full-service restaurant, The Barrel House Bistro. Living in Esplanade at Lakewood Ranch means that all residents have either a golf or social membership included with the deed of their home and paid as part of the HOA fee. All homes have an HOA and CDD fee required, depending on size and location.

Esplanade Golf Club is also close to Lakewood Ranch Main Street, San Marco Plaza, downtown Sarasota, cultural attractions, sporting events, boating, parks, and beautiful white sandy beaches. It is situated close to shopping, Interstate 75 and medical facilities.

blocks.text: 2001 Crestwood Blvd N Royal Palm Beach, FL 33411

Madison Green Country Club is a luxury gated community located in Royal Palm Beach, Florida, centrally located minutes from downtown West Palm Beach and Palm Beach International Airport. Eight gated subdivisions boast 1300 single family homes and resort style amenities. Lush landscaping and twenty-two lakes overlook the 700 acres of protected wildlife preserve.

Madison Green offers an active, social lifestyle with clubhouse, Olympic-sized heated swimming pool and spa, a kids' pool, tot-lot, fitness center, conference facilities and tennis and basketball courts.

Golfers enjoy golf the way it was meant to be played, as you wind your way through nature preserves surrounded by Pine Barrens and hundreds of palm trees and mighty oaks and thousands of native plants. Joining you for your round will be native birds such as the Great Blue Heron, Sandhill Crane, Snowy Egret, various Hawks and other birds of prey who call the course home. This is a public access par-72 golf course and a unique driving range and putting green.

The well-established community is located on Okeechobee Blvd., close to shopping, dining and recreation activities, within close proximity to the Palm Beach Zoo and The Rapids Waterpark. Close by is West Palm Beach boasting a vibrant downtown area, cultural and historic sites and nightlife. Lake Worth is close by with stunning beaches and nearby golf and country clubs.

blocks.text: Estates of Boynton Waters is a small, private neighborhood located in Boynton Beach. Located on the east side of Jog Road in the Boynton Beach, this luxury gated community features 139 one and two-story single-family Mediterranean-style homes ranging in size from 3,875 to 6,376 square feet. Characterized by its brick paved streets and large home sites of up to 1/2 acre, features found in the community include stainless steel appliances, granite and marble counters, hardwood and marble flooring, vaulted ceilings, private swimming pools and home theaters. A large lake surrounds the community providing lake views for many of the homes.

Situated on 80 acres of land divided into two subdivisions, the community of Boynton Waters offers a number of amenities for residents to enjoy. These include a gate-manned entrance, tennis courts, a half Olympic-sized pool, jacuzzi, tennis, billiards, library, and a clubhouse with a fitness facility. The fitness trail that runs throughout this family-friendly community can be used for walking, jogging or bicycling.

The Estates of Boynton Waters is in a great position if you enjoy the water and the great outdoors! Boynton Harbor Marina is just under 7 miles away. Meadows Park is six miles away and has a basketball court, BBQ grills, bocce court, fitness trail has a 1/2-mile path with 11-exercise stations, gazebo, open play area, pavilion, picnic tables, playground, rental shelters, tennis courts and a volleyball court. Excellent restaurants, shopping centers, golf courses and museums are in the neighborhood. Top-notch schools and fantastic parks are also nearby. The pristine beaches of Boynton are only a 15 minute drive away.

The Florida Turnpike and I-95 are within a short commute from Estates of Boynton Waters providing residents with easy access to all of the attractions southern Florida has to offer.. Palm Beach International Airport is easy to get to.

blocks.text: Forest Ridge in Davie, Florida is like living in a small town as many residents view Forest Ridge as its own city within Davie. Surrounded by 200 year old oak trees, nature trails, and a historic preserve, Forest Ridge offers residents a lifestyle rarely found in a metropolitan community. There are 9 distinct neighborhoods within Forest Ridge, Old Orchard, Southern Orchard, North Orchard, Arborwood, Lake Park, Oak Park, Oak Grove, and Chapel Hill. The sister community, The Ridge on Nob Hill is located west of Pine Island Ridge. In order to preserve Pine Island Ridge, The Ridge on Nob Hill has its own entrance on Nob Hill Road. There are 1,558 one and two story homes 1,300 to 3,500 square feet of living area from within these neighborhoods. Each community within Forest Ridge offers a community heated swimming pool, clubhouse and 8 tennis courts, 6 of which are lit for night time playing.

Forest Ridge community is connected at its main entrance to Tree Tops Park by a paved walking path that meanders across Pine Island Ridge with paved trails and equestrian trails in Westbridge, a park in the town of Davie. Shopping, medical facilities and dining are located nearby. With I-595 and I-75 within close proximity, Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport and Miami International Airport are about 30 minutes away.

Frenchman's Reserve offers Full and Social/Sport Equity Memberships, and both provide unlimited use of tennis, swimming, fitness, spa, and social facilities at the club as well as complete access to the Grande Clubhouse with full dining privileges and access to the golf course and practice areas.

An equestrian community of 109 homesites, Foxwood is located just west of I-95 and the Turnpike in beautiful Martin County. Foxwood is a Sanctuary for Birds and Private Community for Horses and Humans nestled in Natural Surroundings.

Foxwood is a Deed Restricted Community where Custom built homes sit on large lots of two acres or more with one horse per acre permitted. Residents are encouraged to keep the Natural Habitat not completely clear it. A practice that allows wildlife to feel at home in Foxwood exists as well. Common Areas in Foxwood are minimal keeping HOA fees well below comparable communities in the area.

Foxwood was established in 1978. Five years later, the community had property owners in three phases of the development. By 1990, the creators of Foxwood had opened development on a fourth phase. It contains a Natural Preserve Area which is maintained, monitored, and managed by the Foxwood Property Owners Association.

All roads are private in Foxwood. The Foxwood Property Owner's Association maintains the four and a half miles of road system providing plenty of pathways for humans and horses. A Road Reserve fund is the major portion of the annual budget raised by Foxwood Property Owner's Association annual fees to residents of Foxwood.

Four Rivers, located in Palm City, is an environment where the river and the gorgeous foliage compete for space. From the minute you enter the tranquil community, you are instantly transported to another kind of lifestyle.

All of the residents of Four Rivers enjoy about an acre of land and all residents have waterfront homes. You would be hard pressed to find another community anywhere in Florida that possesses the charm of winding tree-lined roads and meandering rivers with the boating amenities and deep water docks of Four Rivers.
Established in 1971, Four Rivers is a quiet waterfront community where neighbors, wildlife and the South Florida boating lifestyle live together in harmony.

Located in Palm City, Florida, Four Rivers is named after the waterways that lie within its boundaries - the Rio Del Norte, the Rio Del Centro and the Rio Del Sur - and bounded on the East by the South Fork of the Saint Lucie River. The winding roads - named after local birds - are flanked with lush foliage, beautiful homes and lazy rivers.

?Each home in Four Rivers backs up to its own piece of paradise that connects to the Okeechobee waterway with easy boating access to the nearby Atlantic Ocean or all the way to the Gulf of Mexico. Here, boats are as common as cars and the local wildlife share our backyards. Over 200 residents in 97 properties are blessed to call this beautiful neighborhood home.

/neighborhood/frenchmans-creek.description: Frenchman's Creek Palm Beach Gardens Homes for.

blocks.text: 13495 Tournament Drive Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33410

Residents in Frenchman's Creek, located in Northern Palm Beach County, are warmly welcomed by tranquil waterfalls, colorful flora and fauna, and friendly, full-time security guards. Homes in Frenchman's Creek are comprised of Mediterranean-inspired villas, patio homes and townhomes, single family homes, golf villas, and expansive million-dollar estates. Most of these homes in this 700-acre community are located along the open water canals allowing boating, water sports, and yachting activities.

Prices range from $1.8 million for a three-bedroom townhouse to more than $12 million for a custom-built home on the water. Waterfront property in Frenchman's Creek is found along the Intracoastal Waterway--across from Loggerhead Marina--or on deep water canals, creating easy, navigable access for boats and yachts.

The one amenity that truly separates Frenchmen's Creek from other elite clubs in the region is its private Beach Club. Located on sparkling blue waters of Juno Beach, Frenchman's Creek Beach Club is an oceanside facility that presents concierge service, cabanas, a swimming pool, and food and beverages. Golf enthusiasts are thrilled to have two championship courses right in their own community.

The spectacular 110,000 square-foot clubhouse features six dining venues, a sports bar, conference rooms, game rooms, and well-appointed locker rooms. At the club, the complete concierge service includes complimentary valet parking; complimentary breakfast each morning; shuttle transportation to the beach club, airport, or local venues; fresh tea, coffee, cookies and snacks all day; food delivery from one of the on-site dining establishments; and numerous educational programs. The adjacent Wellness Center boasts a state-of-the-art fitness center, group exercise classes, full-service spa, lap pool, and resort-style swimming pool. Children have their own special area as well, which is full of fantastic toys, video games, board games, a ping pong table, an air hockey table, and an indoor basketball court.

Situated one hour north of Tampa, GlenLakes in Weeki Wachee is outside of the hustle and bustle of big city life, but still within the center of everything. Located on the western banks of the Indian River and the Intracoastal Waterway, Grand Harbor is a majestic community that takes pride in living in harmony with nature. Grand Harbor is committed to living in an environmentally responsible manner that includes rehabilitating the surrounding wetlands.It is amongst 900 lush tropical acres set directly on the west side of the Indian River. Grand Harbor is one of Vero Beach's largest luxury residential communities. Mediterranean style homes are clustered in individual private communities known as islands. These islands feature different housing options for individual's unique lifestyles including condominiums, townhomes, duplexes, villas, and custom-build estate homes. The River Club, River Village, Wood Duck, Newport Island, Victoria Island, and Harbor Point are just some of the communities located in Grand Harbor, located on the golf course, on the water, at the marina, or along the Indian River.

The Treasure Coast offers white sandy beaches and Atlantic breezes. Boating enthusiasts enjoy quick and easy deep-water access to the Indian River, Atlantic Ocean, and beyond.Five-star amenities are extensive including two championship golf courses, a 32,000 square foot grandiose Mediterranean style clubhouse with four diverse venues for dinning, 161-slip protected deep water marine, tennis center with 10 Har-Tru courts, 2 stadium courts, pickle ball courts, 3 bocce ball courts, a modern fitness center, and a full social calendar. The Treasure Coast offers white sandy beaches and Atlantic breezes

The marina is part of a unique harbor system, Grand Harbor offers controlled access to boat owners within a gated, secured community. The marina features 130 slips that can accommodate vessels up to 120 feet in length with a draft of six feet at low water. Boating enthusiasts enjoy quick and easy deep-water access to the Indian River, Atlantic Ocean, and beyond.

Grand Harbor neighborhoods are just a 10 minute drive to the private, oceanfront Beach Club with amenities that include an oceanfront swimming pool, beach cabanas, and oceanfront dining. Grand Harbor offers many monthly social events which include theme parties, dinner shows, golf invitational, tennis exhibitions, and all kinds of special interest clubs. Residents enjoy the resort-at-home lifestyle, along with the exciting art and culture scenes in Vero Beach. Despite a major population boom in the surrounding areas, this quaint town has kept its intimate size and charm due to thoughtful planning and city ordinances. At the same time, Vero Beach has become a state leader in the arts, sports, education, and medical facilities.

blocks.text: Grand Hampton is a private, master-planned gated community in New Tampa where residents enjoy a peaceful balance between comfort and convenience along with the serenity of a gorgeous natural setting. This 600-acre community offers a wide variety of homes to suit an array of homeowners’ needs. Grand Hampton consists of 1,782 homes, both single family homes and townhomes. Homes range from cozy, maintenance-free villas to enormous semi-custom estate homes nestled among wooded conservation preserves, including lakes, forests and wetlands where fifty percent of the land has been set aside for natural areas and open spaces. Homes range from 1,558 square feet to 5,382 square feet in living area, offering 3-6 bedrooms.
Grand Hampton is conveniently located within minutes to shopping, restaurants, and I-75 for easy access to Downtown, Tampa International Airport and the gorgeous gulf beaches.

The community has an assortment of amenities to enjoy as well. From the enormous resort-style pool with a slide and hot tub to a grand 8,000 square foot clubhouse, fitness center, tennis courts, and walking trails. The neighborhood boasts beautifully landscaped streets, lush green spaces, and a serene atmosphere that provides a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life.

There are numerous parks, plus tennis courts, a fitness center with an aerobics room, a basketball court, a multi-purpose athletic field, playground, and walking trails nearby. Parks in the area include West Meadows Country Club, Richmond Place Community Park and Live Oak Little League Fields that offers baseball, softball, and walking trails. Additional parks nearby include Lettuce Lake Park, New Tampa Community Park, Hampton Park, and the Flatwoods Wilderness Park.

The Tampa Convention Center and Tampa General Hospital are 21 miles away in downtown Tampa. Residents can reach most places by taking Interstate 75, such as Downtown Tampa with all the endless amenities it has to offer. In addition, there are shopping malls within 5 minutes. Tampa International Airport is just 26 miles away.

blocks.text: Golden Ocala Golf & Equestrian Club has carved out a piece of paradise on the more than 1,200 acres of beautiful rolling hills of Central Florida. Each Golden Ocala home is unique and custom built. Most properties feature views of the woods, golf course or water. Homes range from 1700 square feet to over 6000 square feet. At Golden Ocala, you must be a member to live inside the gates. Residents may choose from a variety of memberships including social, golf, general, sports, corporate and young executive.

The exclusive equestrian sports offerings in the heart of the Horse Capital of the World makes Golden Ocala the ideal spot to attend equine events. Spanish moss adorns the trees that line the streets, the homes are nothing short of luxurious, there is an award-winning golf course, resort-style amenities and it’s one of the most equestrian-friendly places to live in Central Florida. The professional event planning staff at Golden Ocala can accommodate any type of function from intimate group events to weddings and large corporate gatherings. Inside the Clubhouse, Golden Ocala offers several rooms of various sizes to accommodate guests, which includes the Grand Ballroom. There are a variety of meeting spaces available. There are three popular restaurants within the community from formal dining, lunch or just healthy snacks.

blocks.text: Haile Plantation is a village whose planning and style create an old-fashioned sense of community. The Haile Village shopping plaza is at the heart of the 2,700 custom homes, townhouses, apartments and condominiums that make up Haile Plantation where residences are woven amongst the retail shops, restaurants, and businesses in this downtown area. Within Haile Plantation are dozens of mini neighborhoods offering homes in a variety of styles and price points. The homes in Haile Planation run the full spectrum from small 1 bedroom condos to impressive million-dollar mansions. Haile Village is also the starting point of a RTS shuttle bus that runs regularly during the weekdays from Haile Plantation to the UF campus.

Haile Village is a great family-friendly destination boasting restaurants, supermarket, boutiques, spas and gift shops. The shopping is diverse, from the Blue Bird Boutique, Charm Shoes & Pedicures, and two quality jewelers, Village Jeweler, and Sanders Jewelers. Haile Village features a variety of restaurants, including The Third Place, a full-service bar and restaurant where people gather to meet friends and neighbors in the spirit of British pubs, a specialty ice cream shop, a pizzeria, and The Sisters for Breakfast featuring elegant breakfasts Wednesday through Sunday.

Located less than 10 miles southwest of UF Health Shands Hospital and the University of Florida, there are 2,700 homes in this community in SW Gainesville, which features miles of walking and biking trails, and lots of greenspace throughout its 1700 acres with a village center at its heart with shops and restaurants, townhouses, and a vibrant farmers market on Saturday mornings. It has an 18-hole signature golf course, large swimming pool and clubhouse with 2 pools, tennis and pickleball courts and fitness center. Walking trails connect scores of small internal neighborhoods. The Haile Equestrian Center also offers horse leasing, casual horseback rides, and pony parties.

Haile Plantation is within driving distance of many nature parks and other fun outdoor recreational activities around Gainesville. For example, the Haile Plantation West Park, anchored by the community's Hampstead Park neighborhood. It features a playground, gazebo, and an open field perfect for family picnics.

Nestled in the heart of Palm Beach County, the Gulfstream Preserve community in Lake Worth is a hidden gem that offers a unique blend of modern living, natural beauty, and unparalleled amenities. Gulfstream Preserve is a gated single family home and townhome community located on the east side of Lyons Road, just south of Lake Worth Road, in Lake Worth Florida. This gated community is only minutes away from major shopping, dining and entertainment. The Florida Turnpike and Palm Beach International Airport are also close by.

The neighborhood offers both single-family homes and townhomes, looking for a cozy, low-maintenance living space, the latter, for buyers looking for a cozy, low-maintenance living space. The community offers 211 one and two-story homes within the gates. There are 6 different models with living area ranging from 2,658 square feet to 3,773 square feet. These beautiful homes feature 3-5 bedrooms, 2.5-4 bathrooms and a 2 or 3 car garage. The architectural diversity ensures that Gulfstream Preserve has a distinctive charm, with homes that range from Mediterranean-style villas to contemporary designs. Almost every single home in Gulfstream Preserve is situated on a lake or garden view. There are also two cul-de-sacs providing some of the largest lots in the entire community.

Residents have the bonus of wonderful amenities to indulge in these include a clubhouse, resort-style swimming pool, spa and cabana, fitness center with exercise machines and free weights, children's playground, walking trails, beautiful shimmering lakes, and plenty of green spaces perfect for picnics and outdoor exercise.

The community is conveniently located so that everyday tasks can be completed with ease and downtown Lake Worth offers residents and visitors a charming area with shops, restaurants, entertainment, and galleries. The larger malls of Wellington and Palm Beach Gardens indulge in high end boutique stores. Lake Worth offers plenty of beaches and parks perfect for spending time outdoors with the family. Children will also love the amusement center that offers go karting, laser tag, and over 200 video games.
Lake Worth Beach is a short drive away, as is John Prince Park, historic Downtown Lake Worth, Winstoin Trails Golf Club, Lion Country Safari and Norton Museum of Art in West Palm Beach.

Gulf Stream is a small town in South Florida that spans 537 acres and is home to around 1,000 people. Nestled between Boynton Beach and the city of Delray Beach, this small town is designated specifically for residents, recreation, and public property. The Town of Gulf Stream is an oceanside oasis of estate homes, luxury oceanfront condominiums, and waterfront townhouses located between Delray Beach and Boynton Beach in South Palm Beach County. Located just east of the Intracoastal Waterway, the Town of Gulf Stream is exclusively a residential and recreational town.

Gulf Stream started out as a farming area with cultivated lands, where the intracoastal canal provided freshwater for agriculture. In 1922 parcels of land around the area were being snapped up and Gulf Stream was noticed as an ideal place for a golf course and polo fields, and is still one of the premier private clubs in the country.
The historic scenic highway that runs through the middle of the town offers the breathtaking scenery of the Atlantic Ocean and picturesque views of the real estate available.
This quaint town involves golf and polo, along with fishing, sailing, and other water related activities. The park has access to the ocean, a playground, and grilling stations.

For all your shopping needs the nearby towns of Boynton Beach and Delray Beach are within close proximity. Palm Beach International Airport and Fort Lauderdale International Airport are easily accessible with I-95 and the Florida Turnpike just a few miles away.

blocks.text: Harbor Beach is a gated, ocean access Barrier Island in the Southeast corner of Fort Lauderdale. It is one of the most prestigious neighborhoods in all of Fort Lauderdale bordered by Port Everglades to the South, the Atlantic Ocean to the East, the Intracoastal Waterway to the West and Fort Lauderdale Beach Park to the North, with A1A running through its core. This community consists of close to 400 homes ranging from magnificent multi-million-dollar waterfront estates to beautiful dry lot properties. Many of the luxury homes in Harbor Beach have private dockage deep enough for expansive yachts with unobstructed waterway passages to the Atlantic ocean. The neighborhood consists of different architectural styles ranging from traditional, Mediterranean, and contemporary.

This community is popular with yachting enthusiasts who appreciate the deep water home sites and close proximity to the ocean. Harbor Beach includes the subdivisions of Laguna Isle, Lucille Isle, Del Lago Isle and Isla Bahia and the the association provides for a private beach club and security patrols. The affluent Harborage Isle which contains just 17 waterfront homes on the beautiful New River Sound, has its own association, guard gate and security. South of 17th Street (Seabreeze Blvd.) are the subdivisions of Harbor Isles, with waterfront homes behind fixed bridges, and Harbor Inlet which has single family properties facing Port Everglades.

A water sports paradise, Harbor Beach provides private beach access along with its own beach club and marina, as well as private security, lending an exclusive and resort-style atmosphere for the community. Only minutes away, famous Las Olas Boulevard offers a wide array of fine boutiques, galleries, restaurants, and cafes. Conveniently located, Harbor Beach is also close to downtown Fort Lauderdale’s Riverwalk Arts and Entertainment District and a short drive from the Fort Lauderdale International Airport. The nearest golf course, which is no more than 10 minutes away.

blocks.text: Harbor Acres is an exclusive and sought-after section of Sarasota a few minutes south of downtown with its quaint neighborhood ambiance and elegant waterfront opulence. Hugging Sarasota’s waterfront with direct views of Bird Key across Sarasota Bay, this quaint and beautifully landscaped residential neighborhood is popular for those who enjoy boating. There is an eclectic blend of older and newer homes. The luxurious homes at Harbor Acres have consistently enjoyed solid value appreciation as waterfront properties are part of a real estate niche in Southwest Florida. This neighborhood, which is situated on two peninsulas overlooking the Sarasota Bay, is a great opportunity for buyers interested in acquiring stunning waterfront property designed by award-winning home builders. There is an eclectic blend of older and newer homes. With its combination of stylish modern and older homes, Harbor Acres has something to suit everyone's tastes. With most of the older homes having had extensive renovations over the years, they now include all the conveniences of modern living desired by today's families and busy professionals, as the neighborhood has a character all its own..

This is a neighborhood where you can find a handsome Mediterranean estate with private docks, perfect for boating and sailing, next to a Key West home or a Spanish Colonial masterpiece of residential architecture. From cascading terraces of limestone to various fountains and sculptures dotting the landscape, it's easy to see why Harbor Acres is a living experience. The homes' waterfront views are spectacular, as are the docks available for boating or fishing.

Harbor Acres is located in a very desirable section of Sarasota. Memorial Hospital and an upscale shopping district are within walking distance, and the arts district of Downtown Sarasota is about 12 blocks away. St. Armands Circle or the beaches of Siesta Key takes less than 10 minutes. Sandwiched between the bay and a bustling retail and restaurant district, top restaurants, attractions, and shopping are only five minutes away from bustling downtown Sarasota. Residents come together to celebrate the community at the annual Sarasota Jazz Festival, Sarasota Seafood & Music Festival, and the Sarasota Chalk Festival.

blocks.text: Harmony is located in rural west Osceola County, right off East Irlo Bronson Memorial Highway and is a master planned community, which offers a wide variety of homes that fit different needs and different budgets. There are townhomes, villas, spacious homes, and custom manor homes. As a master-planned community, it offers many amenities such as its own golf course, restaurants, a doctor’s office, nail salon, market place, and more. The amenity they consider one of their biggest features though is the 7,700 acres of open space, along with two large natural lakes with pristine shores. It also boasts 12.5 miles of trails and pathways perfect for walking, biking, and jogging. Residents of Harmony also partake in an exciting community lifestyle. Throughout the year, the Harmony social committee hosts many special events, such as book clubs, poker nights, swimming events and the Relay for Life.

Harmony is a new urbanism style community which offers plenty of park and recreational areas throughout the community. The community is really one massive neighborhood built around a golf preserve style golf course and offers a downtown area with shops and restaurants.

The greater Harmony area is made up of two large neighborhoods. 5 Oaks Drive is the main road throughout the community that runs through the original Harmony area and Botanic Blvd is the main road in the new Harmony West area. Hwy 192 runs along the Entrance to Harmony and will take you Southeast to Indialantic Beach in Melbourne or Northwest through Kissimmee where it connects to Hwy 27 in the Four Corners area.
Orlando International Airport is 35 miles and Disney, Universal Studios and Sea World attractions are about 35 miles away from the community. Downtown Orlando is 42 miles away.

blocks.text: Located in the heart of Lake Mary, Heathrow Country Club is Seminole County’s premier private country club. Heathrow is a guard gated, country club community featuring nearly 2,000 single-family homes situated on 1800 acres of real estate. With a backdrop of natural lakes, mature trees and impeccably maintained landscape along the winding roads, walking paths and numerous park areas, the Heathrow Community provides the ideal setting for biking, jogging, fishing or a quiet moment to savor the scenery. Real estate options in this gated community consist of single family homes, zero lot line villas and condos.

Heathrow Legacy Country Club features two spacious clubhouses and both have an athletic club adjacent to them. Unique to central Florida, Heathrow offers 36 holes of Championship golf between our two well-maintained courses and a lush green fairway, both golf courses are located within a mile of each other and provide members two distinct golf experiences. The Garl Course is a water lover’s dream, featuring water hazards that come into play on 14 out of the 18 holes. Down the street the Fazio Course that couldn’t be more different. The Fazio course was carved around a dense forest of lush, mature trees with spectacular topography, dramatic slopes, rises and knolls unique to Florida. This course is a true nature lover’s dream and is certified as an Audubon International Sanctuary golf course. Both golf courses feature expansive clubhouses, a pro-shop, and practice facilities that include a driving range and dedicated greens for both chipping and putting. All Heathrow Legacy memberships extend privileges to the primary member, spouse, or spousal equivalent, and dependent children under 24 or 25 if a full-time student living at home.

The Racquet Club with 13 tennis courts, and Swim Club, featuring a junior Olympic pool and fitness facility are amongst the many activities. Indoor and outdoor dining are available all year-round and the culinary team offers only the freshest of ingredients. For children, there is in-house sitter care, various activities, and classes, and a social calendar that is full of a variety of events for all ages.

Heathrow community provides residents with access to shopping, a major business center and its own elementary school. Just minutes from Interstate 4, Heathrow residents have a direct link to Orlando Sanford International and Orlando International airports as well as the rest of Seminole County.

blocks.text: An active 55+ community located in Hudson on Florida’s nature coast, a mere 45 minutes north of Tampa International Airport, Heritage Pines is a secure, gated, financially sound, affordable community of 1,406 homes with a spectacular Clubhouse and a private golf course owned by the community. This hidden gem of community is located on the border of Pasco and Hernando counties on the west coast of Florida. Heritage Pines is a 55 + community with much to offer the fun seeking retiree. Heritage Pines is close to beaches, great shopping, sport fishing, professional sports, and performing arts.

Heritage Pines is comprised of individual, self-governing villages. In some villages homes are maintained by the association, while in others the homeowners take care of maintenance. Heritage Pines has a variety of attached and detached homes. This community is made up of mostly single family homes and some attached and detached villas. The course features sweeping fairways and manicured greens. The course also features a full driving range, a putting green, a chipping green and a practice sand bunker. The Heritage Pines Pro Shop is open for your assistance every day. It offers an array of golf-related attire and supplies for both men and women.

This gated 55+ community offers the best in active adult living with a diverse array of activities and amenities. Heritage Pine also boasts lighted, 4 Har-Tru tennis courts, 2 Bocce Ball courts and over sized heated pool/spa, and the gently rolling hills are just perfect for bike riding. blocks.text: Hernando Beach FL located in Hernando County is found on the far west coast with many waterfront residential opportunities. Weeki Wachee is to the north and Spring Hill is south east of this small rural community. This tight-knit neighborhood has a laid back and relaxed lifestyle on the waterfront. Offering homes with direct access to the Gulf of Mexico, as well as, the Weeki Wachee River. The living is easy in these large and small homes on the water. Homes vary from classic Florida style homesites to new construction with deep fresh water canal and indirect gulf access. It is within minutes to the open water for all water activities and still convenient to all the major amenities US Highway 19 has to offer including shopping, restaurants, entertainment, and medical facilities.

Custom-built and stilt-homes are dotted along the network of manmade canals in Hernando Beach, all are navigable by boat and open to the deep waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Offering great value for the money, homes in Hernando Beach consist mostly of single-family homes that, compared to other waterfront properties in the Tampa Bay Area, are quite affordable. This location has some of the best and most desirable waterfront living in Florida. The canals are lined with many existing upscale homes that feature waterfront dockage for your boat, kayak, or paddle boards. Hernando Beach offers largely undeveloped beauty with many waterfront home sites that are still available to build your dream home.

The Nature Preserve and man-made lakes across from Hernando Beach offer serene hiking trails for bird watching, and bike riding paths for the outdoor or exercise enthusiast. A quick 5-minute drive north takes you to the 135-acre Linda Peterson Park, formally known as Hernando Beach Park, and Jenkins Creek. Both public parks are host to outdoor favorites that include fishing piers, picnic areas, manatee watch zones, and a 40-foot observation tower. There are plenty of areas available for shoreline fishing and photographing the eagles and ospreys that call Florida’s Adventure Coast their home.

From Hernando Beach you can paddle in kayaks and canoes to nearby Weeki Wachee and Withlacoochee Rivers, the Gulf shallows and backwaters. There are fantastic sunsets every evening and during the day you can find natural coastal wildlife. Hernando Beach itself has seen a rapid growth of local businesses and restaurants that include outdoor dining, local establishments that offer live music and several marinas to provide its residents with all of their recreational needs.

blocks.text: Highland Lakes is an active adult community that boasts great country club-style amenities along with a low-maintenance lifestyle. Located just northwest of Tampa, Florida, Highland Lakes is situated on 684-acres of land, providing the perfect convenience for retirees and senior citizens who are looking forward to residing in a peaceful neighborhood. The surrounding area offers great opportunities for recreation and entertainment. Highland Lakes consists of 2,454 attached villas, townhomes, condos and single-family homes ranging from 700-2190 square feet in living area..

Highland Lakes offers its residents great amenities to stay socially and physically active. The main clubhouse includes a card room, billiards room, library, meeting room and a large ballroom where residents can enjoy dinners, dances, entertainment and fitness activities. Outside amenities include a swimming pool, water aerobics, tennis, shuffleboard, and bocce ball courts. At the center of Highland Lakes is the 27-hole executive golf course providing free play to all residents of all skill levels. In addition, there is an arts and crafts building that houses a ceramics room, woodworking shop, rooms for jewelry-making and stained-glass as well as art classes and a computer room. Another amenity center is Lake Tarpon Lodge. The lodge is mainly used for club meetings, fitness activities like yoga or Zumba, and other community gatherings, an outdoor pool and patio with a picnic area and BBQ grills with access to Lake Tarpon that is also available for residents to rent out for personal use. Two Highland Lakes pontoon boats are docked at the Lodge and take residents and their guests on two trips daily around the lake stopping at a local restaurant.

The area of Palm Harbor offers a quiet oasis close to the urban city of Tampa. Located between the Gulf of Mexico and Lake Tarpon, this community is accessible for shopping, dining, and medical services just outside the community. Just a few miles from the Gulf of Mexico residents can take day trips to any of the white sand beaches up and down the coastline. Professional sports teams such as the Tampa Bay Rays baseball team and the Tampa Bay Lighting football team are nearby. Airports such as St. Pete Clearwater International Airport and Tampa Bay International Airport are also just minutes away from Highland Lakes.

/neighborhood/historic-old-northeast.name: Historic Old Northeast
/neighborhood/historic-old-northeast.title: Historic Old Northeast
/neighborhood/historic-old-northeast.description: Historic Old Northeast St. Petersburg Homes for Sale St. Pete Homes for.

blocks.text: Nestled along the beautiful waterfront of Coffee Pot Bayou is one of the area’s oldest and most prominent neighborhoods. The neighborhood’s boundaries are 5th Avenue N/NE on the south and 30th Avenue N/NE on the north with Tampa Bay and Coffee Pot Bayou its eastern boundary and 4th Street N its western boundary. The area’s quaint charm and luxury also feature an abundance of outdoor activities and delicious restaurants. With a delightful shopping district and a collection of iconic landmarks, Historic Old Northeast is a charming, walkable neighborhood teeming with life.

The historic Old Northeast district abuts downtown, and claims nearly 3,000 historic buildings within its boundaries. It also has a pleasant shopping district, restaurants and a number of city landmarks. Housing is a mix of Mediterranean and bungalow style homes in a lushly green setting rife with jacarandas, pines, palms, and magnolias. There are 2,975 historic homes and buildings in Historic Old Northeast, which features a leafy residential area with brick streets and waterfront green spaces, including expansive Vinoy Park. Historic Old Northeast offers a serene and romantic journey into the past that still has all the easy trappings of modern convenience.

Brick streets and granite curbs add to the charm of the area, which also includes North Shore Park to the east, with its swimming, biking, walking, and playing areas as well as a pretty white sand beach. The area also borders Coffee Pot Bay, famous for its resident manatees. The Gizella Kopsick Palm Arboretum is another bucolic addition to the community. The Palladium Theater presents eclectic performances in a former church also in the area. The St. Petersburg transit system provides bus service through the neighborhood, and the busy urban nightlife of downtown is just minutes away. Dating from the early 1900s, the Sunken Gardens feature tropical plants and flamingos, and the nearby Great Explorations Children's Museum has creative, play-based exhibits. Cafes, casual chain restaurants, and taco spots line 4th Street North.
I-275 is easily accessible for travel and Tampa International Airport is 30 minutes away.

Highlands Reserve is a prestigious neo-traditional style neighborhood gated community, situated only minutes from I-95, the Florida State Turnpike, downtown Stuart, the ocean and the Jensen Beach shopping areas.

Through Highlands Reserves magnificent gated entrance one finds an unparalleled lifestyle for the entire family. Residents have come to relax in the serenity of nature’s beauty at Highlands Reserve. Here you will discover a community where acres of tranquil lakes and miles of tree-covered trails offer breathtaking backdrops to a quiet and simple lifestyle. Highlands Reserve was born in 2005 by Engle Homes and was purchased and completed by DR Horton and eventually Starwood Land Ventures. Prior to the start of manufacturing, the land was primarily woodlands with some areas for cattle to roam. The construction of homes began in earnest in 2006 and the building continues today. The community displays spectacular spacious home designs in three distinctive home styles each with multiple floor plans, Traditional, generally smaller homes with smaller lots; Estates, which feature larger lots and generally larger homes; and the Waterfront homes which are primarily along the St Lucie waterway with several featuring larger lots with access to a dock.The community features designer street lamps and wide sidewalks where residents can enjoy casual strolls with views of the preserve and lakes. This community has been planned for a majority home owner-occupied residence and requires adherence to the comprehensive rules and covenants that provide for a safe and enjoyable community. Many of the residents are families with children, retirees or snowbirds who come to enjoy our lovely community during those cold northern winter months.

Highlands Reserve residents enjoy gated entrances with 24-hour virtual guard and street lights and sidewalks throughout the community along with a large, resort-style heated swimming pool for all residents that includes a shaded pavilion next to the pool for relaxing in the shade. Highlands Reserve also has a 4,600 sq. ft. Clubhouse featuring a state-of-the-art Fitness Center, Activity center, kitchen, a wet bar, a large covered breezeway, and a covered pavilion.

Highlands Reserve has a Tot Lot playground located next to the clubhouse and pool. There are two lighted tennis courts near the community swimming pool. One of the courts is lined for pickleball. The community has miles of walking trails around many of our 10 lakes. Fishing is allowed at all the lakes.Covered BBQ Pavilion and picnic area near the tennis courts overlooking a large majestic pond. Highland’s Reserve provides community common area and home landscaping for all mowing, fertilization/seed treatment, and shrub trimming. All lots and common areas include an automatic sprinkler system for lawns and shrubs.

/neighborhood/histroric-kenwood.title: Historic Kenwood
/neighborhood/histroric-kenwood.description: Just west of Downtown, Historic Kenwood is a diverse, artsy district known for its mature oak trees, brick streets, and high concentration of Craftsman.

blocks.text: Just west of Downtown, Historic Kenwood is a diverse, artsy district known for its mature oak trees, brick streets, and high concentration of Craftsman bungalows. Relaxed restaurants and cafes, beer bars, and gay nightspots line busy Central Avenue and 34 Street North. Neighborhood events like architecture tours and artist open-studio nights create a strong community vibe.

The Kenwood Historic District is a 375-acre residential area best known for its historic bungalows. It consists mostly of one-story and two-story single-family homes constructed between 1912 and 1945. Historic outbuildings, such as garages and garage apartments, are also common in the neighborhood. There are a variety of residential architectural styles represented in the district, including Frame and Masonry Vernacular, Craftsman Bungalow, Minimal Traditional, Tudor Revival, Mediterranean Revival, Colonial Revival, Ranch, Prairie, American Foursquare, Dutch Colonial Revival, Mission, and International, bungalows constitute more than 50 per cent of the homes.

In addition to the large number of historic buildings remaining in the neighborhood, many of the historic landscape and streetscape elements remain. The majority of the avenues, which run in an east–west direction in the district, continue to be made of brick. Hexagonal paves can still be found comprising many of the sidewalks. The high granite curbs are also still evident along many of the streets, which are lined with large oak trees, as well as jacaranda, palms, and pine trees. Historic Kenwood is located on a plateau about 50 feet above sea level, making it much higher than other neighborhoods in the city. Another feature of Historic Kenwood is Seminole Park, with This historic park featuring many types of trees, grassy areas, sidewalks, playground equipment, and a modern pavilion in the center constructed in the Craftsman style.

blocks.text: Hollywood Lakes, Hollywood’s oldest neighborhood, located east of U.S. 1 between Washington and Johnson Streets, is desirable not only for its charming historic houses but also for its pedestrian friendly environment. Homes occupy 50’ frontage lots clustered around green public spaces that include Hollywood Golf and Country Club, Young Circle, North and South Lakes and Jefferson Park. The historic neighborhood of Hollywood Lakes maintains its 1920s character, even while offering a more modern vibe to potential new residents. The Hollywood community was developed as a luxury-living neighborhood, catering to wealthy yacht owners drawn to the manmade twin lakes’ easy access to the Intercoastal Waterway. The number of condominiums and high-rise apartments has risen steadily since the neighborhood was developed. Now, potential residents can choose dozens of high floor condominiums, some with stunning views of the North Ocean Drive and the ocean.

Mid-to-large-sized homes were built along tree-lined streets in Mediterranean, Art Deco, Mission and Spanish Colonial styes. The most grandiose homes lined the main boulevard, providing visitors their first impression. Some of those homes still exist and have undergone renovations. On some streets, Mediterranean Revival-style homes made of limestone and terra cotta dominate. The homes are characterized by gabled roofs covered with barrel tiles, doors and windows highlighted with spiral columns, stone carvings or tile, balconies and porches that flow from inside. Homes vary from 2-9 bedrooms and range from 1,390 square feet to 12,845 square feet in living area.

Many of the houses built in the 1920’s were designed to capture the southeast breezes from the Atlantic Ocean. Hollywood Lakes was planned as a large residential section of expensive homes with twin manmade lakes flanking Hollywood Boulevard as focal points for beauty, symmetry, and aquatic activities. Open porches served as venues for entertainment and garages were built at the rear of the lots and alleys for easy maintenance and the alleys were to be used as walking paths.

One of the defining features of Hollywood Lakes is its close proximity to beautiful sandy beaches. Hollywood Beach and South Florida’s beautiful coastline is less than 5 miles. Like most of Florida’s east coast, Hollywood has miles of sunny beaches, charming boardwalks and interesting sites from jogging on the beach to chartering a boat for deep sea fishing. Recreational and leisure activities range from the lush greens of public golf courses dotting the area and parks hosting local events to iconic destinations like Hard Rock Casino. In the heart of Hollywood Hills, vibrant amenities are within easy reach, from the shopping to a myriad of diverse dining options. Fitness and wellness are also well catered to in Hollywood Hills with popular health clubs. It is Home to Memorial /Joe Di Maggio Children's Hospital and other healthcare facilities.

Open green spaces include the Hollywood Golf and Country Club, Young Circle, Jefferson Park and North and South Lakes which are popular spots for water-skiers. Several parks are in and around Hollywood Lakes, including neighborhood favorite West Lake Park. In addition to athletic amenities and biking and jogging paths, the 15-acre urban park has a boat ramp, a busy marina, fishing areas and shrub- and tree-filled wetlands.

The Hollywood Lakes neighborhood enjoys easy access to highways and thoroughfares, including I95 and the Florida Turnpike, allowing easy traveling to nearby cities like Fort Lauderdale and Miami. There is convenient accessibility to the train station and Fort Lauderdale International Airport. Shopping, dining options and entertainment are all near by.

blocks.text: Located in northwest Osceola County, Celebration is a master-planned community where residents have access to a state-of-the-art Florida Hospital facility and award-winning educational opportunities from kindergarten through college. The community boasts evolving technology and an outstanding sports complex, the Celebration Community Field, to enrich its residents' lives.

Timeless characters resonate among architectural buildings, public spaces, and the local Town Hall. Time seems to stand still in this iconic community, as neighbors visit on front porches, children play outdoors, and friends meet in the charming downtown.

Each village within Celebration boasts an exceptional array of amenities that may include a thermal salt pool, outdoor picnic pavilions, wading pools, and playgrounds for children. Lighted tennis courts, an outdoor amphitheater, lighted basketball courts, and more. Residential offerings include a single-family terrace, bungalow, garden, cottage, village, manor, estate homes in addition to townhomes and condominiums. A stunning variety of architectural styles contribute to Celebration's timelessness, including Classical, Colonial, French, Coastal, Mediterranean, and Victorian exteriors, all with modern floor plans. Welcoming front porches are the perfect place to gather. Homes enjoy access to rear garages via a service alley creating eye-catching curb appeal in the front.

Built as a place to live and work, residents will find everything that they need in downtown Celebration. The quaint area boasts a hotel, shops, dining, a lake, and a boardwalk. With over 40 parks, miles of walking trails, a library, and two places of worship, life in Celebration is simple. The core of Celebration, Walt Disney World, is conveniently just 5 miles away. And, for those commuting, I4 and the 417 are right outside Celebration's entrance.

blocks.text: Situated among rolling hills in Brooksville, Cascades at Southern Hills is an age-restricted community ideally situated within an hour of Tampa. Cascades is located next to the prestigious Southern Hills Country Club and residents have the option of joining the golf and country club. This gated neighborhood is part of the larger, all ages master-planned community of Southern Hills Plantation. The homes range from 2-4 bedrooms and from 1,352-2,663 square feet in living area.

Residents of the 55 and better Cascades community can also purchase a membership in order to access the magnificent Southern Hills Plantation clubhouse. The 20,000 square-foot clubhouse was designed in the Old Florida style. It houses a library, billiards, hobby rooms, and a 7,500 square-foot fitness center. This center has great workout equipment with free weights, elliptical machines, treadmills, and flat screen TVs for entertainment during workouts. It also features an aquatic center as well as a full-service spa, where residents can pamper themselves with manicures, pedicures, wraps, and other relaxing treatments. Outside the center residents will have bocce ball, pickleball, four Har-Tru tennis courts and a resort-style pool. Casual dining is provided at the full service restaurant, in addsition to three special event dining areas including the covered outdoor sitting area. There is a private golf course within Southern Hills Plantation where membership is limited to the residents.

Southern Hills in Brooksville, FL is situated 45 minutes north of Tampa. Major highways nearby include I-75 and Suncoast Expressway. Tampa has some of the best shopping, dining, sports, and cultural activities that Florida has to offer. Nature enthusiasts will find over 40 miles of trails ready for exploration. National parks in the area include Mutual Mine Recreation Area, Withlachoochee State Forest, and Chassahowitska National Wildlife Refuge. Cultural attractions in the Brooksville area include the Hernando Heritage Museum, the William Sherman Jennings House landmark, the Hernando Historical Museum, and the Frank Saxon House landmark. The closest airport, just minutes away, is Hernando County Airport. Tampa International Airport in downtown Tampa can be reached within 45 minutes.

Set within the master-planned community of Lakewood Ranch, Central Park at Lakewood Ranch integrates a gated family-friendly community with the natural Florida environment. Central Park homes are nestled north of State Road 70 and east of Lakewood Ranch Blvd. in a 300 acre green community consisting of 800 homes, comprised of 5 neighborhoods, ranging from 1040 to 3300 square feet. These neighborhoods are: Forest Park, Piedmont Park, Gramercy Park, Claremont Park, and Longview Park, each one named for notable parks in America. The community is environmentally-conscious with building techniques respecting the natural surroundings. Many homes have private pools in their spacious yards.

Its magnificent centerpiece is a beautiful 10 acre park with fountains, and playground with large open fields for baseball, soccer or football, a children's splash park and pavilion, tennis courts, a butterfly garden, hiking and biking trails, tennis courts, pavilion for outdoor entertaining and two dog parks. 

Premiere schools, sporting venues, attractions, festivals, farmers markets, and shopping are close by.  Within close proximity, you have the University Town Center Mall, casual and fine dining, gyms, beauty shops and spas, and Lakewood Ranch Medical Center. The Sarasota International Airport is minutes away and Siesta Beach is a 25 minute ride. Downtown Sarasota features theatres, museums, art galleries, boutiques, international restaurants, parks and marinas.

blocks.text: Channelside Tamps is a gem on the Gulf Coast that offers urban living with a coastal flair and its historic architecture is complemented by modern landmarks. Channelside is Florida's largest open-water estuary, connecting three counties through the Gulf of Mexico. It is a metropolitan neighborhood that is home to young professionals, families, and seniors alike. There are several distinct and remarkable neighborhoods with luxury homes within the Tampa region, each offering its own appeal to the discerning buyer. Sitting along the banks of the Ybor Channel is one of the most coveted and fastest-growing areas in Tampa.

Channelside is the ultimate residential and entertainment borough, with homes featuring premium luxury towers with many new exclusive upscale, luxury skyscraper condominiums and penthouses along with urban chic lofts have been recently built. This upscale and trendy neighborhood is the perfect blend of modern and classic architecture in a location that highlights the best of downtown Tampa. The Channel District sits just east of downtown next to Port Tampa Bay. Chanbelside is a dynamic community with exceptional restaurants, nightlife, bars, events and attractions. Enjoy the charm of the old-time streetcar that connects downtown to Channelside and the Historic District. Residents can walk to the Channelside District and enjoy restaurants, nightlife, shops and movies. Nearby is the Port of Tampa where you can take a cruise or trolley on over to Ybor City or downtown Tampa.

Located three minutes from downtown Tampa and Sparkman Wharf, six minutes from historic Ybor City, and seven minutes from upscale Harbour Island, residents have easy access to modern to vintage shopping venues, a diverse menu of dining options, a vibrant nightlife scene, museums, and the Amalie Arena for sports and music events. The Channel District is a busy area that brings families to the Florida Aquarium for its sharks, stingrays, and wild dolphin cruises. Just outside, the American Victory Ship is a warship repurposed as a maritime museum. Hockey fans fill Amalie Arena to see the Tampa Bay Lightning play, and the venue also hosts big-name rock and pop acts. Casual, sports-themed bars and restaurants. The Channel District is busy with scenic walks, biking, or running along the Tampa Riverwalk that runs from Channelside Drive to the Armature Works for casual eats.

blocks.text: The Clearwater Point waterfront condos are located on the southern tip of Clearwater Beach just north of Sand Key,renownded for it's quiet and peaceful location. These moderately priced 2 bedroom 2 bath condos are close to all that Clearwater Beach has to offer. With over 400 units in the community, there are usually lots of choices for price, layouts, and views.

Clearwater Beach Point captivates beautiful waterfront views that residents enjoy. Only two buildings are active adult, 55 and over, which are 868 Bayway Blvd, Building #3 and 825 Bayway Blvd, Building #5, while the rest of the buildings welcome all ages. Day or night residents enjoy morning strolls or nightly sunsets from their private condominium homes. These include one and two bedroom condos that offer spacious floor plans, lots of closet space, assigned parking and a maintenance free lifestyle.

Located on the southeastern tip of Clearwater Beach on Clearwater Pass and Clearwater Harbor, Clearwater Point has its own semi-private beach area on Clearwater Harbor with beautiful panoramic views of Clearwater Harbor and Clearwater Pass, including watching the boats and ships go by as they pass through Clearwater Pass on their way to or from the Gulf of Mexico. The community amenities consist of a fitness center, shuffleboard and sand volleyball courts, tennis courts, 3 heated pools and spa, a large pool side hot tub or grill out by the barbecue area near the beach. The great convenient location is close to many restaurants, bars, entertainment spots and is sitting adjacent to a beautiful secluded beach as well as being within walking distance to transportation, shops, and Sand Key Park.

blocks.text: Citrus Glen is an exclusive gated community located in Boynton Beach with only 195 single-family home sites. The community consists of large single-family homes with attached garages, spacious yards and beautifully maintained gardens with mature trees. Most homes have serene views of one of the many lakes weaved amongst the quiet streets. This beautiful landscaped gated community offers sidewalks for evening strolls.

Community amenities include a modern fitness center, a tastefully remodeled clubhouse, and a lakeside resort-style pool perfect for enjoying amazing year-round temperatures. It's easy to find things to do within the community with basketball and tennis courts, community playgrounds, and plenty of walking trails available.

Citrus Glen has plenty of things to see and do within only a few minutes away. The Boynton Beach Mall and Town Center is under three miles away, there you will find all the shops you need, along with banks, a post office and several great eateries. Nearby are Boynton Beach Harbor and the award-winning Oceanfront Park Beach for scuba diving, getting a fishing charter, hiring jet skis, or just having a picnic at the beach park. The Loxahatchee National Wildlife Refuge is just a 20-minute drive away, with over 221 square miles of Everglades habitat it is home to the American Alligator and the endangered Everglade snail kite.

Citrus Glen is between Military Trail just west of Interstate 95, placing residents near major shopping, popular restaurants, and grocery stores. Head North on I95 for just under half an hour and spend a day at Palm Springs or head South for just over 9 miles and have a relaxing day at Delray Beach.

blocks.text: Cleveland Heights is a family-friendly neighborhood with a mix of modest starter homes and bigger properties, as well as some townhomes, located south of Lake Hollingsworth and north of Polk Parkway. The neighborhood consists of 1,061 homes bounded on the east by Cleveland Heights Boulevard, an elegant palm tree-lined road reminiscent of Beverly Hills, and on the west by S. Florida Avenue. The neighborhood offers modest starter homes alongside a 27 hole golf course. The homes range from 2-5 bedrooms and from 850 square feet to 1,628 square feet in living area.

Amenities include a 20,000 square feet clubhouse, a 27-hole public golf course, full service pro shop, golf instruction and a restaurant. Residents enjoy walking and biking along Three Parks Trail, a 4-mile path along the neighborhood’s outskirts and a section of Cleveland Heights Boulevard. Common Ground Park, directly north of Cleveland Heights, the first inclusive playground in Polk County that caters to those with physical and developmental disabilities as the park incorporates non-traditional play zones with classics like swings and slides. Peterson Park, farther south, offers an optimal space for little league games with four baseball diamonds. Handley Park offers playground, grills and picnic area.

Florida Avenue South and Cleveland Heights Boulevard are two major thoroughfares for the area, and bus stops run along Florida Avenue for commuters who use public transit. Florida State Route 570 is also in the neighborhood along the southern border. Also known as Polk Parkway, this toll road leads to Lakeland Linder International Airport 6 miles west and connects to U.S. State Route 98 4 1/2 miles east.

blocks.text: Colee Hammock is a highly desirable waterfront neighborhood located in the Historic Heart of East Fort Lauderdale amidst the neighborhood's mature oaks and tropical landscaping lush with swinging Spanish moss. This upscale area attracts residents who enjoy living within walking distance to restaurants, galleries and shops on the popular Las Olas Boulevard, which is just minutes to Fort Lauderdale Beach. Also within walking distance is the community park, the perfect place to relax and admire the waterfront mansions as boats sail by. Though somewhat inland and just south of Broward Boulevard, Colee Hammock is very much a peninsula. Bordered on the south by the New River/Tarpon River, on the west by the Himmarshee Canal, and on the east by another Intracoastal canal, it is a boater's dream with no fixed bridges.

Colee Hammock homes include luxury condos, townhomes with typically over 2,500 square feet and historical single-family homes with over 10,000 square feet of living area, boat dockage and ocean access. From multi-million dollar waterfront estates to urban condos and townhomes, this neighborhood offers plenty of housing options in all price ranges. The area exudes old Florida charm with many estate homes that feature classic Mediterranean-style architecture on large, mature oak tree-lined streets with key residences offering frontage on the historic New River.

blocks.text: Cobblestone is a beautiful gated community of nearly 500 acres, nestled among Florida pines and open waterways in western Palm City, Florida. Located in central Florida’s Martin County on scenic Martin Highway between I-95 and the Florida Turnpike, it affords easy highway access for its owners whether traveling North or South. Cobblestone shares its guarded entrance with the equestrian community of Stuart West and the private golf club, The Fox Club.

The 238 home sites of Cobblestone are intertwined with the Fox Club’s 131 acre private golf course. The challenging 18-hole course was redesigned in 2004 by British Open champion Darren Clarke. Cobblestone and The Fox Club combine to create a beautiful tract of undisturbed land with majestic soft pines, sparkling lakes and tranquil nature preserves that are home to many species of wildlife and plants. It is not unusual to see deer grazing, eagles soaring overhead or river otters swimming in its lakes. Home sites are a minimum of one half acre with many having panoramic views of the golf course, lakes and preserves.

Cobblestone’s sister community, Stuart West, is hallmarked by stables and pastures. The two communities share a beautiful private park complete with football and baseball fields, basketball court, playground equipment and shelters surrounded by live oaks and pines.
