blocks.text: Rio Vista is a riverfront community of over 1,000 homes, situated next to downtown Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Its name means "River View" in Spanish. It is one of the oldest communities in Fort Lauderdale and features tree-lined streets, sidewalks and unique architecture. Close proximity to the ocean makes Rio Vista a good choice for those with yachts and other boats looking to live the nautical lifestyle. Many of the waterfront homes are located on Isles with access to deep water. Rio Vista’s location is highly desirable with its deep water canals, no fixed bridges, direct ocean access and its proximity to Downtown Fort Lauderdale. Spanish style architecture is prominent in the larger homes that run in the millions of dollars. Homes are also colonial architectural style. Waterfront homes are more aptly described as estates.

Residents of this luxury neighborhood enjoy quick access to the Atlantic Ocean via the community's eastern waterways. Although a great number of marinas are located close by, many choose to dock their boats and yachts in the waterfront canals right outside of their homes.

Rio Vista offers both upscale and casual dining options to choose from, with a few special offerings different from South Florida’s traditional tropical aura such as Boatyard and 15th Street Fisheries, both sitting right on the marina. Just north of Rio Vista, Riverwalk Fort Lauderdale is a beautiful park on the shores of the New River featuring plenty of places to shop and dine, along with a high number of art galleries and museums.

The community is bounded by Federal Highway (US1) on the west, bordered on the east by the Intracoastal Waterway, south of the New River and north of SE 12th Street. Rio Vista is also very close to Las Olas Boulevard which is also accessible by boat as well as car, and offers outdoor dining, boutique browsing, and art galleries The Fort Lauderdale International Airport is 15 minutes away as is interstate 95 which connects you to the rest of South Florida.

blocks.text: Poinsettia Heights is a neighborhood in the northeast section of Fort Lauderdale, Florida, is adjacent to the neighborhoods of Lake Ridge and Middle River Terrace. Poinsettia Heights, including the subdivisions of Progresso and Lake Ridge, is bordered by Wilton Manors to the North, US-1 to the East, Sunrise Blvd to the South and Dixie Highway to the West. The beautiful beaches of the Atlantic Ocean are just a stone's throw away from the community. Some of Fort Lauderdale's main tourist attractions are located near Poinsettia Heights including the Broward Performing Arts Center, Las Olas Boulevard and The Museum of Discovery and Science.

Poinsettia Heights was rezoned in the 1980s to protect the neighborhood’s suburban charm by not allowing town homes or condos to be built within the neighborhood boundaries, only allowing them to be built on the major roadways that border the area. Despite these restrictions, there’s still plenty of new construction in Poinsettia Heights, with modern single family homes adding a futuristic flair to this classic neighborhood. A combination of classic older homes and recent new construction, the community is quickly gaining popularity due to its old Florida charm and close proximity to downtown and the beaches. Poinsettia Heights also includes some unique waterfront property with lovely views on the landlocked Lake Melva.

The suburban streets feature a mix of classic ranch style homes as well as larger Spanish-inspired designs; however, both styles favoring the bright exteriors and layered clay roofing common throughout southern Florida. The nearby Middle River separates the neighborhood from Wilton Manors to the north and creates plenty of waterfront property, with many houses sporting private docks.

Poinsettia Heights is close to shops, restaurants, parks, the beach, Las Olas, Downtown, and the Galleria Mall, which offers fabulous restaurants, major stores, unique boutiques, and a five star spa. Residents in Poinsettia Heights are surrounded by excellent recreational amenities such as Holiday Park, which features a sports complex, expansive playground, roller hockey rink, gymnasium, dog park. Colohatchee Park, an 8.5-acre community park is just across the river from Poinsettia Heights. This waterfront green space includes 7 acres of mangrove preserves along with an elevated walking path to explore the natural environment. There’s even a fenced dog park for your four-legged friends to run free.

blocks.text: Tucked along the New River just west of downtown Fort Lauderdale, the historic Sailboat Bend community is known for being visually appealing historic and art scenes, like the eclectic home styles like bungalows, Art Deco dwellings and Mission-style properties, which are scattered throughout. Lined with charming sidewalks and unique homes, it's just west of downtown and nestled by the New River. The neighborhood is easily accessible via the I-95 and US-1 highways and has the Broward Center for the Performing Arts in close vicinity. , Sailboat Bend exudes a warm, welcoming hometown feel and is just minutes away from the busy city center. Culture lovers will enjoy the close proximity to the Broward Center for the Performing Arts and the Historic Stranahan House Museum. There is convenient access to outdoor activities, including the Riverwalk Park and Cooley's Landing Marina. The community is only minutes to the Fort Lauderdale International Airport.

Vibrant and cheery, Sailboat Bend is the up-and-comer of Fort Lauderdale neighborhoods. Historic Art Deco homes line the inner blocks, while sleek high-rise condos and town homes take up the riverfront. Waterfront homes are located along Tarpon River, which leads to the ocean with no fixed bridge obstructions. The lush native vegetation and tree canopy adds to the attraction of this historic area of Ft. Lauderdale. The majority of Sailboat Bend homes were built in the 1920’s to early 1930’s and some are now the oldest and most important historic homes in Broward County. Sailboat bend is also known for its “swing bridge”, a 169 ft. bridge was constructed in 1922 and is one of the few of its kind left in Florida. It opens by swinging from side to side.

There is an artistic, even funky atmosphere to the neighborhood. Arts venues, bars, museums, nightclubs and quirky sculptures are part of the experience. Bungalows and ranch-style homes dating to the early 1900s make up a core part of the housing inventory. Century-old trees, and palm trees add a dash of coastal flair to the neighborhood.

In the Fort Lauderdale suburbs, the groceries aisles are never too far. The Westside Market is nearby as well as the New River Open Market, where you can buy crisp produce and gourmet delicacies. There are several coffee shops and cafes, with their rustic vibes close by. This diverse Fort Lauderdale neighborhood gets an equally blended fitness scene. A low-key version of downtown nightlife, Sailboat Bend has spots for both entertainment and partying.

blocks.text: Sunrise Intracoastal is a captivating private peninsula community with Intracoastal frontage to its East and the Middle River to the South and West. It is a charming hide-away with a guardhouse/gated entry and is tucked away between Sunrise Boulevard and the Las Olas Isles. Beautiful tree-lined streets and a private park and playground are other attributes that truly set this lovely Fort Lauderdale neighborhood apart.

Sunrise Intracoastal homes include a mixture of single-family homes, condos and townhomes. The area offers a mixture of waterfront and dry lot homes. There are fewer than 200 single family homes in the neighborhood, giving it a very charming, private feel that begins at the guardhouse gate. In this upscale neighborhood homes range in style from traditional, to Mediterranean, and contemporary. About one-third of the homes sit directly on the Intracoastal or Middle River and there are a number of oversized point lots with wide, unobstructed views. The neighborhood actually forms a peninsula surrounded by the Intracoastal Waterway to the East and the Middle River to the South and West. For those homes on the water, boaters can enjoy direct access to the Intracoastal Waterway and Atlantic Ocean with no fixed bridges getting in the way. Sunrise Intracoastal’s unique shape allow it to have a number of waterfront homes and dry lot homes that are highly desirable given the central location and access to water.

It is a great enough distance away from Sunrise Boulevard that it enjoys privacy however all of the Sunrise Intracoastal homes are within walking distance to Galleria Shopping Mall and a chic area of restaurants located around the mall. These homes run in the multi millions and are in a variety of architectural styles.

Boutique shopping, dining, entertainment, museums, top-rated schools, Fort Lauderdale Beach and the Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport are only minutes away by car. Located just blocks from the beach, shopping and restaurants, as well as a short drive to the city’s downtown, Sunrise Intracoastal offers residents a safe, vibrant environment.

Popular destinations in the area include Las Olas Boulevard, The Broward Center of the Performing Arts in Downtown Fort Lauderdale, and The Galleria Mall. Golfing, tennis, yacht clubs and more are only a short car ride away. Sunrise Intracoastal is close to the Fort Lauderdale International Airport, under 15 minutes and interstate 95 which links you to all that is available in South Florida.

blocks.text: A golf sanctuary, tucked away just minutes away from I-95, the Florida Turnpike, Vero Beach and Downtown Fort Pierce, Meadowood Golf and Tennis Club redefines the private golf and tennis club experience.

The moment you arrive, you feel it. A gentle peace. The wonderful feeling that you have stumbled upon something special created just for you. Meadowood Golf and Tennis Club is an oasis of golf, tennis, swimming, and social camaraderie, offering a variety of choices designed to complement your lifestyle. The Charles Ankrom designed 18-hole championship course offers a challenging yet fair test for golfers of all levels and is recognized as one of the finest courses on the Treasure Coast.

Golf legend Sam Snead, winner of three Masters' Tournaments plus many other major golf titles, made his winter home here for 14 years. In 1988 Sam Snead became the Resident Golf Pro Emeritus. While he was here he was either playing a round, on the practice tee or regaling members with tales of his many golf experiences. The Club celebrated Sam’s 90th birthday in the Spring of 2002 - just before he left to hit his last opening shot at the Masters.

Skyview Golf and Country Club is a neighborhood of homes in Hernando, Fl. Skyview at Terra Vista Golf and Country Club is the crowning jewel and is the newest and most notable addition to the golf community. With a combination of traditional country-club lifestyle, new amenities, and member-driven activities, this golf community attracts both retirees and working families. Skyview at Terra Vista Golf and Country Club has the highest elevation of Florida's central ridge offering views of the Gulf Coast and the large hillside estate. Terra Vista is a private, gated community where residents enjoy panoramic views and resort-style living.

Terra Vista of Citrus Hills community encompasses the Skyview golf course offering single family and detached villa homes ranging from 1,700-4,000 square feet in living area. This community offers an amenity rich lifestyle and wide spectrum of housing opportunities to accommodate a variety of budgets and tastes. The country club offers a little bit of everything for its residents, including fine dining, shopping, swimming, two tennis centers that includes the Skyview Tennis Center and Tennis Pro Shop, spas, and much more. There is also the 45,000-square feet Bella Vita Spa and Fitness Center, multiple clubhouses with a choice of outdoor pools, a walking path, and an extensive schedule of social and entertainment activities. Dining options at this golf community include three private restaurants that offer casual to fine dining in two different clubhouse facilities, The Tiki Bar, The Grille Room Restaurant and Lounge, and Skyview at Terra Vista. The Skyview Restaurant is the centerpiece of the Skyview golf course and offers lunch, drinks, and fine casual dining to residents and golfers.

All residents hold social membership and have access to four golf courses, including the Skyview Course, Oaks Course, Meadows Course, and Brentwood Farms Golf Course. Amenities include three 18-hole golf courses and one 9-hole course.

Skyview at Terra Vista Golf and Country Club is located in the heart of Citrus Hills and Florida's Nature Coast region and is just ten minutes from the Gulf of Mexico's beaches and sport-fishing marinas. Nearly half of Citrus County is a natural habitat protected from development. It features the 46-mile Withlacoochee State Trail, perfect for hiking and biking excursions, while other popular attractions in Orlando and Tampa are just an hour away.

/neighborhood/the-villages-of-citrus-hil.description: The Villages of Citrus Hills Homes for Sale Citrus Hills Homes for.

blocks.text: 2400 N Terra Vista Blvd Hernando, FL 34442

The Villages of Citrus Hills, located in Hernando, will boast approximately 10,000 spacious, high-end homes. The Villages of Citrus Hills contains several distinct neighborhoods, or villages, which are commonly referred to as Terra Vista of Citrus Hills, Brentwood of Citrus Hills, Canterbury Lakes of Citrus Hills, and Belmont Hills of Citrus Hills, among others.

The opulent homes within The Villages of Citrus Hills are available as both traditional single-family homes and detached villas. The detached villas differ from single-family homes only in that they offer the advantage of being care-free. Care-free single-family homes at The Villages of Citrus Hills offers 2-3 bedrooms plus den and are 1,666-3,061 square feet of living space. Single-family residences offer 2-3 bedrooms ranging from 2,182-3,952 square feet of living space. Some lots are set on large, open homesites, while others feature more secluded lots. Terra Vista of Citrus Hills is a gated community that is set on a hillside with a spectacular view of Citrus County.

The Villages of Citrus Hills is open to all ages. Some neighborhoods are gated for those who prefer added security. All residents enjoy access to the multiple clubhouses found throughout The Villages of Citrus Hills. The abundance of amenities provided throughout The Villages of Citrus Hills will keep even the most active of residents entertained. In addition to the amenities offered at multiple clubhouses, this community also boasts three 18-hole championship golf courses. The Villages of Citrus Hills offers many social groups and classes designed to engage residents. Some neighborhoods in The Villages of Citrus Hills require social memberships in order to use certain amenities.

At the BellaVita Spa and Fitness Center, residents of The Villages of Citrus Hills can make use of the amenities offered in a collection of smaller buildings. The state-of-the-art-fitness center has cardiovascular equipment and two racquetball courts. There are also yoga, aerobics and spin rooms, an indoor lap pool, whirlpool spa, saunas, and steam rooms. A full-service day spa provides a variety of facials and massages as well as hair and nail treatments.

Restaurants, pro shops, and tennis courts are also available at the Skyview Clubhouse and Oaks and Meadows Clubhouse. The Skyview Clubhouse features a Har-Tru tennis facility, while the Oaks and Meadows Clubhouse offers a hard-surface tennis center.

For outdoor swimming and poolside entertainment, residents of The Villages of Citrus Hills can visit either the Brentwood Clubhouse or the Belmont Hills outdoor pool and cabana. The Central Activity Center provides additional amenities including another outdoor pool, state-of-the-art fitness center, 400-seat community theatre, billiards, card room, media center, and pickleball, basketball, and bocce ball courts. Homeowners also have access to a tot lot, dog park, and plenty of walking trails.

The Villages of Citrus Hills is set within Hernando, Florida in the center of Citrus County. This beautiful area is located near the gulf coast and lies just north of the Withlacoochee State Forest. Citrus County is 70 miles north of Tampa and 60 miles northwest of Orlando. With beautiful beaches, state parks, shopping, dining, and cultural attractions, there are plenty of recreational activities found within the surrounding areas. Many necessities are centrally located within Citrus Hills, including a Publix Grocery Store, Walgreens Pharmacy, and Suntrust Bank. Fast food restaurants, a medical clinic, gas station and other conveniences are also located within the community, as well as a salon and day spa.

blocks.text: 8700 SE Retreat Dr Hobe Sound, FL 33455

The Retreat is a non-gated community, located in Hobe Sound. The Retreat at Seabranch was acknowledged as a Community of Excellence in an article for the December 2009 issue of the Florida Community Association Journal.

The Retreat at Seabranch is a 555-home community surrounded by Martin County’s beautiful 4,886-acre Atlantic Ridge Preserve State Park. Nestled amid ten stocked lakes and seven wetlands, the Retreat consists of 312 2-bedroom Capris models, 178 3-bedroom Oakmonts models, and 65 4-bedroom Carlyle models, built by DiVosta. The homes benefit from DiVosta's poured reinforced concrete construction which has survived the direct hit hurricanes of 2004 with little or no building damage, and recently Hurricanes Matthew and Irma with just minimal foliage damage.

Homeowners are Members in the Retreat at Seabranch Homeowners Association, which is managed by a five-person Board of Directors who are elected by the membership for two-year terms. The day-to-day management is contracted to Signature Property Management of Martin and St.Lucie Counties. Prudent oversight has resulted in a position of strong financial reserves and stable HOA fees. The Retreat retains outside professional legal, financial, and engineering consultants.

The amenities include a beautiful, large community swimming pool with adjacent clubhouse, a well-equipped exercise facility, and four tennis/pickleball courts. The Retreat is adjacent to the semi-private, non-equity Lost Lake Golf Club that offers golf and social memberships.

The Retreat Women's Club actively supports numerous local charities and provides a variety of opportunities for women to welcome new residents, make new friends, and share field trips and lunches together. Our Retreat Assistance Network (RAN) provides peer assistance and support to any resident in need of help due to health, sickness, or necessity. Other groups include Duplicate Bridge, Mah Jongg, Pickleball, Poker, Red Hat Society, and an active knitting group.

blocks.text: Martin and St Lucie Counties real estate on Hutchinson Island holds some of Florida's most prestigious waterfront real estate and oceanfront condos. Real Estate of Florida knows the area well and will help you purchase or sell your own slice of beach heaven on Hutchinson Island.

As a barrier island along the upper southeast coast of Florida, Hutchinson Island gives residents access to a vast array of watersports and marine activities including environmental education for families. Hutchinson Island has the Treasure Coast's longest public beaches, finest resort hotels and most interesting attractions.

Some of the highlights of living on this island are horseback riding on the beach and sea turtle walks. Hutchinson Island is one of the few areas in all of Florida that allow horseback riding along the surf. Florida Power & Light sponsors turtle walks twice a week during the summer months for families to watch endangered sea turtles lay their eggs on the same beaches they've been returning to for hundreds of years. The island is also home to some fabulous educational museums like The Elliot Museum, which houses some of the finest collections of the golden age of american creativity including antiques, fine arts, sports memorabilia and vintage cars; The House of Refuge, which is the oldest surviving building in Martin County; the Florida Oceanographic Society that works to protect the Martin County ecosystem through education and research; the Navy UDT-SEAL Museum and the Manatee Observation and Education Center.
Raise your children or enjoy your retirement in this beach paradise and education resort area. Real Estate of Florida will help you find your new Hutchinson Island home!

blocks.text: Oceancrest is a uniquely shaped condo sitting on a corner of Beach Road and A1A across from the beach in Jupiter. Ranch Colony is a gated, equestrian community located in Jupiter, located in North Palm Beach. Homesites span from ¾ an acre to over 100 acres. Real estate in Ranch Colony is comprised of single-family homes, many of which include separate guest cottages, backyard stables, riding rings, tack rooms, and wash racks.

Ranch Colony is comprised of 257 custom built homes divided amongst five distinct subdivisions. The five subdivisions within Ranch Colony are: Tailwinds, Ranch Estates, Ranch Acres, Old Trail and The Links.

The 40 homes here come with pastures, stalls, barns, kennels, riding arenas, and plenty of space to build.

The Links subdivision in Ranch Colony is perfect for the keen golfer. Residents are surrounded by an 18-hole Pete Dye designed golf course. There are 51 Homesites here that range in size from 1-5 acres and offer privacy and seclusion. blocks.text: Located on 340 acres of land, The Loxahatchee Club community features 285 homes and a variety of amenities for residents to enjoy. Situated in Jupiter, Florida, just north of Palm Beach in Jupiter, the area boasts 71 acres of fresh-water lakes and 40 acres of greenbelt. The clubhouse is also available for private functions.

blocks.text: Storey Lake Resort is a gated resort masterplan community located right in the heart of Kissimmee, close to Osceola Parkway. that features single family, townhomes and spacious condos just minutes from the best attractions Central Florida has to offer, with easy access to Walt Disney World, Universal Orlando, Sea World Orlando, several top golf courses and popular shopping, as well as Lake Tohopekaliga and multiple beaches along the Atlantic. A free golf cart shuttle service transports guests to the different clubhouses and their vacation rentals. The Clubhouse pools and the lazy river are heated all year round, the pool in the condo section is not heated.

blocks.text: The Silver Lakes community is one of the single largest developments in Broward County, comprised of 39 gated and non-gated subdivisions, each with its own appeal, filled with single family homes and town-homes. Silver Lakes stretches from Sheridan Street, Pembroke Pines, south all the way to Miramar Parkway, covering 2,400 acres of land, offering miles of beautiful parks, vibrant wetlands, lovely tree lined streets and recreational areas. Silver Lakes is a community of 5,626 homes that feature 2-7 bedrooms and range from 1,176 square feet to 4,842 square feet in living area.

Amenities include pool, sun deck, clubhouse, recreation center, European health spa, lakeside walking trails and parks. Some events unite the community, like happy hour events at the Silver Lake Sports Grill on 180th Avenue or the annual pumpkin patch event with hayrides and live music. Silver Lakes hosts the regional women's softball tournament. Parks in the area are Silver Lakes North with basketball, grills and picnic areas, Silver Lakes Community Park with grills, picnic area and pool, and Silver Lakes South with baseball, softball, basketball and grills.

The neighborhood, which is in close proximity to major highways providing convenient travel in all directions, and is also home to multiple parks and green spaces providing opportunity for a broad range of recreational activities. Located south of I-75 and west of I-95, commuting to Fort Lauderdale International Airport or Miami International Airport is easily accessible.

/neighborhood/ocala-preserve.name: Ocala Preserve
/neighborhood/ocala-preserve.title: Ocala Preserve

blocks.text: Ocala Preserve is a resort-style master planned community in Central Floriday featuring both 55+ neighborhoods and non-age-restricted sections. This luxurious community consists of about 1,800 single family and attached duplex homes sprawled across 623 acres of lush landscaping. The community is built with innovative architectural designs, and energy-efficient materials and offers residents a wide variety of resort-style amenities such as a spacious clubhouse and a 24-hole golf course. Ideally situated in Marion County, Ocala Preserve is only a mile-and-a-half from Interstate 75 and a short drive to larger cities such as Gainesville, Tampa, and Orlando. Ocala Preserve is close to plenty of dining, shopping, entertainment, and other attractions for everyday necessities.

All homes offer open layouts as well as indoor and outdoor living spaces and an easy maintenance lifestyle. There are various collections for homebuyers to choose from. The Resort Collection of villas range from 2-4 bedroom with 1320-2214 square feet and 2 car garages. The Rivera Collection offers 2-3 bedrooms from 1276-1463 square feet and 2 car garages. The Escape Collection has 2-bedroom single family homes from 1449-1928 square feet with 2 car garages. The Freedom Collection offers homes with 2-3 bedrooms ranging from 1631-2370 square feet and 2 car garages.

The resort club, Oak House, offers 17,000 square-feet of recreational and social space. The clubhouse has a signature full-service restaurant and bar, private dining room, state-of-the-art fitness center, day spa and salon, concierge, culinary studio, card and game room, and grand living room.

Additional amenities include an outdoor zero-entry resort-style pool, lakeside veranda, bocce ball, multiple tennis and pickleball courts, a Tom Lehman–designed golf course, golf pro shop, and 10 miles of walking and biking trails. Residents also enjoy a seven-acre pond in the center of the neighborhood and a community park.

This location puts residents close to many attractions and everyday conveniences. Ocala Preserve is close to grocery stores and several health care providers, including Ocala Region Medical Center, Kindred Hospital Ocala, and West Marion Community Hospital. Homeowners looking for dining and entertainment can travel along Old Blitchton Road and West Silver Springs Boulevard which are home to restaurants, bars, and cafes. Ocala's historic downtown square, home to Brick City Center for the Arts, Ocala Civic Theater, and Central Florida's Symphony Orchestra are just a short drive. Disney World and Orlando are an hour away. Ocala International Airport is only eleven minutes away.

blocks.text: Metrowest is an 1,805-acre master-planned community consisting of residential, commercial, and businesses in Orlando. The development has about 1.5 miles of lake frontage. Developed with a focus on creating an environment where people can enjoy a strong sense of community, Metrowest's housing options include single-family homes, townhomes, condos, and apartments. The community has grown to over 10,000 residential units, over 750,000 square feet of retail and restaurant space, and 1.4 million square feet of office space. The vast housing options available offer something for everyone with more than 700 single-family homes, and over 1,300 apartments, villas, and condos. Homes in Metrowest range in size from 500 square feet to upwards of 4,000 square feet.

In addition, the development is designed to support healthy lifestyles with numerous outdoor facilities that include an 18-hole championship golf course, numerous parks, recreational facilities, and more. Many of the residences that are older have been completely remodeled with modern fixtures and finishes. The development is beautifully maintained with tropical landscaping, tree-lined streets, and breathtaking common areas.

Metrowest is located southwest of downtown Orlando, with the main entrance situated on MetroWest Boulevard, bounded by Kirkman Road to the east; by Turkey Lake to the southeast; by Pembrooke Pines development to the south; by the Florida Turnpike to the southwest; Apopka-Vineland Road on its western tip; and to the north by Steer Lake Road, Edgewood Children's Ranch, Lake Hiawassee and Orlo Vista, Florida. Bisecting the middle of the development, winding from north to south, is South Hiawassee Road, which also serves as the main entrance coming from the north and only entrance from the south. The main entrance of MetroWest is only 2.5 miles north of Universal Studios Orlando.

/neighborhood/on-top-of-the-world.description: On Top of the World Ocala Homes for.

blocks.text: Located just six and a half miles west of Interstate 75, On Top of the World Ocala is a scenic 55+ community in the heart of Central Florida. The planned 10,000 homes make the community one of the largest in the state. This community has attracted retirees from across the country with its finely crafted homes, world-class amenities, and active and low-maintenance lifestyle. On Top of the World real estate features a variety of unique floor plans designed for low-maintenance living. Homebuyers can choose from single-family homes and attached villas that range from approximately 1,000 to over 3,000 square feet. Buyers looking for On Top of the World Ocala resales can select from intimate villas all the way to stately homes with golf course views.

This 55+ community is divided into two distinct communities with several neighborhoods to choose from, depending on the buyer's budget and the conveniences included. The Villas attached homes offer 1,092 to 1,856 square feet. These homes have two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and attached one or two-car garages. The single-family homes of On Top of the World Ocala come in seven collections and more than 100 floor plans. These homes range from 1,204 to 3,039 square feet and offer two to three bedrooms with attached two- Three-and-a-half-car garages. Many of these homes also offer den spaces.

The single-family homes of On Top of the World Ocala come in seven collections and more than 100 floor plans. These homes range from 1,204 to 3,039 square feet and offer two to three bedrooms and bathrooms with attached two- to three-and-a-half-car garages.

This community has myriad facilities that include amenities such as three golf courses, several clubhouses, fitness centers, swimming pools, tennis and pickleball courts, restaurants, even an R/C airplane field, and an R/C car track. The Recreation Center, Hobby Building, Arbor Club, and Conference Center are all open to residents. There are three 18-hole golf courses at On Top of the World Ocala. There are two restaurants available: The Pub, which is reserved for residents and their guests, and The Club at Candler Hills, which is adjacent to the golf course and is open to the public. Circle Square Commons is the entertainment and social hub for the public and On Top of the World Ocala residents. Circle Square Cultural Center at Circle Square Commons brings top-name entertainment to the Ocala area, featuring various events and performers every year. This beautiful auditorium also hosts theatrical productions, dances, conventions, expos, fundraising events, and more. The adult learning center offers several hundred courses throughout the year, including academic and special interests, fine arts and crafts, health and wellness, computer training, and culinary classes.

The Ranch Fitness Center and Spa is Ocala's first world-class spa and state-of-the-art fitness center designed to provide cardiovascular and strength-training equipment with specialized fitness programs. In addition to the fitness center, The Ranch also includes a full-service day spa and professional salon.

There are also several everyday conveniences located right at The Commons such as an ice cream shop, deli, and a weekly farmers market with fresh, locally grown produce. Anchoring the Circle Square Commons is the Town Square, which showcases live entertainment every Friday and Saturday evening.
Visiting metropolitan areas as On Top of the World Ocala is just about 30 minutes away from Historic Downtown Ocala and Ocala International Airport is just 15 minutes from the community.

blocks.text: Stone Creek is a gated active adult community where the residences enjoy a low-maintenance lifestyle. Stone Creek is a neighborhood located in Ocala offering an assortment of beautiful styles, varying sizes and affordable prices to choose from. There are 3800 attached and single-family homes varying in size from around 1,100 square feet to over 2,700 square feet. Stone Creek is a gated active adult community which is planned to feature 3,800 attached and single-family homes. The blend of appealing home designs, top-notch amenities, and a robust lifestyle in a community that still retains a small-town feel make it an attractive setting for Florida retirement living. There are the Twin Villas, Pinnacle Series and Regal Series. The newer Garden, Classic and Estate Series include one to five bedrooms and range from 1133 to 2634 square feet.
Stone Creek Golf Club is right there, providing unique challenges for golfers right at their doorstep. Golf enthusiasts will enjoy the 18-hole championship golf course that is situated on 187 acres.

Stone Creek offers residents a wide selection of amenities. The Reflection Bay social and recreational complex spans 29 acres and is 60,000 square feet. It features two indoor facilities that are reserved for social and fitness activities. The social hub, known as the Reunion Center, is the ideal gathering place for activities, club meetings, and events. There is also a large ballroom with a stage that hosts parties, dances, and theatrical performances. In addition, there is a meeting room, a billiards room, a catering kitchen, a card room, and a craft room with a kiln, which allows residents to express their creativity. The Wallstreet Room is the center's library area. Elan Spa & Resort Pool is the fitness complex and includes some of the latest high-end cardiovascular and weight-training equipment. The fitness area also includes an aerobics and dance studio, massage services, an indoor lap pool, an indoor spa, an outdoor resort-style pool with beach entry, and an outdoor spa. There is an on-site community activities director.

The well-maintained grounds are home to a variety of recreation and sports courts including a softball field, horseshoes, and tennis, pickleball, and bocce ball courts. A spacious picnic pavilion and event lawn are also available for homeowners. There is a great fishing lake and pier as well as miles of walking and biking trails.

Ideally situated in the heart of central Florida, homeowners are just 30 miles to the Gulf of Mexico and 90 minutes to popular destinations such as Disney World, Universal Studios, Daytona Beach, and the Kennedy Space Center.

blocks.text: Rio Pinar is an established single-family community that has established a long-standing presence in the Orlando area. Its namesake, the Rio Pinar Golf Club, has been a fixture on the Orlando landscape since the early 1960s. Many of the homes surrounding the community were built in the mid-1970s and The Villages feature newer homes built in the mid-2000s. The homes range in size, age, and design with exterior elevations varying from traditional to ranch-style.

The community reflects Old World Florida charm with mature trees and lush landscaping. Many of the homes have been renovated with updated kitchens finished in granite countertops, custom cabinets, stainless steel appliances, and center islands; some homes have private pools, covered patios, and fenced backyards. The family-friendly neighborhood is beautifully maintained and clean despite having no governing HOA and no monthly dues.

The Rio Pinar community spans two square miles bordered by major roads of Lake Underhill, South Goldenrod, and South Econlockhatchee. Rio Pinar homes range in size from around 1,100 square feet to over 6,000 square feet, and boast proximity to several parks, nature preserves, and recreational facilities. Rio Pinar Estates is a neighborhood of homes offering an assortment of beautiful styles, varying sizes and affordable prices to choose from, ranging in square footage around 2,000 square feet.

blocks.text: 11800 Old Palm Drive Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33418

Old Palm Golf Club is a 650-acre private residential golf community with an equity club located in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. Old Palm is one of the most prestigious golf communities in the United States, and offers all the amenities of a country club, with luxurious homes and exceptional amenities, as well as catering to the ultimate golfer. The tournament-caliber golf course at Old Palm gets a lot of the community’s attention. Additional amenities, including privacy, with a gate staffed round the clock. Old Palm is located six miles from the Atlantic Ocean, and while it’s far from inexpensive, it’s in the ballpark of surrounding communities despite its exclusivity and high-golf status.

Pennock Point combines the beauty of being located on the shimmering waters of the Loxahatchee River in Jupiter with homesites that are more than ½ acre. This community offers unrivaled spectacular views along the western part of the Jupiter Inlet, allowing residents to take their yacht directly from their own backyard right into the Intracoastal or Atlantic Ocean to go fishing, cruising, jet skiing, or to play on the water, all within minutes. Residents can take advantage of the views and the unforgettable sunsets and sunrises that are framed with tropical landscaping, which include many varieties of palm trees.

Pennock Point is comprised of a total of 119 single family homes, with 2-7 bedrooms and 9 bathrooms, square footages range anywhere between 1,144 and 11,500 square feet of living area. Pennock Pointe Estates is a 28-home enclave with a beautiful park-like setting and sidewalks framed with wonderfully manicured tropical landscaped lots from ½ an acre to ¾ of an acre deep, giving residents true backyards. The mansions feature everything from Key West to Addison Mizner architecture and are designed using the finest materials and perfect attention to detail, to create a buyer’s dream home. Builders typically pay close attention to the outdoor living and construct amazing resort-style swimming pools, including everything from Tiki huts to incredible loggias.

There are many marinas in Jupiter or Tequesta that are ideal to store practically any sized boat. Non-boaters can purchase existing homes or build on lots that are not on the water for a fraction of the price. Pennock Point can be reached via Loxahatchee River Road. Amenities include boating, as it is a boater's paradise, private docks, and easy access to shops, restaurants, and Jupiter Inlet by boat. Resident children attend A-rated public schools

Pennock Point Road is the main street. There are many fine restaurants and shops within close proximity, with an easy work commute access to US 1, I-95, and the Florida Turnpike. There is so much to enjoy within this riverfront community retreat, just minutes from the Jupiter Inlet.

blocks.text: 7500 Old Marsh Rd Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33418

Nestled in a strikingly beautiful wetlands preserve, Old Marsh Golf Club is a private, gated luxury golf course community of 456-acres of 186 single family homes offering vast wild life and serenity. Located on the corner of PGA Boulevard and Central Boulevard, Old Marsh Golf Club is adjacent to Old Palm Golf Club, and it is just a few miles away from PGA National Resort and Golf Club. Residents appreciate the close proximity to nearby restaurants such as The Cooper, Vic and Angelos, Spotos Oyster Bar and Rocco Tacos. Nearby attractions include Downtown at the Gardens, the Gardens Mall, Juno Beach Pier, the Eissey Center, and Roger Den Stadium. With both ingress and egress to I-95 and the Florida Turnpike, residents easily commute to downtown West Palm Beach, the Palm Beach International Airport.

Homes in Old Marsh Golf Club range from a charming, single-story home to an expansive, custom estate. Many of the homes have been recently renovated and feature backyard swimming pools, covered lanais, gourmet kitchens, marble floors, well-appointed interior finishes, and panoramic views of the immaculate golf course, pristine lake, or marsh preserve. Each custom estate home is created with old world charm and is exquisitely designed. The magnificent homes of Old Marsh coupled with the pristine natural landscape have played an integral role in the overall character of the Club.

The golf course is unforgettably picturesque with its abundant species of wildlife such as the three-foot high Sandhill Crane, Egrets, endangered Wood Storks, Bobcats, Florida Deer, and even American Bald Eagles. Overlooking the ninth and eighteenth holes sits the majestic yet unpretentious clubhouse. This 30,000 square foot structure resembles an Old-world Mediterranean-style estate. the clubhouse serves both casual and complicated cuisine fitting for any palate and preference. Membership to Old Marsh Golf Club is by invitation-only and is capped at 300 members, ensuring all members the best personal attention from staff with the club maintaining its intimate ambiance.

The Mirasol Country Club is a 2,300-acre gated community featuring 25 unique residential villages consisting of villas, cottages and estate homes, some homes offering golf, waterfront, and natural preserve settings. Located in the heart of Palm Beach Gardens, just north of PGA Boulevard and west of the Florida Turnpike, Mirasol is a unique community, known for its Mediterranean-inspired architecture, interesting structural details, and strong construction. While construction in Mirasol Country Club began in 2002, modern custom designed estate homes continue to be built today.

Amenities in Mirasol Country Club include the 50,000 square foot grand clubhouse, two fantastic golf courses, Tom Fazio and Arthur Hills, a pro shop, the 17,000 square feet Esplanade Sports and Fitness Center featuring 15 clay tennis courts, men’s and women’s locker rooms with steam and massage rooms, state-of-the-art fitness center, swimming pool complete with lap lanes and a soothing spa. Just outside the gates is the 5-mile Mirasol Trail and a 15-acre community park featuring, softball, soccer and football fields, volleyball courts, playground, jogging train, picnic areas, concession building, restrooms and more. It is required to purchase an equity membership when you purchase a home in Mirasol. The three memberships offered Social, Sports and Golf. Additional amenities include tennis courts, biking and jogging trails, clubhouse, game room, fitness center, swimming pool, picnic area, and easy access to shops, restaurants, and the Florida Turnpike. Resident children attend A-rated public schools.

Palm Pointe/Palm Isles is a gated community of 143 homes in Palm City, about 10 miles from the beautiful beaches of Stuart on Florida's Atlantic coast. It's an ideal spot, conveniently located near schools, Palm City's shopping district, Florida's Turnpike and I-95.

The Homeowners Association provides for the care and upkeep of all landscaping in the front and side yards and common areas including a master irrigation system for the entire community. Paradise. It’s the only way to describe living in a private, tropical retreat along the St. Lucie River in Palm City, Florida. Just 302 residences are nestled among 600 acres of lush, natural preserve areas, and secluded waterfront with excellent waterway access. Located on Florida’s Treasure Coast, Martin County is known for its stunning residential ambiance and abundance of waterways, and yet is just north of the world-class shopping of the Palm Beaches.

Stroll through our exceptional nature preserves, tropical atmosphere, and 29 lakes brimming with bass. Piper’s Landing has been officially designated a wildlife sanctuary, and it’s not unusual for a conversation between Piper's residents to start with “What animals have you seen lately?" Wildlife that have been spotted at Piper’s include: sandhill cranes, bald eagles, hawks, ospreys, owls, herons, egrets, pelicans, bobcats, foxes, armadillos, wild boar, manatees, the occasional alligator and even a Florida panther.

Enjoy the ultimate concierge lifestyle with country club amenities and casual elegance only offered in the finest 5-star resorts. There are numerous activities to fill your days, or if you prefer, borrow a book from our library, get together with friends for a game of bridge, or run your dog on the miles of cart paths. Treat yourself to a massage, or rejuvenate the mind and body with exercise such as yoga or water aerobics in one of our six community pools. Pamper your palate with creations designed by an award-winning chef served up in a spacious clubhouse or your own home.

Our Gene Bates championship golf course is a challenging design of 6,922 yards (6,329 meters) that will beckon your return. Due to the exclusivity of the Club, we pride ourselves on being one of the only courses in South Florida where you can be assured of a tee time that works for you. Our course is artfully designed to become five different courses of play, offering any skill-level of golfer a challenge that never loses its allure.

A harbor that has been naturally protected for hundreds of years, yet has excellent water access, is a rare combination in Florida. Sail into the Indian River Lagoon and the Atlantic Ocean from our newly-remodeled naturally protected yacht basin, one of the safest in the region and one of the most accessible on Florida’s east coast. Our waters are the Sailfish Capital of the World, and they provide some of the best fishing in Florida because of a large, unique estuary, famous since the turn of the 20th century.

/neighborhood/Rustic_Hills.description: Rustic Hills Palm City Florida MLS real estate search for sale Martin.

blocks.text: 1470 SW Covered Bridge Drive Palm City, FL 34990

Rustic Hills offers a combination of urban and rural luxuries not found elsewhere on the Treasure Coast. Developed in the early 1970’s, Rustic Hills features a wooden covered bridge entrance and is comprised of 178 residential sites. All but 14 of these sites are waterfront and lead to the St. Lucie River and the Atlantic Ocean. 10 of the 14 dry sites have deeded waterfront access. Most of the original homes have undergone either complete renovation, or have been replaced with newer homes. Private, paved roads insure privacy and a wooded setting gives the area its rustic charm.

Rustic Hills Home Owners Association is responsible for administration and management. Property Owners are automatically members of the Association. There are no dues, but members pay a yearly fee to cover the costs of maintenance of the canals and roads. Owners are responsible for maintenance of their own property, including landscaping, and for complying with published Deed Restrictions.

The Rustic Hills area provides all crucial urban conveniences. The area has its charming historic districts, excellent restaurants, extensive shopping, stimulating cultural offerings, outstanding medical facilities and superb educational institutions.

Stuart West can be best described as a suburban lifestyle set among the best of country living. This 1000-acre residential neighborhood in Palm City, FL is a gated community with a 24/7 manned gate. Limited to only 249 lots of 2 to 10+ acres, the community is abundant with green space and features 300 acres of nature preserves providing a sanctuary to many species of Florida wildlife. Over 11 miles of waterways intertwined throughout the community provide beautiful reflections of sunrises and sunsets.

With over 10 miles of paved roadways and limited traffic, Stuart West provides a great environment for biking, rollerblading, walking, running or taking a leisurely golf cart ride to visit the 8 acre community park, visiting with horses, or fishing for bass in the fresh water canals.

Located in Martin County’s A-rated school system, Stuart West has bus pick and drop off for the children living in the community.

Whether you are a horse lover, nature enthusiast, or seeking that somewhere between country and suburbia, Stuart West offers something for everyone. Large estate homes located on multiple-acre lots in highly-desired city of Palm City, Florida.

/neighborhood/pembroke-lakes.description: Pembroke Lakes Homes for Sale Pembroke Pines Homes for.

blocks.text: W Golfview Dr Pembroke Pines, FL 33026

Pembroke Lakes is a luxury single-family community of golf homes in Pembroke Pines, offering an assortment of beautiful styles, varying sizes, and affordable prices to choose from. Along the palm tree-lined streets of Pembroke Lakes, you’ll mostly find ranch-style homes with brick or stucco exteriors, as well as traditional concrete block homes, and Spanish and Mediterranean styles with barrel roof tiles and porticos.

Pembroke Lakes ranges in square footage from quite modest sizes to over 4,075-square feet of living area with 2-5 bedrooms. There are three parks within the neighborhood and a baseball field a few blocks away. The 108th Avenue Kiddie Park has two shaded playgrounds where kids can climb and swing. Nearby, Flamingo Park frequently hosts youth sports leagues and boasts over 10 baseball fields and four batting cages.

The community is centered around the Pembroke Lakes Golf and Racquet Club which features both hard and clay tennis courts and an 18-hole championship golf course. The club’s tennis center boasts nine hard and five clay tennis courts.

Pembroke Lakes features many other amenities for its residents and is situated just a few miles from the dazzling beaches of the Atlantic coastline, amazing seaside boardwalks, and waterfront cafes. Residents of the community also enjoy easy access to major highways, I-75, and Florida's Turnpike to the east making getting to and from major attractions, entertainment venues, employment, parks, and other nearby golf courses convenient. Pembroke Pines is home to over 28 beautiful parks and recreational facilities.
Publix is located in the Village Square shopping center and the Pembroke Lakes Mall is close by. There is easy access to I95, I75, and the Florida Turnpike.

/neighborhood/The_Meadows.description: The Meadows Brighton Foxboro Greenwich Lakemont Mayflower Ridgewood Palm City Florida MLS real estate search for sale Martin.

blocks.text: 2550 SW Waterfall Boulevard Palm City, FL 34990

The Meadows at Martin Downs is a residential development located in Palm City, Florida. The 832 units at The Meadows are divided into 6 neighborhoods or Villages -- Greenwich, Lakemont, Mayflower, Brighton, Foxboro and Ridgewood -- consisting of single-family homes, duplexes, 4 unit townhouses, and 4 unit patio homes.

The Meadows is a gated community with round-the-clock security. The community provides for its residents a large heated swimming pool, a kiddies' pool, a children's playground adjacent to the pool, a basket ball hoop, 3 lighted tennis courts, a horseshoe pit and 2 bocce courts. Near the entrance of the Meadows, between the gatehouse and the fountain, is a 2200 square foot recreation center, known as The Meadows House, which also houses the administrative offices of The Meadows Homeowners Association.

Divosta started construction on the site known as The Meadows in 1988. In 1989 a Single Family Home area , now part of Brighton Village, was started with the Hampton model. In 1991 a Multiple Family area, now known as Ridgewood Village, was started with the first Sun Terrace building, a four unit Patio Home. Also built here was the first section of Capri homes, a two family patio home. In 1990 another Single Family Home area, Mayflower Village, was started, offering the Bedford model. In 1992 a new Single Family Home model known as a Carmel was added to the nearly built Mayflower Village. Only thirteen (13) of these homes were built. In 1992 a second section of Capri homes was built in Ridgewood Village. In 1993-1994, Foxboro Village was constructed with Capri Homes.

In July of 1993 Divosta, who until then ran the Homeowners Association, turned over control of the Homeowners Association to the homeowners' elected Board of Directors which then took over the management and maintenance of the 6 Meadows villages.

/neighborhood/Sawgrass-Lakes.title: Sawgrass Lakes
/neighborhood/Sawgrass-Lakes.description: Sawgrass Lakes Homes for Sale Port Saint Lucie Homes for.

blocks.text: 409 SW Sundance Trail Port St. Lucie, FL 34953

Sawgrass Lakes in Port St Lucie is a 450 acre community with five individual neighborhoods built around a 100 acre lake. Originally intended as a golf course, Sawgrass Lakes’ homesites never back to another property. With 8 miles of shoreline the water views offer tranquility and recreation as residents can use electric-powered boats on the water.

Homes are not cookie cutter like other developments as they were constructed by various local builders such as Ameritrend, Associated, GEM, Louran, Mercedes, Pace 2000, and Tropical. Start of construction was in 1998.
Crane Pointe on the northeast side has a gated entry off of Paar Drive. Over three quarters of the 107 homes have a lake view.
Panther Trace in the northwest quadrant has a gated entry off of Darwin Blvd. With 145 homes, Panther Trace is the largest of the five neighborhoods.

Hammock Cove in the southwest corner also has a gated entry off of Darwin Blvd. Hammock Cove is the only neighborhood in Sawgrass with a clubhouse and pool. This neighborhood is the second largest with 131 homes.
The Sanctuary on the southeast side has 85 homes.
The Estates is centered between Crane Point and Sanctuary off of Paar Drive on the east side and is the newest division of Sawgrass Lakes offering new construction on 75 homesites.
Home owners dues vary among the neighborhoods and range from $75 to $110 a month. The dues cover basic cable and the common areas. Residents are required to maintain their own lawns.
RV and boat storage is offered on the north side of the community for an additional, minimal cost.

Less than 2 miles away is the 36 acre Whispering Pines Park offering a playground, baseball, basketball, tennis, volleyball, and picnic pavilions. Elementary, Middle and High Schools are also within a 2 mile radius.
Call or email Real Estate of Florida now for more information about listings in this fabulous family-friendly Treasure Coast community.

/neighborhood/sandpiper-bay.name: Sandpiper Bay
/neighborhood/sandpiper-bay.title: Sandpiper Bay
/neighborhood/sandpiper-bay.description: Sandpiper Bay Homes for Sale Port St. Lucie Homes for.

blocks.text: SW Westmorland Port Saint Lucie, FL 34952

Sandpiper Bay is on the St. Lucie River and just west of US-1. The geographic boundaries are the North Fork of the St. Lucie River to the south and west, Port St. Lucie Boulevard to the north and US 1 to the east. Nestled amongst scenic greenery and lakes in a central Port St. Lucie, it is a quaint and pristine neighborhood which features the Saints Golf Course. Sandpiper Bay features golf courses, large lots and waterfront homes, with a typical lot around a quarter-acre and many properties closer to a half-acre. While a few townhouses and condominium complexes can be found in Sandpiper Bay, most residences are single-family homes built in the 1970s and 1980s. The neighborhood comprises several subdivisions, some gated and some not, so HOAs are not universal in this community. For the most part, you'll find Mediterranean, Minimal Traditional and creative custom-built ranch-style homes or bungalows along Sandpiper Bay's streets with waterfront homes along the river that feature backyard docks and direct deepwater and ocean access.

The Treasure Coast Square is just a couple of minutes from Sandpiper Bay. Lyngate Park is just ten-minutes away, featuring a 16-acre park boasting fantastic amenities such as two baseball/softball fields, two tennis courts, a basketball court, a sand volleyball court, restrooms, a children’s playground, four racquetball courts and two pavilions complete with grills, power, lights and tables. St. Lucie County offers some nice fishing spots and sits by the southern river boardwalk. Up the road, Port St. Lucie Botanical Gardens flourishes on the riverbank with thriving Floridian habitats, including scrub, wet flatwoods, scrubby flatwoods and mangrove fringe.

Convenient for traveling, Florida's Turnpike is just a bridge away, less than 5 miles west of the community. In addition, the main thoroughfare Port St. Lucie Boulevard, runs along the neighborhood's north side, lined with commercial shops, convenient businesses and some great options for eating out.

blocks.text: Palm Aire Drive Pompano Beach, FL 33069

Palm Aire's home styles are as varied with Single-family residences in Palm Aire, comprising minimal traditional ranch-style architecture as well as Spanish eclectic influence. Low, mid and high-rise condominium buildings dwell in the community as well. There are many subcommunities within the Palm Aire area, the majority of them covered by HOAs. The gated Palm Aire Gardens community condominiums range from 1 bedroom with 600 square feet to a 3 bedroom single family home with 1,949 square feet.

Palm Aire Country Club stretches over 5,000 acres, boasting three courses: the Palms course, 6,944 yards, par-72; the Cypress course. Golfers of all skill levels are welcomed, and its courses provide a good range of difficulty. The club also offers a golfing academy, two shops and two driving ranges.

Palm Aire is treated to the best of both worlds, with its north side in Pompano Beach and south side in Fort Lauderdale. The rising city of Pompano Beach has been building out its arts, innovation and entertainment district less than 5 miles east of the area. Due south, Fort Lauderdale's established shopping mecca and downtown destination, Las Olas Boulevard, is only around a 5-mile drive away. Furthermore, residents of Palm Aire have their pick of beaches, sitting almost equidistant from the sandy expanses of Lauderdale Beach and Pompano Beach. Moreover, the Palm Aire area has direct connections to major thoroughfares, including Florida's Turnpike, Atlantic Boulevard and U.S. 441. With these main roads and highways come the plentiful commercial strips that skirt them with convenient big-box and grocery stores, regional chains and locally-owned restaurants, as well as entertainment centers, such as Harrah's. There's also the nearby DRV PNK Stadium, a soccer-specific stadium home to Inter Miami CF of Major League Soccer and its MLS Next Pro reserve side Inter Miami CF II.

blocks.text: Misty Creek Country Club is a private gated country club located in Sarasota, Florida. This equity golf community includes an 18-hole championship golf course which is surrounded by beautiful wetlands and preserves set on 350 acres of preserve with lakes and hammock forests. Although The Preserve at Misty Creek has no golf membership requirements, the club does offer golfers a beautiful golf course that is set among native trees, lakes and wildlife

Adjacent to acres of wildlife preserve and sheltered from the busy thoroughfares of Sarasota, Misty Creek is situated on 780 acres of land and includes 302 single family homes surrounding the course. This quiet, secluded community boasts one and two-story homes of approximately 3200 sq. ft. and up. There are a variety of floor plans many that pairs the main living area with a pool and spa. Misty Creek home sites are large and spacious with golf course or preserve views, which truly make this unique country club living.

Besides the golf course, the club offers members a full grass driving range, practice green and short game area with a sand bunker. In addition to excellent golf facilities, residents have access to Tennis Courts, Pickleball Courts, fully staffed pro shop, and an active social calendar. A reciprocal summer program offering playing privileges at other Sarasota area golf courses, a Men's and Women's golf association and a junior golf program are also featured. The club offers both fine dining as well as a more casual options in The Grill room on the 2nd floor of the Clubhouse. The Preserve at Misty Creek is located on a heavily forested tract of land that houses many kinds of wildlife, including deer, bobcats, bald eagles, several species of hawks, sandhill cranes, egrets, alligators, and large turtles. There is also an abundance of fish who live in our Misty Creek lakes where residents can fish and paddle on the many lakes.

Misty Creek provides members a luxurious lifestyle in a great location close to pristine beaches, shopping, dining and culture. The community is close to Interstate 75 and just off of Bee Ridge Extension. Misty Creek is approximately a 20 minute drive to beautiful beaches and resorts on Longboat and Siesta Key, close to several churches, all on Bee Ridge Road. Shopping is within minutes as well.

blocks.text: Southbend in Port St Lucie offers the look and feel of a home owner’s association without the maintenance fees and restrictions. Located south of Port St Lucie Blvd where Bayshore and Floresta curve and meet you’ll find the entrance to Southbend Blvd which runs all the way down to Becker Road.

Oak trees and Sabal palms line the streets and a sidewalk runs the entire length of the boulevard. You’ll see joggers, bikers, and many residents walking their dogs or out for a stroll every day of the week.

The majority of homes in Southbend were built on scattered lots by different builders since the 80’s. There are a few subdivisions that are gated: Osprey Ridge off of Eagle Drive, Vikings Landing, and Bay of St Lucie.
For $25 a year residents can be a part of the Southbend Lakes Resident’s Association which works to maintain the beauty and benefits of our special neighborhood.

In February 2015 the C-24 Canal Boat Ramp Park opened at the entrance to Southbend. The park offers two boat ramps, ample parking, three pavilions, and restrooms. Many Southbend residents have boats and the addition of this park makes water access much more convenient. Launching at this park bypasses many of the no-wake zones further north on the St. Lucie River.

Residents also enjoy Jessica Clinton community park which offers 20 acres of space with a pavilion, picnic tables, play area, and restrooms. blocks.text: Siesta Key is a barrier island in the Gulf of Mexico, off the coast of Sarasota, Florida. It’s known for its sandy beaches. Siesta Beach, near the shops and cafes of Siesta Key Village, has shallow waters, a playground and tennis courts. Crescent Beach offers access to Point of Rocks, limestone outcroppings that surround tidal pools and coral reefs. To the south, Turtle Beach has boat ramps and picnic areas.

Siesta Key offers condos, single family homes, townhomes and villas. Siesta Key has become known as a tropical paradise to our guests from all over the world. As soon as you cross one of the two draw bridges onto the Island of Siesta Key you will feel like you have entered a different world of lush green tropical plants, a slower pace of life, world famous beaches, and great dinning and shopping.

Siesta Key is 45 minutes south of Tampa, Siesta Key offers the nation's best beach, big city arts and entertainment. With awe-inspiring beauty and easy access into downtown, this lovely locale truly blends the best of both worlds. Enjoy easy access onto U.S. 41, and make your way to the vibrant arts scene of spectacular Sarasota. The city is infused with countless cultural offerings, from award-winning eateries and boutique shops to fascinating museums and art galleries. Top Siesta Key Neighborhood Spots include the Spearfish Grille, Big Water Fish Market, Dry Dock Waterfront Grill and Claytons Siesta Grille.

blocks.text: Oak Hills Golf and Country Club

Nestled among mature oak trees and rolling hills, Oak Hills Golf & Country Club is a private, member-owned club that was established in 1926. Oak Hills is a place for family gatherings, camaraderie and tradition. Oak Hills is a beautiful neighborhood of single family homes that is tucked away between Northcliffe and Elgin Blvd in Spring Hill, Florida. Centrally located, it is one of Spring Hill's best kept secrets with a golf course meandering throughout the neighborhood and quiet streets without through traffic. The homes in this neighborhood range in style and age from the mid 80's to present and vary in size from about 1500 Square Feet to more than 3000 Square Feet in living area. Lots are generously sized, many of them are half an acre lots that can accommodate a larger home while still allowing for plenty of breathing room between homes.

Oak Hills is a private club with formal elegance and informal dining settings. Surprisingly affordable, Oak Hills offers golf, tennis, swimming and premier dining facilities. There is an 18-hole course at the Oak Hills Golf Club. It is a deed restricted community without a mandatory homeowner's association, therefore, there are no monthly fees.

Oak Hills is ideally situated in Spring Hill allowing it easy access within minutes to shopping, medical services, restaurants, libraries, and much more. One of the three Spring Hill hospitals is located just a few miles from Oak Hills Golf Course.

blocks.text: Roser Park is one of St. Petersburg's most interesting and charming neighborhoods. Roser Park is located within the boundaries of 4th Street and Martin Luther King Jr Street to the east/west and by Booker Creek and Ingleside Avenue on the north and south. It is most recognized for its green space around the creek and hilltop residences and is the first area to be noted as an official Historic District in the town of St. Petersburg. With scenic, tree-lined streets and a welcoming community, Roser Park offers a unique blend of history, community, and convenience.

A small residential neighborhood with tree-lined streets, Historic Roser Park has a mix of uniquely American architectural styles, such as Craftsman bungalows and Colonial Revival and Prairie homes. This historic neighborhood is home to many private homes with Mediterranean or Spanish-style architecture. In Historic Roser Park, roughly 45% of buildings are single detached homes, whereas the remainder are mainly large apartment buildings and small apartment buildings. Within its boundaries are 146 historic structures. This neighborhood offers mainly lofts and one bedroom homes.

Green spaces include peaceful, 19th-century Greenwood Cemetery, with monuments to Civil War soldiers as well as graves of early pioneers. Roser Park, from which this neighborhood takes its name, has royal palms, oaks and lush flower gardens. A walking trail lines sections of Booker Creek, which runs through the area. The Historic Outdoor Museum of Roser Park is an award-winning creation of local resident, Ron Motyka, featuring 28 markers that describe the features, homes and historical significance of the neighborhood. It winds along Booker Creek and throughout the neighborhood.
I-275 is easily accessible for travel.

Sun City Center is an expansive master planned 55+,that is a self-contained town unto itself, located south of Tampa and north of Sarasota on I-75. There are plenty of choices for shopping, dining and services, and small enough to make the golf cart a preferred choice for daily transportation.

Sun City Center is home to an array of amenities uniquely crafted for residents. The community is designed around three amenity campuses that each offer facilities for fitness, social, and interest group activities. Sun City Center is home to an array of amenities uniquely crafted for residents. Greater Sun City Center, Florida has eight golf courses and several clubhouses.

Homes for sale in Sun City Center, FL are spread across a wide variety of homes models and styles. The largest section of this 55+ community is the original neighborhood built by Del Webb, which contains approximately 6,200 homes and has over 11,000 residents. A majority of the units in Sun City Center are single-family homes but there are also duplex villas and condominiums as well. Home prices, styles, and included options vary widely throughout the community. Kings Point at Sun City Center is a large gated neighborhood with approximately 5,300 villas and 9,500 residents. It is adjacent to the original neighborhood and has its own amenities and association. There are also several other neighborhoods including assisted and independent living facilities, and Renaissance, which is an enclave of single-family homes.
The Verona Collection by Minto offers unique attached 2 bedroom/2 bath, 2 car garage home designs that offer 1,503 to 1,862 square feet of living space.

Renaissance Siena Collection by Minto offers low-maintenance floor plans from 2-3 bedrooms, 2-3 car garages ranging from 1,544 to 2,557 square feet of living space. The Renaissance Calabria Collection by Minto offers three floor plans of 3 bedrooms, 3 car garages ranging from 2,878 to 3,086 square feet of living space.

The community is designed around three amenity campuses that each offer facilities for fitness, social, and interest group activities. The community is eight miles from Tampa Bay and just 45 minutes from the dining, shopping and, entertainment offered by the cities of Tampa, St. Petersburg and Sarasota. The Gulf of Mexico and other notable attractions make it desirable for those looking to take advantage of a coastal lifestyle. Sun City Center is located 25 miles south of Tampa and is conveniently located near I-75, making trips to surrounding attractions readily accessible. Sun City Center is also close to several health care providers, including Cornerstone Medical Center, Manatee Memorial Hospital, and Memorial Hospital of Tampa. Tampa International Airport is just 35 miles away.

/neighborhood/new-tampa.description: New Tampa is a unique area on the north side of Tampa Florida. This is a master-planned community with the most desired areas tend to be in the south parts.

blocks.text: New Tampa is a unique area on the north side of Tampa Florida. This is a master-planned community with the most desired areas tend to be in the south parts of the neighborhood, while more affordable homes are in the southwest regions. Surrounded by vast parkland and business parks, New Tampa South features apartment complexes and townhouse communities. The Hidden River VA Clinic sits in the south half of the neighborhood, giving local veterans access to healthcare options. New Tampa North features several gated golf communities. Neighborhoods in North New Tampa are Arbor Greene, Bassett Creek, Canterbury Trail, Corey Lake Isles, Cross Creek, Easton Park, Esplanade, Grand Hampton, Hunters Green, K-Bar Ranch, Live Oak Preserve, Pebble Creek, Richmond Place, Tampa Palms and West Meadows.

Located in New Tampa is the New Tampa Community Park, a recreation center with a 12,500 square-foot gymnastics area, which includes a gymnastics pit, tumbling strip, and full apparatus gymnastic equipment for all competitive Olympic events, and a large multi purpose room and a snack bar. The center offers both gymnastic and dance classes. In addition to the gymnastics area, the center features a concrete bi-level street skate park with pyramids, stairs, wedges and grind rails, and a series of quarter-pipe turns.
The New Tampa Regional Library is located on Cross Creek Blvd. adjacent to a small lake and wooded area offering a panoramic view of a natural habitat from the reading room.

The New Tampa Family YMCA is a wellness center with an olympic-sized swimming pool, family activities and group exercise classes for all. The wellness floor features new cardio and strength equipment.
New Tampa Performing Arts Center, a 20,000 square foot facility, includes a 354 seat multi purpose theatre with a large stage, elaborate sound and lighting complete with orchestra pit.

Residents of all ages can visit Flatwood Park, Morris Bridge Park, Trout Creek Wilderness Park or the Washburn Equestrian Area. Each park welcomes runners, cyclists and bird watchers. Children can play on the ropes course and zipline at New Tampa Nature Park. Lettuce Park has a shaded playground and several covered picnic and grilling areas. Boardwalks weave through the hardwood swamps, leading to a lakeside observation tower. Residents can canoe, kayak or fish along the Hillsborough River. Flatwood Park has bike trails, boating and camping.

New Tampa is accessible to Bruce B. Downs Blvd., Cross Creek Blvd., I-75, I-275 and New Tampa Blvd. for easy commutes. It is close to the University of South Florida and close by shopping. It is a 17 mile drive to Downtown Tampa and its amenities. Tampa International Airport is a 40 minute drive. Advent Health Care facility is in North New Tampa.

blocks.text: The Sunset Park neighborhood is located in South Tampa and its boundaries are Beach Park Isles to the North, Culbreath Heights to the northeast, El Prado the South, Tampa Bay to the West, and Manhattan Avenue to the East. Sunset Park is a coveted water-lovers haven, hugging the shoreline of Old Tampa Bay between two bridges that connect the east and west sides of the peninsula. Grand estates are graced with private piers that share wild beaches with protected mangroves, while residents are within easy reach of attractions, dining and shopping. Sunset Park’s serene canals now undulate between custom mansions with manicured lawns lined with oak, palm and pine trees. blocks.text: Seminole Heights is known for its rich history, strong sense of community and unbeatable location, with a small-town feel, yet it is still close to major highways and only10 minutes from downtown Tampa. Nationally designated as a historic district, it is located is in Tampa, just east of the Hillsborough River, tucked between East and West Tampa. The neighborhood is south of Carrollwood and USF and north of Ybor City. It is close to I-275 for easy accessibility traveling north or south. Seminole Heights, the neighborhood, consists of three distinct communities: Old Seminole Heights, South Seminole Heights and Southeast Seminole Heights.

Seminole Heights features an array of architectural styles, from early 20th century Craftsman-style bungalows to Florida crackers to modernized Mediterranean. Within the community are smaller original pockets like Hampton Terrace, where bungalows still hold the same charm as when they were built in the 1920s. Founded at the peak of the bungalow style home’s popularity, Seminole Heights boasts more bungalows than any other Tampa neighborhood. The high ceilings, low-pitched roof with wide eaves and large airspace underneath make the small wood-frame building ideal for warm climates.

Seminole Heights boasts the longest stretch of riverfront park space in Tampa offering everything from pocket parks and beach volleyball courts to dog parks and a disc golf course. Highlight include The Seminole Heights Garden Center, a popular community gathering place, the 160-acre Rogers Park Golf Course, which has an 18-hole course for all skill levels and the Jean Street Shipyard that is the oldest shipyard in the state.

Seminole Heights is a historic neighborhood known for its quirky and eclectic mix of boutiques, galleries and restaurants. Seminole Heights has a bustling night scene, thanks to popular restaurants, craft breweries and distilleries. The area is home to a number of hotspots, a buzzing art scene and even the Lowry Park Zoo.

In this gated community, these CBS constructed homes range from 3,000 square feet to over more than 6,500 square feet. A secured quaint community, with thirteen distinctive homes, offering 5 luxurious homes directly on the Loxahatchee river and another 8 beautiful interior homes on quiet stretch of the Loxahatchee River soon after it leaves Jonathan Dickinson State Park and heads towards Jupiter Inlet. Every home in Old Cypress Point is unique, as many homes in the neighborhood were custom-built, some overlooking the northwest fork of the Loxahatchee River or the 3.5 acre community lake. These riverfront homes have access to the Intracoastal waterway and Jupiter Inlet, but there are fixed bridges to take into consideration. The waterfront homes have boat docks with lifts in the backyard, swimming pools and large outdoor entertaining areas many with summer kitchens. The Loxahatchee riverfront community is actually in Martin County, but the stores and great restaurants of Jupiter and Tequesta are close by.

/neighborhood/terrace-park.description: Terrace Park Homes for Sale Hillsborough Homes for.

blocks.text: Terrace Brook Place Temple Terrace, FL 33637

Terrace Park is a neighborhood within the city limits of North Tampa, featuring established single-family homes featuring small to mid-sized ranchers, cozy homes with landscaped yards and an eclectic mix of two-story dwellings that includes custom homes, traditional split levels and Cape Cods. Many of the properties for sale in Terrace Park come with fully-fenced backyards, as well as generous master suits, laminate floors, stainless steel appliances and wood cabinets in the kitchen and so much more. Mature large oaks guard many of the Tampa homes in this Temple Terrace community.

Terrace Park is home to Busch Gardens, The Museum of Science and Industry, Saunders Planetarium, Adventure Island, a sprawling water park that features a 17,000-square-foot wave pool, a lazy river and the brand new Shaka-Lake Shores, an interactive, kid-friendly play zone. On the northern edge of Terrace Park at the intersection of science, technology and innovation in the Tampa Bay area is the Museum of Science & Industry. The university of South Florida is across Fowler Avenue. Attractions there include the Botanical Gardens, offering guided tours and field trips, the USF Contemporary Art Museum and Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Plaza, the centerpiece of the school’s greenway concept. Terrace Park conveniently located for residents traveling the area's major interstates, as all three, I-275, I-75 and I-4, surround the neighborhood. Traditional neighborhood activities take place at Takomah Trail Park, a greenspace for passive recreation that hosts many of the events. Organized athletic activity takes place at the Greco Softball Complex, run by the City of Tampa. The park features four lighted softball fields for the youth and adult tournaments held there throughout the year.

Retail and dining options are plentiful in Terrace Park. There are two Publix-anchored shopping centers in the neighborhood, and eateries are abundant along Fowler Avenue, 56th Street and Busch Boulevard. Mediterranean restaurants are especially prevalent, including Petra, which offers authentic Middle Eastern dishes.
