blocks.text: Traveling down A1A Riomar, Vero Beach's oldest and most prestigious community, is surrounded by the sparkling blue waters of the Atlantic Ocean and the Intracoastal Waterways and offers waterfront living at its best. Known for its small community feel and great location, Riomar is divided into two subdivisions; Riomar Bay I and Riomar Bay II. While homeowners in Riomar Bay II enjoy living in a 24 hour manned gated community, Riomar Bay I residents enjoy the freedom of living in a beautiful community free of any homeowners association restrictions. Each of these custom built grand estates feature wide open floor plans, upgraded kitchens, high end appliances, designer touches, and high quality finishes throughout. The homes in Riomar are as intimate as 3,400 square feet or as grand as greater than 6,000 square feet. Located between the 17th Street Causeway and the Merrill Barber Bridge, Riomar offers extravagant estates in a classic suburban neighborhood.

Riomar residents enjoy outdoor living at its best as many of the homes enjoy oversized tropical landscaped backyards, brick paved extended patios, outdoor kitchens, and resort-style heated swimming pools and spas. Most of the homes in come equipped with boat slips and docks allowing discerning mariners easy access to the Indian River, Intracoastal Waterways, and the wide open waters of the Atlantic Ocean.

The Riomar Yacht Club, a separate entity, sits just across State Road A1A. It has 650 member families, many of whom also are members of the country club. Its 40 boat slips include some used annually and offers other slips for transient boaters, which quickly fill up during the season.

Riomar consists of an 18-hole golf course, a clubhouse and a beach house surrounded by residential neighborhoods near the ocean in Vero Beach. It includes 200 members and spans an area of 100 acres. Riomar Country Club is a private, member owned club providing golf, dining, bridge, camaraderie and opportunities to gather socially in a congenial, harmonious atmosphere next to the Atlantic Ocean.

With easy access to both the Quail Valley River Club and the nearby Riomar Country Club, residents can enjoy championship golf courses, first rate tennis programs, and many other five star amenities. Riomar residents take pleasure in participating in all the amenities that the City of Vero Beach offers, seeing a show at the nearby Riverside Theater or attending an art opening at the Vero Beach Art Museum. Enjoy both casual and fine dining restaurants on Ocean Drive where the finest and freshest of Florida cuisine is featured. Appreciate the beautiful sandy beaches of the Atlantic Ocean that is walking distance from Riomar's front entrance. Situated between Melbourne and West Palm Beach, residents have easy commutes to points both north and south with access to both I-95. The Florida Turnpike, Palm Beach International Airport, Orlando International Airport, and Melbourne International Airport are only minutes away.

For the youngest Members, River Hills offers year-round junior golf and tennis programs, swim lessons and a variety of activities and camps. The Moorings is located on Vero Beach’s barrier island – a luxurious waterfront community nestled between the sparkling waters of the Atlantic Ocean and the scenic Indian River Lagoon, with direct access to the Intracoastal Waterway. Residents enjoy miles of pristine beaches, riverfront living featuring eight miles of deep-water dockage and an unsurpassed lifestyle of relaxation in this golf and boating community. Boasting over 500 acres of relaxed island lifestyle between two bodies of water, The Moorings is the perfect residential community for those looking for either a year-round or seasonal retreat. The Moorings communities consist of private luxury single-family residences and condominiums and villas, comprised of 15 different neighborhoods.

There are eight miles of seawall along the Indian River Lagoon providing a deep-water canal system connected to the Intracoastal Waterway. Riverfront properties offer boat slips, as do the two private marinas.

The private Moorings Yacht and Country Club is located within the heart of the community and offers a wide-range of amenities including two championship golf courses consisting of 36-holes of golf, nine Har-Tru tennis courts, fitness center, spa, pickle ball, croquet, kayaks, paddleboards, pool and spa, private beach, yacht club and fine and casual dining.

The charming seaside village of Vero Beach offers a great deal of cultural experiences including The Riverside Theatre, Vero Beach Art Museum, and the McKee Botanical Garden. This lush 18-acre property is home to over 10,000 native and tropical plants and one of Florida’s largest collections of water lilies. Enjoy a stroll through Ocean Drive with the ocean backdrop to designer boutique shopping and restaurants that provides a casual yet sophisticated lifestyle.

blocks.text: Situated just south of Venice, Sarasota National encompasses an exceptional offering of Venice with beautiful residences from splendid single-family homes to charming condominiums with great amenities. Sarasota National is a unique blended community built for golfers and nature lovers. The community is divided into a pair of distinct subdivisions that provide a luxurious lifestyle for all its residents. The 800 lots feature carriage-style townhomes, villas and estate homes with Spanish Mediterranean styles. The community has 2 sections. In the golf section, your golf membership is included in the HOA fee. There is also a section of the community dedicated to residents who love the surroundings but either do not golf or just want to play occasionally. This section has no mandatory golf fees attached to your home.

Sarasota National was built with input from the National Audubon Society to lessen the community’s environmental impact on 2400 acres. As a result, the homes are set amid 1,300 acres of protected land and open space. The centerpiece of Lake Village is the natural environment, as the subdivision features 350 acres of lakes, natural habitats and nature-watching. While many of the homes are on the water, the community also features a preserve, with all kinds of animals.

Amenities include an 18-hole championship golf course, known as Sarasota National Golf Course that is a private golf club, a 32,000-square-foot resort-style clubhouse, which is part of a three-building community complex surrounded by additional amenities to include a pool with beach entry, outdoor tiki bar, spa, tennis and pickleball courts, state of the art fitness center, coffee cafe, playground and an 8,000-square-foot lawn designed for events. The clubhouse comes complete with dining options. There is also a state of the art practice facility featuring a chipping green, practice putting green and a practice tee with an upscale aqua-range.

Sarasota National is conveniently located along Tamiami Trail. This bustling street is lined with restaurants, shopping centers and other services for your convenience. In a short distance north in the city of Venice, residents can find dining delights, boutique shops, museums and theatrical venues, as well as many more attractions. Just south of Sarasota, Venice is a Gulf Coast gem with something for everyone. Known as Florida's Cultural Coast, Sarasota is infused with countless cultural offerings and is known for its vibrant arts scene.

Venice is located between two major coastal cities, with St. Petersburg to the north and Fort Myers to the south. Because of the area’s large nature preserves and suburban layout, the area is mostly car dependent. Sarasota National sits along Highway 41, offering easy access to the rest of Florida’s western coast.

blocks.text: Plantation Golf & Country Club is a private, member-owned luxurious golf community in east Venice, Florida. Plantation Golf & Country Club consists of 20 distinct subdivisions and features a variety of elegant homes, from charming condos, villas, patio homes, that are maintenance-free, to spacious single-family homes with private amenities that include clubhouse, cabana and outdoor pool. Condo units vary from 948-2275 square feet, attached villas are from 1279-1765 square feet, patio homes offer 2000-2547 square feet, and estate homes range from 2178-over 3000 square feet of living area. Plantation Golf & Country Club features 2600 homes extending across 1,200 acres of lush landscaping, replicating the Bermuda island lifestyle with palm tree-lined streets and buildings in pastel colors.

This luxurious community offers an expansive clubhouse with first-class amenities, two 18-hole championship golf courses, and an active social calendar. The focal point of Plantation Golf & Country Club is the 25,000-square foot clubhouse. The clubhouse features resort-style amenities that enhance the active and social lifestyle of the community. This expansive clubhouse features a well-equipped fitness center, sauna, member's lounge, and a variety of restaurants that offer casual or fine dining. The clubhouse features the Hibiscus Room that is available for larger occasions, a multi purpose room, a card room, golf and tennis pro shop and catering kitchen. Outdoor amenities include a junior Olympic size pool, spa, 13 Hr-Tru tennis, four bocce ball, two pickleball courts. Although membership is optional, it is required to use the main clubhouse facilities. A variety of membership levels are available for a competitive fee.

Located in the highly attractive Florida Gulf Coast, residents have easy access to major highways, gulf beaches, and fun attractions . Residents have a variety of shopping and entertainment options in downtown Venice and can take a road trip to nearby Port Charlotte that is only 20 miles away. Sarasota and its international airport are only 40 minutes away, while Punta Gorda's airport is 30 miles from the community. Other cities like Tampa or Fort Myers are a little over an hour's drive from this neighborhood.

blocks.text: River Pines Homeowners Association, Inc. is a townhome community located in Stuart, Florida on the easternmost end of Cove Road in Martin County, barely five miles east of the exit at Interstate 95. It is situated where Cove Road ends at the Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway, overlooking the northern tip of Jupiter Island and just a walk across the street to Miles Grant Country Club for a golf outing. On the south, the property is bordered by a state owned area, Seabranch Preserve.

River Pines is comprised of 400 townhomes contained in 100 buildings. The buildings are a two-story variety with four units per building, at approximately twelve-hundred square feet of living space per unit with a large fence-enclosed patio. The buildings were built between 1979 and 1981 and the construction is a monolithic poured concrete structure at the first floor, and concrete structure on the exterior walls between units on the second floor. The interior structure of the second floor (which houses the balcony areas) was constructed of wood. The flat roof decks house the air-conditioning units and are also constructed of poured concrete. They are primarily overlaid with polyurethane spray-foam roofing. The mansard roofs are a facade laid over a wood truss system, which was replaced several years ago with five foot cedar panels manufactured by "Cedar Valley", out of California.

Since River Pines is a homeowner association as opposed to a condominium association, the buildings are owned by the individual owners, and not the association. The responsibility of the maintenance of the common area belongs to the association, but the maintenance of the buildings belongs to the individual owners. This maintenance responsibility (and replacement responsibility) includes the flat roofs, the mansard roofs, the fences, the stucco paint, the balconies, and any other parts of the structure. Any work done on the buildings must conform to uniformity standards.

The amenities of the Association include two double tennis courts, two racquetball courts, two pools, and a boardwalk meandering through two ecosystems (fresh water/salt water) which ends on the Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway. Of course its greatest amenity may well be the native areas bordering Riverboat Drive and the perimeter of the property. Several years ago River Pines was awarded grant funds from the State of Florida to remove invasive species from its native areas, and is now primarily in a "maintenance mode" regarding those areas.

As a result of the initial clearing of its native areas River Pines has spawned a volunteer program reaching out to owners who take the time and initiative to work in its nursery. In this nursery, in-house workers, as well as volunteers help to "step up" smaller varieties of plants into larger containers before they are placed in the field, thus saving the Association funds it might well spend on larger varieties. The program also grows from cuttings of indigenous species from the area, such species including cocoplum, porterweed, wild coffee, and many others. Due to the invasion of the pine bark beetle for many years, River Pines plants some fifteen hundred pine sapling (Densa-Dade County Hardwood Pine) every other year which are raised from one-gallon to three-gallon containers before being planted in the native areas. The current nursery system is geared toward self-sustaining practices, which will allow future owners at River Pines to keep their grounds healthy without major cash infusion.

As one can see from this information, River Pines is a healthy community which continues in its green efforts. It is located in a prime real estate territory in the state, in one of the most sought after counties in Florida. It is only a few miles to both Interstate 95 and the Florida Turnpike. Grocery shopping is just a bicycle ride, and the south hub of Martin Memorial Hospital is just three miles away.

blocks.text: 450 NE Lazy River Pkwy Port St. Lucie, FL 34983
River Place on the St. Lucie

River Place on the St. Lucie river is a 293 acre master planned community in the St. James area of northern Port St. Lucie. Native wilderness preserves and dense oak hammocks establish an “Old Florida” lifestyle that distinguishes River Place from other communities. Here, 113 acres of River Place is dedicated to open, natural preserves which are threaded by almost 2 miles of nature trails, woodlands for hiking, and wetlands for canoeing and kayaking. River Place is situated on the North Fork of the St. Lucie River, an acclaimed fishing retreat, where a lazy riverboat ride is just minutes from home.
The neighborhood consists of separate subdivisions:
Bent Paddle – 35 single- and two-story townhomes with one or two car garages. Big dogs allowed.
Little Kayak Point – 70 single family homes where half back to the preserve. In this section homeowners maintain their own lawns and are allowed to have a fence.
Moss Rose Place – Just 9 homes were built on this circle by DR Horton. More could be added.

EcoVillage – 224 greenergy new construction townhomes by HomeCrete Homes to begin in 2015. The 1 and 2-story townhomes will be zero energy in that they will produce more energy than they consume and owners will not have an electric bill! Other features included will be impact glass windows, LED lighting, Energy Star appliances, non-toxic flooring and no VOC paints, and home automation.

Canoe Park Circle – 150 homes built by Hanover with the Key West style metal roof and large front patios. The majority of the homes in this section back to water or preserve. Lawn care included and no fences are allowed.

Home owner’s dues are paid annually in January. Dues covers access to the clubhouse and basic cable for all residents. Additional dues are based on subdivision ~ Bent Paddle: $200 per month for insurance on the building, exterior maintenance, and landscaping; Little Kayak Point: $0; Moss Rose Place: $75 per month for lawn care: EcoVillage: unknown at this point; Canoe Park Circle: $80 per month for lawn care.These figures were verified in Apr. 2015.

River Place has a CDD – Community Development District – which maintains the roadways, clubhouse, pool, entrances, monuments, street lighting, boat docks, and nature trails. This CDD is paid annually in the tax bill for $1,100.
Plantation House is the resident’s clubhouse which features a large meeting room with fireplace, kitchen, private meeting room, small gym, pool with lap section and spa, and restrooms.
River Place public park provides cookout pavilion, playground, softball, soccer, basketball, sand volleyball, canoe/kayak launch, fishing pier, and nature trails.

blocks.text: 5101 SE Miles Grant Road Stuart, FL 34997
Miles Grant is a private country club located in Stuart, Florida, at East Cove Road on the shores of the Intracoastal Waterway and near the Saint Lucie Inlet.

The club offers an 18-hole par-64 course, Har-Tru clay tennis courts, pool, shuffleboard, bocce and croquet, to name a few outdoor activities. Both formal and casual dining are offered at the Clubhouse.
Miles grant offers Summer Golf, Tennis and Social Memberships as well as Annual Golf, Tennis and Social Memberships.

One of the main sports and activities at Miles Grant Country Club is golfing. The challenging and perfectly manicured course has been known since 1972 as one of the finest in the area. The 18-hole, par-64 course sports two legitimate par-fives, five par-fours, 10 par-threes, and one hole that can play as a par-four or five. The course has only “two” lakes – actually one that wraps around the 18th hole and also borders the 17th hole. All skill levels from the senior to the junior golfer, find the course to be a challenge. The facility will give you an enjoyable round in under four hours; you can ride or walk the course. There’s always a breeze!

The communities of Miles Grant are comprised of five distinct real estate sections and the homes in Country Club Cove. Each section operates independently with its own Board of Directors and management style, and thus has individual maintenance fees. Although the single family units within the community have no age restriction, Miles Grant operates mostly as a community of persons who have retired or are reaching retirement age. Residents of the condominiums are required to be 55 years of age or older. Ownership in all sections, with the exception of Fairway Villas, and the residents of Country Club Cove requires social membership in the Miles Grant Country Club.
Call or email Real Estate of Florida today for more information about this wonderful community!

Monterey Yacht and Country Club and King Mountain

Travelers along Florida's southeast Treasure Coast looking for affordable, invigorating, adult condo living should be paying attention when the signs mark the STUART exit. The alert and the lucky who turn off the highway at this point are about to discover Monterey Y&CC, where the grounds are well-tended, the roadways are safe, the people are friendly, and the golf is free.

Monterey Yacht and Country Club is a 55+ condominium complex comprised of fifty-one buildings of ten units each. Forty-nine of the buildings and the Main Clubhouse and pool, along with six ornamental ponds, meander through the nine-hole executive golf course. The final two buildings are on the opposite side of the road adjacent to the Yacht Club, beautifully situated on the bank of the south fork of the St. Lucie River.

Minutes from historic downtown Stuart and the sandy beaches of the Atlantic Ocean, close to restaurants, churches, and shopping, Monterey provides organized activities for residents to suit everyone's interests. Snowbirds alight with eager anticipation and return year after year to join the year-round residents in contributing to the stability of a population that is in every sense a community.

Monterey Y&CC was laid out by a developer in the year 1970 in an overgrown field used as a horse corral! Just three years later all 510 condominiums, ten units in each of the 51 buildings, were sold, and Monterey was energetically establishing a lifestyle that still flavors the 55-and-over community of today.

The nine-hole executive golf course which threads its way throughout the complex is the pride and joy of the residents, who simply "sign up" whenever they want to play. It's a narrow, tricky course that even Monterey's better players never tire of. Unsuspecting outsiders find it a challenge, only partly because of six strategically located ponds. Men's and women's golf leagues provide weekly competition, and frequent Saturday "scrambles" mix up the skill levels and bring unexpected results.

Also at full throttle during the season is the pool, where residents take part in daily organized exercise, swim laps, or recline on poolside lounge chairs. Umbrella tables provide the setting for sprightly games of cards and "rummy cubes" during the afternoon.

A place brimming with motion and enterprise, Monterey is basically run by volunteers who bring to life an ever-expanding spectrum of interests and activities befitting an active adult community with everything from dance parties, pinochle lessons, and bingo to an improved exercise room and newly formed canoe and kayak club. For every gathering it is well understood that everybody Is welcome.

Let there be no mistake, though; it is the people of Monterey who make the difference. Maybe it's luck, maybe it's heaven's plan, but from the very beginning and continuing throughout its history, Monterey has attracted quality people with heart and sparkle, with courtesy and culture, with friendliness and energy. This is Monterey. There is no better place to call home!

blocks.text: Montego Cove is a gated 55+, low-density condominium community located in Stuart, Florida consisting of 30 residential buildings for a total of 182 units.

The property was developed between 1984 and 1990 on 54 acres of natural terrain. The community has a Mediterranean style, characterized by picturesque red tiled barrel roofs and courtyards with wrought-iron gates. Courtyards have the personalized touch of each owner. The sophistication and charm blends with the tranquility of its natural surroundings that include two fishing lakes and a preserve area that remains unspoiled for native birds and wildlife. These are the views residents enjoy from their windows and lanais. The garden units and villas are spread out over the richly landscaped acreage to allow for a blend of privacy and communication between neighbors.

With less than four units per acre, you’ll feel as though you are living in a spacious single-family environment. The designs of the individual units incorporate dramatic and unusual angles, thereby opening the home to the outdoors and maximizing views from windows and lanais.

Life at Montego Cove was designed to be casual and relaxed with recreational enjoyment as a priority. There is a spacious 7,000-foot clubhouse with a kitchen, lounging area, card room/library, billiard room, and a patio overlooking a heated pool and whirlpool spa. The clubhouse serves as a focal point for the community with a social committee that coordinates a variety of activities. In addition, there is a second pool and a screened cabana area, shuffleboard court, and two lighted regulation size tennis courts.
Call or email Real Estate of Florida now for more information about the fabulous 55+ community of Montego Cove.

blocks.text: Palm Grove is an established 55+ community in Fort Pierce, FL. This gated active adult neighborhood features beautiful, low-maintenance single-family homes as well as a resort-style clubhouse that's brimming with amenities and activities. The clubhouse contains an exercise room, card room, library, billiards and table tennis. Outdoors, there is a heated pool, tennis, bocce ball, and shuffleboard courts. The community also features walking and biking trails, parks, natural space and beautiful picturesque lakes. This vibrant community also offers a long list of classes, clubs and events that keep residents busy every day of the week. This tranquil, close-knit neighborhood of just 365 homes is surrounded by lush landscaping making it the ideal retirement destination in St. Lucie County, Florida.

Palm Grove was developed by CBS Homes between 1993 and 2002. This active adult community consists of 365 single-family homes. Homes range in size from 1,305 to 2,766 square feet and have two or three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and an attached one or two-car garage. Buyers will love that most of these homes feature granite countertops, modern appliances, high ceilings, spacious layouts, large master suites, and screened-in front and back porches.

Residents also enjoy low-maintenance living in this age-restricted community. A monthly homeowners' association fee covers lawn care, gated guard entrance, water, sewer, cable, and common area maintenance.

Located in Fort Pierce, Florida, Palm Grove allows homeowners to have easy access to daily conveniences and attractions. Just a few minutes away residents will find major roadways like US Hwy 1, Interstate 95 and the Florida Turnpike for getting around town quickly.

There are also plenty of golf courses nearby including St. Lucie Golf Range, The Champion Turf Club at St. James, and Evergreen Golf Club. Outdoor enthusiasts will love having parks nearby such as Savannas Preserve State Park and North Fork St. Lucie River Aquatic Preserve. Water activities are plentiful with access to the St. Lucie River as well as pristine beaches along the Atlantic coast. For additional entertainment and attractions, Port St. Lucie is 20 minutes away and Jupiter is just under an hour's drive away. Palm Grove is a charming active adult community that has everything 55+ homebuyers are looking for in the Treasure Coast area in Florida.

blocks.text: North River Shores was established in the mid 1950's and is one the oldest subdivisions in Martin County. The community is located on the banks of the North Fork of the St Lucie River and just a short bike ride across the Old Roosevelt Bridge from the downtown shops and restaurants of the City of Stuart "Sailfish Capital of the World". North River Shores includes property owners of North River Shores, Coconut Park, and North River Forest subdivisions.

The community is conveniently close to major retailers and shopping including: Best Buy, Target, Sports Authority, West Marine, Home Depot, Lowes, and the Treasure Coast Mall. The community is also close to several churches, the Blake Library, the Lyric Theater, and Martin Memorial Hospital.

North River Shores is a family friendly boating community with access to the North Fork of the St Lucie River, Atlantic Ocean, Lake Okeechobee, and Gulf Coast of Florida via our private waterways. Community amenities include four waterfront neighborhood parks, a duck pond, and a private boat ramp. Recent park improvements including a fishing pier, picnic pavilion, children's play equipment, and horse shoe pits.

The parks and common areas of North River Shores are managed by a volunteer Board of Directors. The focus of the Board of Directors is to maintain and improve the quality of life in our beautiful community in a fiscally responsible manner. In addition, the Board of Directors and various community committees organize events and activities for our children and residents. Community events like our annual Snow Storm, Cookie Exchange, and Picnic provide an opportunity to spend time with our neighbors and helps foster the neighborly feeling of a hometown community. The Board of Directors publishes a bi-monthly newsletter titled "The Scoop" to keep residents informed of neighborhood activities, and local events, as well as community projects. The Board of Directors also represents our community when necessary in local government issues in Martin County and the City of Stuart.

The residents of North River Shores feel the property values and desirability of living in North River Shores has remained high in large part due to the original covenants and by-laws that were used to build our beautiful community over a half century ago. It is the hope of the Board of Directors that we will be able to maintain the quality of life in our beautiful neighborhood for the enjoyment of our families for another half a century and beyond.

blocks.text: 30 SW South River Drive Stuart, FL 34997

South River Village is a great place to live! Located on the shores of the St. Lucie River in beautiful and historic Stuart, Florida. South River is a 55+ condominium community with an abundance of acreage and recreational facilities. The community offers many activities for residents amid the tranquility of a beautiful, park-like setting with superb landscaping.

South River Village was established in Stuart in 1981 and quickly grew into a condominium community consisting of 39 two-story residential buildings spread across 87 acres. The land stretches from the property entrance on South Kanner Highway to the South Fork of the St. Lucie River. Each building contains 14 residential units. There are one-bedroom and two-bedroom units, each with its own lanai.

South River Village is unique in many ways, not the least of which is in the attention that is paid to landscaping and beautification. The builders took care to preserve much of the natural flora, and over time there have been many enhancements made to keep the environment lush and inviting. There are nine ponds which provide many residents with tranquil water views.

South River Village is gated, and for everyone’s safety, South River Drive has a speed limit of 13 mph. Many residents enjoy bicycling along the road, and many others can be seen power-walking or simply taking a stroll down to the dock to watch the sunsets. South River is a no pet condominium.
Call or email Real Estate of Florida now for more information about the wonderful 55+ community of South River Village.

blocks.text: The Stuart Yacht and Country Club

Overlooking the majestic blue waterways of the Atlantic Ocean is the Stuart Yacht and Country Club. Known as one of the most prestigious boating communities in South Florida, the Stuart Yacht and Country Club offers an intimate country club lifestyle in a luxurious and affluent community. Inspired by Old Florida architecture, this beautiful gated community offers the ultimate in private and secure enjoyment. There are 550 single family homes and luxurious villas in the Stuart Yacht and Country Club ranging in size from 2,000 square feet to just under 4,000 square feet and ranging in price from $200,000 to just under $3 million. Whether buyers are looking for a waterfront custom-built estate home or a quaint vacation retreat, the Stuart Yacht and Country Club has it all. Many homes in this prestigious and affluent community have custom-designed interiors that include open and airy floor plans, gorgeous upgraded kitchens, spa-inspired bathrooms, recessed lighting, high-end flooring, and Master bedroom retreats. Private backyards with magnificent swimming pools, shaded areas, and summer kitchens are the norm in this gated enclave. The Stuart Yacht and Country Club is one of the few country club communities along the Treasure Coast that offer deep water access through the Manatee Pocket and St. Lucie Inlet to the wide open waters of the Atlantic Ocean. To the west, mariners can travel down the St. Lucie Canal where they will find Lake Okeechobee and easy passage to the west coast of Florida.

/neighborhood/the-windjammer.title: The Windjammer

blocks.text: 1850 SW Palm City Rd Stuart, FL 34994

The Windjammer is a 55+ condominium community located in Stuart, Florida along the South Fork of the St. Lucie River. This waterfront active adult community consists of 130 low-maintenance condominium homes distributed across nine elevator buildings, most of which provide canal or river views. Most homes feature open floor plans and screened-in porches or glass-enclosed lanais that overlook waterfront views of the canal, marina, or river

Residents of The Windjammer have access to a community clubhouse that hosts social events. The impressive selection of three outdoor swimming pools includes two along the canal and one that overlooks the St. Lucie River. One of the pools is heated, while all three are surrounded by the community’s lushly landscaped grounds.

Many of the homes at The Windjammer offer accompanying docks, which are deeded to the condominiums and owned by the unit owners. The waterfront location provides access to the Indian River Lagoon and the Intracoastal Waterway, leading to the Atlantic Ocean.

The Windjammer is located in Stuart, Florida, just 25 minutes from Port St. Lucie, putting residents in easy reach of daily needs and fun opportunities. When dining out, restaurants such as Riverwalk Cafe and Oyster Bar, Stuart’s Fish and Pig, Ground Floor Farm, and Flanigan’s Seafood Bar and Grill can be found nearby.

There are also multiple greenspaces and parks to choose from, including Kiplinger Nature Preserve, Poppleton Creek Dog Park, Shepard Park, and Leighton Park. Several scenic Atlantic Coast beaches are just a 20-minute drive away, including Bathtub Reef Beach, Santa Lucea Beach, Jensen Beach Park, and Waveland Beach.
The Windjammer is also close to multiple health care providers, including Treasure Coast Primary Care and Cleveland Clinic Martin Health.

blocks.text: The Anchorage on the St. Lucie River
SE Anchorage Cove Port St. Lucie, FL 34952

The Anchorage on the St. Lucie River is a quiet condo community in the heart of Port St. Lucie off of Westmoreland Blvd. Situated on the North Fork of the St. Lucie River, this community offers boat slips with deep water ocean access. It is a perfect community for all kinds of residents, including those that are looking for a winter getaway or a year round paradise. Its location along Westmoreland Boulevard puts The Anchorage in a special place among communities within Port Saint Lucie, as it combines many amenities with that convenient location, providing an all-inclusive atmosphere for its residents.

The residents of The Anchorage are able to enjoy an active clubhouse, a gated entrance, space for boats to be docked, a community swimming pool, a hot tub, shuffleboard courts, two tennis courts, a boat storage area, and winding pathways throughout the community along the Saint Lucie River. The clubhouse within the community hosts several social events year round, as well as year round cookouts for residents to enjoy. The safety provided by the gated entrance ensures that children are safe to play in The Anchorage’s streets.
The condos were built in the late 80’s and are twelve per building with 220 units in this gated neighborhood. The average living space is 1,019 and all three levels are accessed by stairs.
